raw.description:
About Kindsight:

Kindsight builds technology that helps fundraisers make a difference. For decades, Kindsight has supported the education, healthcare, and nonprofit sectors with fundraising tools and the largest charitable giving database on the market. And as the giving sector evolves, so does Kindsight. As the leader in fundraising intelligence, Kindsight leverages real-time data and AI to help thousands of organizations around the world identify, manage, and engage with donors - at any scale. With purpose-built CRMs that corral all of that donor information and campaign tracking into one place, donor prospect research tools that offer proactive insights and real-time donor intel, and generative AI that creates personalized, meaningful content drafts at scale, Kindsight’s product suite is truly changing the game for donor fundraising.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a hands-on Data Engineer to build and maintain the data platform behind Kindsight's customer-facing analytics products. You will work across the full pipeline: ingesting data from customer environments into our data lake, and transforming it through a dimensional data warehouse that powers dashboards and AI-driven insights. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys building production data systems and wants depth in modern data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and multi-tenant analytics at scale.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and maintain ELT pipelines that ingest data from customer Salesforce environments into our AWS data lake, covering both scheduled batch loads and near-real-time change data capture.

  • Develop data transformation layers (medallion architecture) and dimensional models in dbt on Redshift or Snowflake, implementing incremental logic, slowly changing dimensions, and derived metrics against defined specifications.

  • Write and optimize advanced SQL for transformation, aggregation, and data quality validation across large, multi-tenant datasets.

  • Work hands-on with AWS: S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Step Functions, Lambda, IAM, Lake Formation, and CloudWatch.

  • Onboard new customer data sources by extending existing configuration-driven pipelines, and verify each onboarding against defined acceptance criteria.

  • Build automated data quality checks, reconciliation queries, and monitoring so that pipeline failures are caught and diagnosed quickly.

  • Investigate and resolve data issues end to end — from source system behaviour through ingestion and transformation to the final reported number.

  • Contribute to infrastructure as code (AWS CDK or Terraform) for the pipelines and resources you work on.

  • Support dashboard and reporting development in QuickSight or Tableau, ensuring the underlying data models serve them correctly.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience building and operating production data pipelines.

  • Advanced SQL. You are comfortable with window functions, CTEs, complex joins, and query performance tuning, and you can debug a wrong number by reading the query plan and the data.

  • 2+ years of hands-on AWS experience, including S3, Glue, Athena or Redshift, IAM, and at least one orchestration service such as Step Functions, or Airflow.

  • 2+ years building ETL/ELT pipelines with dbt, or equivalent transformation frameworks, including incremental models and testing.

  • 2+ years working with cloud data warehouses ; Redshift, or Snowflake — including dimensional modeling with star schemas and query optimization.

  • Solid Python for data work: API integrations, data processing scripts, and pipeline code.

  • Experience with Git-based workflows, code review, and CI/CD for data pipelines.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus:

  • Experience integrating Salesforce data, including the REST and Bulk APIs, Change Data Capture, and Salesforce data models and objects.

  • Familiarity with fundraising or nonprofit sector data, or CRM and ERP data models more generally.

  • Experience with open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, or Delta Lake

  • Experience with multi-tenant data platforms and tenant isolation patterns.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code, particularly AWS CDK.

  • Experience with BI development in QuickSight or Tableau.

Compensation Range: $120,000 - $135,000 CAD OTE annually, based on experience, market benchmarks and role complexity. We aim to offer fair, competitive pay that reflects your skills and the market.

This advertised position is for an existing vacancy at Kindsight. At Kindsight, we’re proud to be a place where everyone belongs and has an equal opportunity to contribute, thrive and grow. We hire based on skills, potential, and impact, and we believe our differences fuel innovation. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. We’re building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to do meaningful work and make a difference.

We leverage artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools may help with resume screening, drafting job descriptions, creating interview questions and occasionally identifying potential candidates. All hiring decisions are made by our people, not AI. Our intent is to use AI thoughtfully to streamline administrative tasks, improve the candidate experience and support fair, unbiased hiring practices consistent with industry standards.

raw.description:
About Magic

For over 10 years, Magic has connected top remote talent with fast-growing businesses — backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, with thousands of remote workers worldwide.

Role Overview

When a business brings on a Magic assistant, the relationship doesn't run itself. That's where you come in.
This is a post-sale, account-first role. You'll carry a book of client-assistant pairings and be accountable for how well each one works — from day one of onboarding through every milestone after. Inbound requests will come in, but fielding requests isn't the core of the job. The core is knowing your accounts well enough that you can spot what's about to go wrong before it does, get on a call, and fix it.
Shift: Monday–Friday, 10 PM–7 AM PHT. Training runs 4 weeks across two phases — Product Skills (shadowing, live-call listening) then Immersion (live tickets and onboarding under supervision, KPIs measured from day one). Zero absences during training, documented medical emergencies only, 80%+ required on daily assessments and mock calls to continue.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of client accounts — track the health of each pairing, flag risks early, and keep every relationship on track
  • Lead onboarding sessions, 30-day account reviews, and recurring check-ins that keep clients and their assistants aligned
  • Advocate for assistants internally — coaching conversations, feedback loops, and surfacing what they need to leadership
  • Own retention conversations — identify accounts at risk and lead win-back efforts before the client decides to leave
  • Handle 30+ inbound account requests daily with fast, personalized responses that reflect actual knowledge of that account
  • Maintain clean, detailed HubSpot records for every client interaction — useful to anyone who touches the account after you
  • Coordinate across Operations, Finance, and Engineering when an account issue goes beyond your direct scope

Qualifications Technical Requirements

  • 3+ years of client-facing experience in account management, account support, or B2B customer success — US accounts strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple active client accounts simultaneously without losing thread or detail
  • Fluent written and verbal English — equally sharp in a written account update and a live escalation call
  • Reliable night-shift availability (10 PM–7 AM PHT) with documented history of night-shift work
  • CRM proficiency, HubSpot preferred
  • Proactive by default — you identify account risks and act on them before anyone has to ask

Why You'll Be a Great Fit

After 90 days, your accounts run smoothly not because nothing went wrong — but because you caught the problems early and handled them. You know your client portfolio without having to look everything up. You're as comfortable on a direct call with a frustrated client as you are writing a clear, concise account note at 3 AM. You've worked night shift before, and you know how to pace yourself through a shift that gets busy fast when US business hours kick in.
This isn't the role if you've never managed a real account portfolio before, if "account ownership" means something different to you than being personally responsible for how each relationship turns out, or if your default is to wait for issues to escalate before you move.

Application Process

Application + Pre-Qualifying Questions → HR Interview (30 min) → Skill Assessment (Written Case Study) → Second-Level Interview with Support Management → Mock Feedback Call → Final Interview with Head of Sales → Job Offer → 4-Week Training Program

Compensation Benefits

Gross package ₱32,000–₱38,000/month, total potential ₱38,000–₱40,000/month · Night shift (10 PM–7 AM PHT) · Full training program included

Why Magic?

We're ambitious, driven, and unapologetically the type to plow through obstacles instead of waiting for perfect conditions. Our work dynamic is genuinely different — dynamic, friendly conversations, zero politics, and no hierarchy standing in your way. You can talk to anyone, on any team, about anything, because we respect each other's time and actually like working together. Y Combinator and Sequoia-backed, thousands of remote workers strong, and growing.
﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿

In a nutshell

Title:Account Manager, Academia

Location:United States (remote) - EST preferred
Type: Full-time
Compensation: $100K-$120K base, $30k-$50K variable comp, $130K-$170K OTE
Reporting to: Director of Sales and Account Management
Travel:Approximately 50% (typically 2–3 trips per month), including overnight stays.


The Opportunity

Oxford Medical Simulation Inc (OMS) is scaling fast in the US and we’re hiring a commercial, Account Manager to own renewals and expansion across a portfolio of academic institutions.

This is a role for someone who loves running a book of business, building executive relationships, and closing revenue - protecting and growing ARR through structured renewal motion, account planning, and value-led commercial negotiation.

You do not need prior virtual reality experience. We’ll train you on OMS’s platform and products. What matters most is that you can retain and grow accounts with rigor, pace, and commercial instinct.

What You’ll Own

You will be accountable for:

  • Renewal revenue: own end-to-end renewals for your portfolio,

  • Expansion revenue: identify, qualify, and close upsell/cross-sell opportunities to deliver

  • Forecasting & accuracy: maintain a reliable forecast and pipeline, with strong CRM hygiene and forecasting in Hubspot

  • Executive relationships: build multi-threaded relationships across faculty leadership, program directors, simulation leadership, procurement, IT, and budget owners

  • Commercial negotiation: lead pricing, packaging, and contract negotiations (including multi-year deals), partnering with Legal/Finance as needed

  • Account strategy: run account plans for top customers, mapping stakeholders, renewal risks, competitive threats, and expansion paths

What You’ll Do Day-to-Day

  • Manage a portfolio of 25-50 academic customers and drive a disciplined renewal motion beginning 6 months before contract end

  • Build and execute account plans to expand footprint across programs, campuses, cohorts, or departments

  • Identify new buying centers and develop expansion opportunities (e.g., additional programs, multi-campus rollout, new use cases)

  • Run executive check-ins and commercial reviews tied to outcomes, budget cycles, and renewal timelines

  • Recurring QBRs and touch points with key stakeholders to drive utilization and best practices for Success

  • Own and progress commercial conversations through procurement, contracting, and approvals

  • Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., Product, Clinical, Support) to remove blockers and protect revenue

  • Represent OMS at conferences and events to deepen customer relationships and uncover expansion opportunities

Who You Are

We’re looking for a commercial AM who has consistently delivered results.

Required

  • 3+ years experience in quota-carrying Account Management (renewals + expansion) in B2B healthcare or healthcare academia SaaS

  • Proven record of achieving or exceeding 100%+ NRR targets

  • Experience managing renewals end-to-end, including pricing and negotiation

  • Strong pipeline management, forecasting discipline, and CRM excellence ideally in Hubspot

  • Comfort with complex, multi-stakeholder environments and long buying cycles

Preferred

  • Experience selling intoacademic institutions(universities, nursing schools, medical schools etc)

  • Familiarity with healthcare education, clinical training, simulation, or adjacent markets

  • Experience working through procurement, IT review, and contracting processes common in academia

You’ll thrive here if you

  • Love owning a number and building a plan to hit it

  • Are proactive, organized, and relentless about renewal risk management

  • Can communicate value with senior stakeholders and defend price with confidence

  • Enjoy travel and relationship-based selling in the field

About Oxford Medical Simulation

OMS helps health systems, nursing schools, and medical schools deliver training and assessment better, cheaper, faster and at scale.

Our award-winning simulation platform is transforming the way healthcare and educational institutions train, assess, and recruit healthcare professionals. By combining cutting-edge 3D visualization with artificial intelligence and leading educational theory, OMS delivers all of the benefits of physical simulation while driving significant savings and improving patient care.

Founded in 2017 and commercially launching the award-winning OMS Platform in late 2018, OMS has experienced rapid growth with deployments spanning more than 100 Healthcare and Academic institutions around the world including Mayo Clinic, Advent Health, Johns Hopkins, the NHS, and the world’s #1 pediatric hospital.

Oxford Medical Simulation is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. Oxford Medical Simulation is an equal opportunity employer committed to a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.


Who we are

We are Skiers / Boarders, Runners, Rowers, Pilots, Magicians, Weavers, Photographers, Game Heroes, Movie Buffs, and every other variety of people. We are hard working. We are passionate about what we do. We care about the work. We care about each other. We care about pushing the envelope and we care about using our working lives to make the world a better place.

We value these behaviors above all:

  1. Care & Pride - we take care and pride in everything we do

  2. Growth mindset - we push the boundaries so we are adaptive, inventive and always learning

  3. One Team - we are in it together, mucking in and supporting each other with humour and humility

Sound like you?

Benefits

  • Uncapped commission

  • Medical, Vision and Dental Insurance

  • High specification laptop and VR headset

  • Flexible work environment - work from home/ remote first

  • $600 one-off office set up allowance

  • Knowing that you are making a real difference!

Bask is the best telehealth platform on the market. Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs and businesses to launch a DTC telemedicine company quickly and easily, abstracting away the complexities of the industry into an easy-to-use platform. With hundreds of features to meet the unique needs of telehealth, we put all the tools in our customers' hands for success. We are a rapidly growing startup, and we work with care and intention to create a high-performance company with the following in mind:

  • Speed Wins. Make decisions, move quickly, and know that if things go wrong, it's okay for you and the company.
  • Intuition, Then Data. We're a data-driven company. We start with our instincts and then use data to validate our decisions and improve.
  • Miles, Not Inches. Thinking small is a self-fulfilling prophecy. Favor bold ideas over incremental changes.
  • Customer-Obsession. We are obsessed with helping all our customers launch multi-billion-dollar companies with ease. We accomplish this by knowing our customers incredibly well and finding ways to make their businesses better.

We're looking for a highly analytical and execution-oriented operations professional who enjoys bringing structure to complex, customer-facing technical organizations. You're comfortable working independently, partnering with senior stakeholders, and translating broad business priorities into practical processes and measurable outcomes. You think in systems, are naturally curious, and can move between strategic planning and hands-on execution without needing someone to map out every step.

Field Engineering Operations at Bask Health is AI-first and customer-obsessed. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into operational planning, data analysis, and process improvement, is validated against real team performance and customer outcomes, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of the workflow, not side experiments.

We are looking for someone who takes full ownership of operational processes and insights, treats AI as a real collaborator, and cares deeply about helping customer-facing teams deliver an exceptional experience while operating efficiently.

What You'll Do

  • Work AI-first: Use AI and automation to analyze operational challenges, improve workflows, and reduce repetitive manual work.

  • Partner with technical and GTM leadership on capacity planning, territory alignment, resource allocation, and performance measurement.

  • Analyze operational data to identify bottlenecks, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Product, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations to execute operational initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve internal tooling, introduce automation, and share effective AI-native workflows.

In This Job, You Will:

  • Own the day-to-day operational planning and reporting processes for Field Engineering.
  • Build capacity models to understand team workloads, coverage needs, resource allocation, and future hiring requirements.
  • Support territory planning and account assignment in partnership with Sales and GTM teams.
  • Establish clear metrics and dashboards to measure team performance, account engagement, onboarding progress, and customer outcomes.
  • Track the customer journey from technical sales engagement through onboarding and go-live, identifying opportunities to improve time-to-value.
  • Develop processes that improve visibility into customer adoption, implementation progress, and potential account risks.
  • Maintain and improve Salesforce data, workflows, reporting, and integrations to support operational needs.
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business priorities into actionable plans and follow through on execution.
  • Use data and analysis to make recommendations and measure the impact of operational improvements.
  • Find comfort in working in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Believe no task is too small and no task is too tall.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Field Engineering Operations, Business Operations, Strategy, or Technical Program Management at a high-growth SaaS company.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing technical teams such as Solutions Architects, Sales Engineers, Customer Success Engineers, Technical Account Managers, or Professional Services.

  • Strong understanding of capacity planning, resource allocation, territory planning, and performance measurement.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce administration and reporting, including custom objects, flows, and integrations.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex data into actionable insights.
  • Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and working cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Product, and Customer Success.
  • Comfortable independently owning projects and driving execution without direct reports.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with SQL, BI tools, or building lightweight internal tools is a plus.

About the Role

At Abnormal AI, we are on a thrilling mission to safeguard the world's largest enterprises against a vast range of relentless email attacks. We protect our customers against adversaries who constantly evolve their techniques and tactics to outwit and undermine traditional email security approaches. That’s what makes our novel behavioral- based approach so…Abnormal. Abnormal has constantly been named as one of the top cybersecurity startups and our behavioral AI system has helped us win various cybersecurity accolades resulting in being trusted to protect more than 15% of the Fortune 500 (and ever growing).

As a Software Engineer II, you will build customer-facing security features and the software that supports them. Projects may include detection services or AI agents that use models and software tools to investigate suspicious activity. Other projects support model development and evaluation, mostly driven by automated agentic loops.

You will collaborate closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and fellow Software Engineers to turn new approaches into reliable production systems and in turn help us catch more attacks and improve security investigations while limiting false positives and cost. Your work will help keep our inbound email security product world-class in an ever-evolving threat landscape. Your contributions will directly influence the success of our Email Security product and Abnormal as a whole.

Strong software engineering skills are essential. Practical machine learning experience is preferred.

What You Will Do

  • Build backend services and data pipelines for customer-facing security features.
  • Integrate machine learning models and large language models into detection and investigation workflows.
  • Develop AI agents that analyze suspicious activity and support security investigations.
  • Build tools that make model training repeatable, agent-driven, and help engineers evaluate AI systems.
  • Evaluate changes against real attack patterns and investigate missed attacks and false positives.
  • Improve system reliability and performance within latency and cost limits.
  • Write tested, readable code and contribute to technical designs and code reviews.
  • Own well-defined features from design through release and monitor their behavior in production.

Must Haves

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related engineering field.
  • At least 2 years of experience in software design and development.
  • Experience with backend services or data-intensive applications where reliability and performance matter.
  • Strong programming skills in a general-purpose language and knowledge of data structures and software design.
  • Experience with automated tests and diagnosis of production issues through logs and metrics.
  • Ability to turn a product requirement into a practical design and deliver it with guidance on larger technical decisions.
  • Clear technical communication and effective collaboration with other engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on machine learning experience from industry, research, or substantial projects.
  • Experience with large language models or AI agents, including evaluation of accuracy and reliability.
  • Experience with statistical evaluation of classifiers, including precision and recall.
  • Experience with Python or Go.
  • Experience with data pipelines or tools that make model experiments reproducible.
  • Experience with cybersecurity or fraud detection.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:
$149,200—$214,500 USD

📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Security Consultant binnen een centrale overheidsdienst voor digitale veiligheid bouw je de dienstverlening rond cybersecurity testing en exposure management uit, beheer je die en ontwikkel je ze verder. De dienstverlening ondersteunt overheidsorganisaties en lokale besturen bij het tijdig identificeren en behandelen van kwetsbaarheden.

Cybersecurity testing omvat onder meer penetratesten, vulnerability disclosure-programma's, bug bounty-programma's en andere vormen van offensieve beveiligingstesten. Exposure management omvat onder meer vulnerability management, attack surface management (ASM) en de bijbehorende processen, methodologieën en oplossingen voor het beheer van kwetsbaarheden en blootstellingsrisico's.

Je vertaalt de behoeften van stakeholders naar een duidelijke productvisie, roadmap en concrete dienstverlening. Daarbij bewaak je de kwaliteit van resultaten en werk je samen met interne teams en externe dienstverleners. De functie combineert product ownership met diepgaande inhoudelijke expertise. Naast het uitwerken, aansturen en verbeteren van de dienstverlening neem je actief deel aan de dagelijkse werking. Je bouwt expertise rond cybersecurity testing en exposure management actief op en borgt die binnen de organisatie via kennisdeling, documentatie, standaarden en werkwijzen. General Description:


At BeOne, our Global Development SuperHighway — our integrated, end-to-end, wholly internal development capability — is a cornerstone of our R&D vision. It brings together a unique set of internal cross-functional capabilities from across the globe needed for efficient delivery of clinical trials to develop impactful medicines to accelerate access to innovation for patients around the world.

We are now opening this same delivery engine to the world’s most promising external science. Through SuperHighway partnerships, highly promising assets from leading biotech partners can access our development capabilities creating a true win-win ecosystem with the ultimate goal of helping more patients around the world. This is not a fee-for-service model; it is a bold new way to grow the company and expand what’s possible in oncology. This is a rare opportunity to help build something genuinely new — joining a high-caliber, agile team at the leading edge of clinical development innovation. If you are energized by building, by challenging the status quo, and by making a real impact on patients’ lives, this is where you belong.

Leveraging deep Therapeutic Area expertise, solid global program management skills, global view, and borderless leadership, the GCO Program Lead is accountable for the strategic operational planning and clinical operational performance, of designated programs and acts as a point of escalation for the resolution of issues of the studies within responsible program(s).

Provide strategic leadership to global Clinical Study Managers across designated programs by setting clear expectations, fostering a culture of accountability and proactive risk management, and ensuring alignment with organizational goals. Act as a mentor and coach to develop talent, drive performance excellence, and support career growth through regular feedback and development planning. Collaborate cross-functionally to enable program success and maintain high standards of delivery.

Partner with other program leads/functional representatives in BeOne R&D to drive disease/asset strategy and ensure execution excellence by contributing clinical operations insights and expertise at the program level.

This is an international role and requires working with colleagues in various time zones.

This role helps deliver the partnership studies that run on our Clinical SuperHighway, supporting seamless onboarding and high-quality execution of external partner projects in close partnership with the execution functions.

Essential Functions of the Job:


Strategic leadership and management

· Accountable and responsible for building, developing and retaining the global team of gCSM, including hiring, training, mentoring, developing direct and indirect reports, performance appraisals and resource management.

· Oversee the delivery and goal achievement of projects within the designated program(s), serving as the point of escalation for resolving issues that gCSM cannot resolve.

· Collaborate with the other GCPLs and Franchise Heads (FH) to define and implement strategies and key priorities across-programs, and establish global standards for goals, performance measures, and capability development for the gCSM roles.


GCO Representative for the designated program(s)

· In coordination with Franchise Head, Accountable to the Franchise ERC, DCT and other governance teams as appropriate as GCO representative, to provide clinical operational insight to drive the program strategy and ensure excellence in execution.

· Lead/participate in the KOL engagement activities in the designated programs and may act as function spokesperson if needed.


Program Management

· Evaluate and develop strategic feasibility and budget estimates during Early Planning for new CDPs and upon strategy change during the conduct of a study, where needed.

· Accountable for resource allocation and initiating CST formation; ensures appropriate transition of outputs from early planning to the gCSM.

· Create and be accountable for the annual program budget and resource forecasts, as well as contributing to and tracking the relevant DCT goals for the program.

· Create, review, and provide input to and maintain compound-level documents such as IB, DSUR, and protocol.

· Oversee timely, quality, and efficient study planning and execution of associated studies within the allocated program.

· Conduct regular program review meetings to mentor, support, and ensure all studies are tracking to the DCT/DRC-approved budget and timeline.

· Report on study status, goals, and operational KPIs, and enforce quality KPIs with support from the Compliance team.

· Collaborate with other GCPLs to evaluate and designate preferred global vendors and participate in vendor governance meetings.

· Create or review performance and development plans for direct reports, facilitate and support delivery of performance and development goals.

· Provide line management and mentorship to gCSMs working within the designated program(s).

· Inspire and lead efforts to deepen scientific knowledge within the Clinical Operations’ function.

· Champions a global mindset and approach across Clinical Operations to foster collaboration and consistency across the organization.

· Provide expert knowledge on the execution of clinical trials through a deep understanding of ICH/GCP Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements.

· Point of escalation for all compound-related issues.

· Identify and drive process improvement initiatives in collaboration with Franchise Head and/or other GCPLs within program.

· Collaborates with cross-functional leaders to provide operational perspectives to enable effective and efficient delivery of clinical development goals.

Supervisory Responsibilities: Line-manages direct reports of Global Clinical Study Managers (gCSMs).

Computer Skills: MS Office; Project Planning Applications; Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS)


Other Qualifications:

· Project management exposure/experience across the entire lifecycle of multi-region/country clinical trials in a fast-paced global environment. Experience in both people management and program management preferred.


Travel: Up to 20%. Ability to travel domestically and internationally.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

Working with established sales infrastructure, dedicated marketing support, and robust product offerings, the National Sales Director will ensure rigorous pipeline management, consistent deal execution, and ongoing professional development for a team of experienced RCM sales professionals.

Sales Execution & Team Leadership

  • Active engagement in high-value, complex sales cycles—joining enterprise pitches, assisting in deal structuring, and helping close major contracts alongside sales reps.
  • Monitor sales activity against established KPIs, identify operational bottlenecks, and provide targeted coaching to maximize rep productivity and win rates.

Strategic Alignment & Market Expansion

  • Roll out and execute national sales campaigns and initiatives aligned with overall company objectives and defined target specialties.
  • Identify high-yield growth opportunities within assigned accounts and prospect bases to expand market share across our core RCM solutions.
  • Represent the organization at major national trade shows, industry conferences, and executive forums to strengthen key client relationships and brand presence.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance

Preferred Qualifications

about the role

  • Own the aftermarket product, including reseller tooling that makes it easy for our resellers to list and sell names, and fast, reliable transfers after each sale.

  • Own parking monetisation for eligible domains, covering provider performance, page-content standards and reseller revenue share.

  • Support the Director Product and Lead PM on the reseller platform and module roadmaps through discovery and clear specifications for assigned items.

  • Learning Agility and AI Literacy: you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.

  • Adaptive Innovation Mindset: you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.

  • Quality Orientation: you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on Partnerships & BD expert to grow our banking, deposits, and investing partners, and to bring on the ones we haven't met yet. Most of the job, roughly 70 to 80 percent, is growing the partners we already have: bigger budgets, better economics, broader distribution. The rest is net new, mostly warm, with real outreach on the investing side where the relationships don't exist yet.

You'll work alongside our Head of Partnerships, who will continue to focus on our largest strategic partners. On those strategic partners, you'll run the operations. Across the rest of banking, deposits, and investing, you own it fully, operationally and strategically. That's what gives the Head of Partnerships room for the biggest bets, and it's what makes this seat yours.

This isn't a support role, and it isn't customer service. The job is to grow relationships, not just service them.

WHY THIS SEAT

  • A category to own. Banking, deposits, and investing partners outside our largest strategic accounts are yours, start to finish.
  • A partner, not a handoff. Our Head of Partnerships works closely alongside you for your first 90 days, and the goal is full independence by about day 120.
  • Room to shape it. You'll inherit real momentum, but the strategy in these categories is still being written, and you'll help write it.
  • Close to the media. You'll connect what partners need to placements across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network, which is where a good partnership becomes an extraordinary one.
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership on the deals that matter.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Direct experience on the advertiser side of a financial comparison publisher, marketplace, or performance network, managing bank, deposit, or investing partners.
  • A record of growing accounts, not just servicing them. You can walk through a partner whose budget you grew and what moved it.
  • Sales DNA. You open doors and close. Warm relationships are most of it, but you're comfortable with cold outreach, especially to investing apps.
  • Ownership of the details. URL approvals, budget changes, CPA moves, placement and widget coordination: you run them yourself and nothing drops.
  • You figure it out without being pushed, and you pull in account management, product, media, analytics, compliance, legal, and finance to get it done.
  • Fluency in performance economics, including CPA, CPL, CPC, and revenue share, and the business acumen to use performance, revenue, and unit-economic data in a negotiation.
  • Strong communication, relationship building, and negotiation across several partners and opportunities at once.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Publisher experience, or enough of the language to hold the conversation.
  • Experience in wealth management, financial advisory, RIAs, or advisor networks.
  • Existing relationships with banks, fintech companies, investment platforms, or related financial-services companies.
  • Experience selling customer acquisition, media, lead generation, or performance-based marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Existing partners

  • Budget growth, better unit economics, broader product coverage, and a bigger share of wallet with the partners you own.
  • The operations on our largest strategic banking partners, alongside the Head of Partnerships.
  • Partner operations from onboarding through campaign management, reporting, issue resolution, and optimization.
  • Proposals that connect a partner's goals to placements, audiences, and distribution across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network.
  • Accurate pipeline, forecasts, partner updates, and next steps.
  • Launch Potato's presence at industry events and partner meetings.

New partners

  • A pipeline across banking, deposits, investing, and wealth.
  • Reaching the right decision makers through relationships, referrals, events, and outbound.
  • Partner conversations from first outreach through pitch, deal negotiation, contracting, and launch.
  • A clear read on each partner's growth goals, economics, products, and target customers.

WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

  • First 90 days: you're learning the book side by side with the Head of Partnerships and running operations on the partners you'll own.
  • By about day 120: you run your partners independently.
  • By month 6: you're directing internal traffic and connecting partner activity to media opportunity.
  • Year one: larger budgets and stronger economics across existing partners, new banks and investing advertisers live, and the Head of Partnerships focused on our largest, most strategic deals.

THIS ISN'T THE RIGHT SEAT IF YOU

  • Want to hunt, close, and hand the account to someone else.
  • Want someone else to own the operations.
  • Need a playbook handed to you before you move.
  • Would rather service an account than grow it.

TOTAL COMPENSATION

  • Base: $150,000 to $170,000, set by level and expertise based on initial interviews.
  • Annual Bonus: company EBITDA plus personal performance. No commission.

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Join the Team Modernizing Medicine

At ModMed, we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach: we hired doctors and taught them how to code. This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.

A Culture of Excellence

When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction. From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

  • Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work

  • 2025 Globee Business Awards: Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”

We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.

Ready to modernize medicine with us?

Job Description Summary:

ModMed is hiring a National Sales Director of RCM Sales to lead, manage, and optimize our established national Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) sales organization.


This role focuses on executing corporate go-to-market strategies, driving team performance against assigned revenue quotas, and expanding our market presence across medical practices and health systems nationwide.


Working with established sales infrastructure, dedicated marketing support, and robust product offerings, the National Sales Director will ensure rigorous pipeline management, consistent deal execution, and ongoing professional development for a team of experienced RCM sales professionals.

Your Role:

Sales Execution & Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and manage an established team of RCM sales executives to consistently meet and exceed individual and regional quota targets.
  • Conduct structured weekly pipeline reviews, deal strategy sessions, and accurate sales forecasting using established CRM tools and metrics.
  • Active engagement in high-value, complex sales cycles—joining enterprise pitches, assisting in deal structuring, and helping close major contracts alongside sales reps.
  • Monitor sales activity against established KPIs, identify operational bottlenecks, and provide targeted coaching to maximize rep productivity and win rates.

Strategic Alignment & Market Expansion

  • Roll out and execute national sales campaigns and initiatives aligned with overall company objectives and defined target specialties.
  • Identify high-yield growth opportunities within assigned accounts and prospect bases to expand market share across our core RCM solutions.
  • Represent the organization at major national trade shows, industry conferences, and executive forums to strengthen key client relationships and brand presence.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance

  • Partner with Marketing, Operations, Product Development, and Client Success teams to align client expectations with service delivery and ensure smooth onboarding.
  • Leverage existing sales enablement assets, ROI tools, and training programs to maintain consistent messaging and deal acceleration across the team.
  • Ensure team compliance with sales processes, pricing guidelines, contracting policies, and ethical sales standards.

Key Operational Focus Areas

  • Delivering steady, monthly quota attainment rather than erratic growth spikes.
  • Enhancing rep retention, sharpening deal execution skills, and managing performance against existing standards.
  • Ensuring tight coordination between sales reps, operational leaders, and implementation teams to maintain high client retention.

Skills & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Healthcare Management, or related field required; Master’s degree (MBA or MHA) preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive healthcare sales experience, with a deep understanding of RCM, medical billing, and healthtech solutions.
  • 5+ years of experience managing regional or national sales teams within a mature, fast-paced sales environment.
  • Proven ability to manage sales teams to predictable, consistent quota attainment in multi-million dollar business units.
  • In-depth knowledge of provider billing operations, revenue cycle workflows, claims processing, and denial management.
  • Strong capability in pipeline management, territory management, and executing established sales methodologies (e.g., Challenger, SPIN, Solution Selling).
  • Strong communication, presentation, and contract-negotiation skills with healthcare C-suite executives (CFOs, CEOs, Practice Executives).
  • Fluent in CRM systems (Salesforce), pipeline analytics, and sales enablement platforms.
  • Ability to travel domestically up to 30%

ModMed Benefits Highlight: At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

United States

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution,
  • 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep.
  • Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs,

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.


We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart®.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Regulatory Affairs Consultant - Advertising and Promotion (Manger, Ad Promo) to join a large dedicated client partnership while working from home in Canada. As a Senior Regulatory Affairs Consultant - Advertising and Promotion (Manger, Ad Promo), you will help ensure that promotional and relevant non-promotional materials are compliant and appropriate for their intended audiences. This position plays a key role in regulatory review, advertising compliance, and cross-functional decision-making. You'll collaborate with Marketing, Medical, Legal, and other partners, follow established review processes, and contribute to the efficient review and approval of materials. Responsibilities include reviewing Canadian promotional, educational, medical, and corporate communications against Health Canada advertising requirements, the Canadian Product Monograph, and applicable PAAB standards, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence material outcomes.


You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through regulatory review of Canadian materials, practical guidance on compliant messaging, and support for the Canadian adaptation of global materials. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Regulatory Affairs Consultant - Advertising and Promotion (Manger, Ad Promo) can explore career paths and expand skills across regulatory affairs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review Canadian promotional, educational, medical, and corporate communications for alignment with relevant regulatory requirements, approved product information, and industry standards.
  • Apply knowledge of Health Canada advertising requirements, the Canadian Product Monograph, and applicable PAAB standards in the assessment of materials.
  • Provide regulatory input on the overall content, messaging, and presentation of materials, identifying compliance considerations and recommending practical solutions.
  • Represent Canadian Regulatory Affairs in Promotional Material Review Team (PMRT) and Medical Review Committee (MRC) discussions, as applicable.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Medical, Legal, and other partners to facilitate efficient review and approval of materials through established internal processes.
  • Support the Canadian adaptation of global materials and provide guidance on questions related to promotional versus non-promotional communications.
  • Maintain alignment with Canadian Regulatory leadership and the broader Regulatory Ad Promo team and escalate significant regulatory concerns as appropriate.

Candidate Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in regulatory judgment, communication, and collaboration
  • Experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology Regulatory Affairs, with exposure to advertising and promotional review
  • The ability to collaborate across teams and provide clear, solutions-oriented recommendations
  • A commitment to ensuring materials are compliant and appropriate for their intended audiences
  • Comfort participating in cross-functional review processes and established internal approval processes

Required Qualifications

  • University degree in a scientific or health sciences discipline (e.g., Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biology, or Chemistry) or a related field
  • At least five years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology Regulatory Affairs, including at least two years of advertising and promotional review experience
  • Working knowledge of Canadian pharmaceutical advertising requirements, Health Canada guidance, and the PAAB Code, with experience participating in cross-functional material review
  • Strong regulatory judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, manage priorities, and provide clear, solutions-oriented recommendations

Preferred Qualifications

  • Additional education or certification in Regulatory Affairs is considered an asset
  • Experience with FDA advertising and promotion requirements

We offer a comprehensive benefits plan to eligible Canadian employees.


We offer competitive salaries based on several factors, including the position and level offered, skills, education, training, experience, professional achievements, and location.


Some roles may also be eligible for additional incentives, bonuses, or other compensation programs. Our Talent Acquisition team will provide details on applicable bonus plans or incentive structures for eligible positions.


If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!


We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

Openprovider is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology company founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

At Openprovider, we're not just a company; we're a mission-driven team dedicated to transforming the domain industry. We believe in providing a trusted digital identity to every business.

Our innovative approach is reshaping the industry from a traditional transactional model to a more customer-centric, subscription-based approach. We pay subscriptions for music, newspapers, and movies - why should domains be any different?

Our vision is to build a place where curious, self-driven people do their best work together, to deliver on our mission: a reliable, free, and secure online world for every customer we serve.   • Quality results in quantity: we care about excellence and attention to detail.

Come join us on our journey to create a trusted digital world.

about the role

Openprovider's domain portfolio is about far more than registrations. As our Product Manager for Domains & DNS, you will grow what we earn from it, while keeping compliance sound and our resellers' trust high.

You will report to our Director Product and work as part of the Domains squad, alongside Engineering, Domain Operations, Sales, Support, Marketing and Finance.

key responsibilities

  • Lead TLD integrations and accreditations end to end, using AI-led execution: build the business case, support registry contracting, deliver the technical integration, implement business policies and compliance, launch and hand over to Domain Operations, and migrate TLDs off upstream suppliers.

  • Maintain the integration roadmap, prioritised by domains under management at stake and margin uplift, and measure each migrated TLD's margin against its business case.

  • Own the aftermarket product, including reseller tooling that makes it easy for our resellers to list and sell names, and fast, reliable transfers after each sale.

  • Own parking monetisation for eligible domains, covering provider performance, page-content standards and reseller revenue share.

  • Run our expiring domains program (auctions, drop-catch, backorders, DAX), within each registry's rules and ICANN policy.

  • Act as product owner of the registry automation pipeline: own its requirements, roadmap and quality measurement, agreeing the roadmap with Domain Operations every quarter.

  • Support the Director Product and Lead PM on the reseller platform and module roadmaps through discovery and clear specifications for assigned items.

  • Equip Sales, Support and Marketing for every integration change, with a changelog, an internal FAQ and a Support briefing for each release.

  • Take an active part in agile delivery: grooming, sprint planning, stand-ups and retros for the Domains squad, keeping your Jira items sprint-ready and accurate.

what we are looking for

What you bring

  • TLD and registry knowledge: you understand gTLD and ccTLD registry models, accreditation processes and regional policy specifics.

  • Domain systems and EPP: in-depth understanding of DNS, EPP and registry-side processes.

  • Domain policy literacy: you can apply ICANN policies (ERRP, Transfer Policy, DNS abuse obligations) and registry-specific expiry rules to product design.

  • Aftermarket and monetization economics: you understand marketplace dynamics, parking yield, auction mechanics and reseller revenue-share models.

  • Requirements and specifications: you write clear PRDs, acceptance criteria and bug reports.

  • Agile delivery and documentation: you are proficient in Jira and Confluence and comfortable running grooming sessions. Experience with EOS is a plus.

  • Analytical thinking: you are comfortable with quantitative and qualitative analysis, break down complex problems and report clearly on results.

  • Stakeholder management: you manage registries externally and Sales, Support and Finance internally, aligning priorities and expectations.

  • AI proficiency: you use AI tools every day and can build AI workflows for documentation and analysis.

  • Clear communication: you explain complex topics in a structured way to both technical and non-technical audiences.


How we work at Openprovider

  • Self-management: you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.

  • Learning Agility and AI Literacy: you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.

  • Adaptive Innovation Mindset: you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.

  • Quality Orientation: you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.

  • Customer Focus: you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.

what we offer

  • 100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);

  • Paid time off and sick leave;

  • International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;

  • Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;

  • Quarterly review and annual salary review;

  • Flexible working hours;

  • We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;

  • Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;

  • Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;

  • A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on Partnerships & BD expert to grow our banking, deposits, and investing partners, and to bring on the ones we haven't met yet. Most of the job, roughly 70 to 80 percent, is growing the partners we already have: bigger budgets, better economics, broader distribution. The rest is net new, mostly warm, with real outreach on the investing side where the relationships don't exist yet.

You'll work alongside our Head of Partnerships, who will continue to focus on our largest strategic partners. On those strategic partners, you'll run the operations. Across the rest of banking, deposits, and investing, you own it fully, operationally and strategically. That's what gives the Head of Partnerships room for the biggest bets, and it's what makes this seat yours.

This isn't a support role, and it isn't customer service. The job is to grow relationships, not just service them.

WHY THIS SEAT

  • A category to own. Banking, deposits, and investing partners outside our largest strategic accounts are yours, start to finish.
  • A partner, not a handoff. Our Head of Partnerships works closely alongside you for your first 90 days, and the goal is full independence by about day 120.
  • Room to shape it. You'll inherit real momentum, but the strategy in these categories is still being written, and you'll help write it.
  • Close to the media. You'll connect what partners need to placements across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network, which is where a good partnership becomes an extraordinary one.
  • Direct exposure to senior leadership on the deals that matter.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Direct experience on the advertiser side of a financial comparison publisher, marketplace, or performance network, managing bank, deposit, or investing partners.
  • A record of growing accounts, not just servicing them. You can walk through a partner whose budget you grew and what moved it.
  • Sales DNA. You open doors and close. Warm relationships are most of it, but you're comfortable with cold outreach, especially to investing apps.
  • Ownership of the details. URL approvals, budget changes, CPA moves, placement and widget coordination: you run them yourself and nothing drops.
  • You figure it out without being pushed, and you pull in account management, product, media, analytics, compliance, legal, and finance to get it done.
  • Fluency in performance economics, including CPA, CPL, CPC, and revenue share, and the business acumen to use performance, revenue, and unit-economic data in a negotiation.
  • Strong communication, relationship building, and negotiation across several partners and opportunities at once.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Publisher experience, or enough of the language to hold the conversation.
  • Experience in wealth management, financial advisory, RIAs, or advisor networks.
  • Existing relationships with banks, fintech companies, investment platforms, or related financial-services companies.
  • Experience selling customer acquisition, media, lead generation, or performance-based marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Existing partners

  • Budget growth, better unit economics, broader product coverage, and a bigger share of wallet with the partners you own.
  • The operations on our largest strategic banking partners, alongside the Head of Partnerships.
  • Partner operations from onboarding through campaign management, reporting, issue resolution, and optimization.
  • Proposals that connect a partner's goals to placements, audiences, and distribution across FinanceBuzz and our publisher network.
  • Accurate pipeline, forecasts, partner updates, and next steps.
  • Launch Potato's presence at industry events and partner meetings.

New partners

  • A pipeline across banking, deposits, investing, and wealth.
  • Reaching the right decision makers through relationships, referrals, events, and outbound.
  • Partner conversations from first outreach through pitch, deal negotiation, contracting, and launch.
  • A clear read on each partner's growth goals, economics, products, and target customers.

WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

  • First 90 days: you're learning the book side by side with the Head of Partnerships and running operations on the partners you'll own.
  • By about day 120: you run your partners independently.
  • By month 6: you're directing internal traffic and connecting partner activity to media opportunity.
  • Year one: larger budgets and stronger economics across existing partners, new banks and investing advertisers live, and the Head of Partnerships focused on our largest, most strategic deals.

THIS ISN'T THE RIGHT SEAT IF YOU

  • Want to hunt, close, and hand the account to someone else.
  • Want someone else to own the operations.
  • Need a playbook handed to you before you move.
  • Would rather service an account than grow it.

TOTAL COMPENSATION

  • Base: $150,000 to $170,000, set by level and expertise based on initial interviews.
  • Annual Bonus: company EBITDA plus personal performance. No commission.

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We are looking for someone with 4+ years of relevant experience who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in the day-to-day operations of a growing supplements business.

Marketplace Operations & Catalog Management

raw.description:
Job Summary:

You will build the AI runtime, retrieval, guardrails, and evaluation that make the platform's AI features work in production - with cost, latency, and safety treated as first-class engineering constraints. We build on proven commercial models and win on integration, domain knowledge, and evaluation discipline.

You'll report to the Head of AI Platform Engineering and join a small, senior founding team building the platform from the ground up.

The opportunity: ship AI that customers depend on daily in mission-critical workflows - not demos.

Job Description:

Why This Role Is Different

  • Applied, not research. We use proven commercial models and win on integration, retrieval, orchestration and safety validation. Fine-tuning is an optional track, not the goal.
  • Domain-first, not tech-first. Domain knowledge, delivered through retrieval and evaluation, is the moat, not model weights. You will invest early in your customers' domain.
  • Production-first. We ship AI that customers depend on daily. Demos don't count; reliability, cost and safety do.
  • Platform and product. You will build reusable AI capability while enabling products to ship features fast.
  • A founding role. As a found
  • ing AI hire, you will set the patterns and evaluation discipline the team adopts, and help hire the team.
  • Value-based. You will validate with product teams and customers and prioritise by value, building what moves outcomes rather than what is novel.

What You'll Do

AI Runtime and Orchestration

  • Build and operate the runtime, tool calling and orchestration for production agent workflows.
  • Design model selection and tiering, with cost and latency as first-class constraints.
  • Implement and tune retrieval (RAG) and grounding where it measurably improves quality.

Evaluation, Safety and Quality

  • Stand up evaluation harnesses and golden sets, and use them to make ship or no-ship calls and to catch regressions and drift.
  • Design and implement evaluation frameworks for model and agent quality.
  • Build guardrails and safety controls, treating retrieved content and tool outputs as untrusted.

Production Ownership

  • Own the production behaviour of what you ship, including latency, cost, reliability and failure modes.
  • Partner with product to decide when an agent is, and is not, the right tool.

Delivering Value with Product and Customers

  • Work with product teams and customers to validate results and outcomes, prioritising by value.
  • Take a value-based development approach: prove value with the smallest useful slice, then scale what works.
  • Instrument and measure impact, letting evidence rather than opinion drive what ships.
  • Build automated QA, including tests, quality gates and regression checks, into the delivery pipeline.

Building the Team and Ways of Working

  • Help build the team by setting evaluation and safety patterns others adopt, raising the bar in interviews and mentoring.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession and pragmatic shipping.
  • Partner with product teams across the portfolio who own their own roadmaps.

What You'll Bring

We look at demonstrated experience and scope, not years served, and we don't expect every candidate to tick every box.

  • Production AI: You have shipped software backed by LLMs or ML to real production users, beyond demos and notebooks.
  • Evaluation over vibes: You reason about evaluation, not just prompting.
  • Cost and latency: You treat cost and latency as design constraints from the start.
  • Clear communication: You explain your thinking clearly to engineers, product partners and customers, and bring people along.
  • Value and pragmatism: You focus on outcomes and value, and make pragmatic calls to ship.

Bonus Points

Any of these strengthen an application; none are required.

  • Agents in production: Agent or RAG systems in production, and the failure modes that come with them.
  • Routing and cost wins: Model routing or measurable cost reduction.
  • Calibrated evaluation: Evaluation harnesses driving decisions; LLM-as-judge calibrated against humans.
  • Optimisation track: Fine-tuning or distillation.
  • Judgement: Knowing when not to use an agent.
  • Languages: Strength in Python or C#/.NET.
  • Semantic data: Experience grounding AI in structured, well-modelled business data.
  • Architecture: System and platform design, and trade-off judgement such as one-way versus two-way doors.
  • Enterprise scale: Experience building or operating enterprise-scale software, and its reliability, security and integration demands.
  • AI-assisted engineering: You use AI coding assistants productively and supervise their output with judgement.

New to some of this? If you bring the essentials above and are excited by the problem, we'd still like to hear from you.

• Represent the MSL team in interactions with senior leadership and clearly articulate the impact of the Field Medical team

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a strong collaborator with these qualifications

OR

  • Maintains tracking of safety submissions
  • Fosters constructive and professional working relationships with all project team members, internal and external

  • Files documents according to project specific requirements (electronically or in hard copy as applicable)
  • Forwards completed safety submission documents to clients and other relevant parties
  • Provides support with miscellaneous project tasks related to safety reporting
  • Maintains an understanding and compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), global drug/biologic/device regulations, GCPs, ICH guidelines, and the drug development process

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s Degree in life science, registered nurse, pharmacist or an equivalent combination of education and experience that gives the individual the necessary knowledge, skills and abilities to perform the job.
  • Safety and Pharmacovigilance experience preferred
  • Safety Database systems and moderate medical terminology preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel and PowerPoint), Visio, email (Outlook),TeamShare (or other management/shared content/workspace) and internet.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment
  • Ability to successfully prioritize and work on multiple tasks
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both written and spoken
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills
  • Detailed oriented with a high degree of accuracy and ability to meet deadlines
  • Good knowledge of ICH guidelines and regulations relating to Safety and Pharmacovigilance
  • Able to make effective decisions
  • Manage multiple priorities

raw.excerpt: About the job Private Equity Growth Platform has an exciting opportunity for a Sr.
raw.description:
About the job
Private Equity Growth Platform has an exciting opportunity for a Sr. Associate, Corporate Development. This position reports to Chief Growth Officer and serves an integral part of the M&A deal process, as well as supporting the external development activity and market strategy development.

Role Overview

The Senior Associate of Business Development will play a key role in driving corporate growth through mergers, acquisitions, and strategic partnerships. This position focuses on the execution of the deal pipeline, financial data gathering, market analysis, and building relationships with prospective partners. The ideal candidate possesses deep experience in specialty medical practice M&A alongside a broader background in healthcare M&A transaction execution.
This is a remote, work-from-home position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Deal Sourcing & Relationship Development
  • Build Relationships: Develop trust and maintain deep relationships with physician practice owners, brokers, bankers, and industry advisors.
  • Partner with Leadership: Partner closely with physician dyad leaders to ensure alignment, credibility, and consistent communication with potential sellers.
  • Represent the Organization: Travel to target practices to present the company’s value proposition and assess cultural, operational, and strategic fit.

Pipeline Management & Deal Evaluation
  • Manage the Pipeline: Track and manage a disciplined sourcing pipeline from initial outreach and data gathering through to Letter of Intent (LOI).
  • Assess Value Drivers: Demonstrate a thorough understanding of value drivers at both the physician practice and surgical center levels.
  • Profile Markets: Create detailed market profiles and strategic recommendations for target regions.
  • Build Materials: Prepare external pitch decks, investment summaries, and transaction materials for executive leadership and in-person pitches.

Financial Modeling & Transaction Support
  • Gather Financial Data: Collect baseline financial and operational data to support pro forma financial modeling for M&As and de novo projects.
  • Inform Modeling Assumptions: Provide key modeling assumptions based on growth projections and collaborate with stakeholders to validate pro forma outputs.
  • Progress Deal Materials: Drive the progression of deal modeling, transaction structuring, and due diligence materials into underwriting and completion.
  • Support Negotiations: Participate in and help lead deal negotiations, providing accurate transaction details and summaries to enterprise stakeholders to inform financial decisions.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate with internal stakeholders (finance, operations, clinical leadership, legal) to maintain momentum through signing, closing, and transition.

Leadership & Team Culture
  • Mentor Analysts: Oversee the work product of Analysts to ensure financial projections are accurate for specific deal structures, acting as a behavioral role model.
  • Foster Culture & Integrity: Positively contribute to the team culture and conduct all business matters with the highest degree of integrity.
  • Maintain Compliance: Understand healthcare compliance-related issues and proactively raise risks to appropriate company stakeholders in a timely manner.

Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree required; Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience: 5–7 years of experience in M&A investment banking, corporate development, accounting, transaction advisory, or healthcare consulting.
  • M&A Expertise: Proven, hands-on experience in specialty medical practice M&A as well as general healthcare sector M&A.
  • Technical Skills: Mastery of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; strong ability to synthesize complex data into a clear investment thesis.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting financial sections and detailed analyses to clinical practice boards and stakeholders.
  • Travel: Ability to travel independently up to 25% as needed.
This is a remote work from home position in the United States
