title: Area Vice President, Sales - Central / West
description: The Calix platform enables Communication Service Providers (CSPs) of all sizes to transform and future-proof their businesses.

raw.title: Area Vice President, Sales - Central / West
raw.excerpt: The Calix platform enables Communication Service Providers (CSPs) of all sizes to transform and future-proof their businesses.
raw.description:
The Calix platform enables Communication Service Providers (CSPs) of all sizes to transform and future-proof their businesses. Through real-time data, automation, and actionable insights delivered via Calix One — our cloud-first, AI-powered platform — CSPs can simplify operations, collapse cost, and accelerate innovation. Calix One brings together the automation of everything and the experience of one, empowering customers to deliver differentiated subscriber experiences while driving acquisition, loyalty, and revenue growth. This is the Calix mission: to enable CSPs of all sizes to simplify, innovate, and grow, strengthening both their businesses and the communities they serve.

We’re at the forefront of a once in a generational change in the broadband industry. Join us as we innovate, help our customers reach their potential, and connect underserved communities with unrivaled digital experiences.

We are seeking a proven sales leader to guide a team of high-performing Sales Managers to record sales and customer success.


This is a remote position that can be based anywhere in the Central / Western part of the United States.


Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Lead a region consisting of multiple territories in the Central / Western US focused on our Tier 3 customers.
  • Support and drive sales to new and established Calix customers.
  • Coach, lead, develop and drive accountability across a sales team and cross-functional teams.
  • Lead a sales team in strategic process bases selling within a highly matrixed team selling environment.
  • Engage with cross-functional teams to collaborate on strategy, forecasting, execution, and debriefing to drive top performance.
  • Must have a strong financial acumen to drive KPI’s tied to financial outcomes both within the sales process to customers and internal business performance.
  • Develop and support the business processes around forecasting, whitespace, competitive strategies, partnerships, tracking, and reporting.
  • Ability to use AI to strengthen and streamline day-to-day processes, strategies, and organizational structure.
  • Manage the day-to-day and week-to-week operations of the sales team.
  • Strong communication up and down the corporate structure is essential
  • Ensure sales’ best practices are brought to bear to support high velocity, high-quality sales performance.
  • Bring your sales leadership experience to the team as you coach, develop and support their growth as sales professionals.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of sales leadership experience.
  • Track record of leading teams to over-quota achievement (top 10-20% of companies) in past positions.
  • In-depth understanding of Broadband Service Provider business, networking, SaaS, and business software applications.
  • Experience managing the sales cycle from business champion to the CEO/CFO/CMO level.
  • 10+ years of quota carrying technology sales
  • Experience managing and closing complex sales cycles, demonstrating ownership of all aspects of territory management.
  • Candidates must be competitive, cooperative, collaborative, and work well with customers both internal and external.
  • Strong computer skills, including salesforce.com, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Travel expectations: 50%

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in managing or selling to Broadband Service Providers, PE backed companies, and COOPs.
  • Previous Sales Methodology training, CRM experience, and strong customer references preferred.
  • Bachelor and/or Master’s degree preferred.

Location:

  • Remote position in the Central / Western United States


The on-target earnings for this position varies based on the geographic location. More information about the pay range specific to candidate location and other factors will be shared during the recruitment process. Individual pay is determined based on location of residence and multiple factors, including job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

San Francisco Bay Area:

372,000 - 595,000 USD Annual

Select US Metros and States:

323,000 - 517,000 USD Annual

Other US Locations:

291,000 - 466,000 USD Annual

raw.description:
Your Impact

This role keeps customers moving by providing top level technical support, troubleshooting, and clear documentation across CivicPlus products and integrations. You will also train and mentor colleagues, lead projects, and bring recurring issues to the teams that can resolve them. Your work helps ensure successful outcomes for the customers we serve.

About CivicPlus

At CivicPlus, we strive to bring our company vision to life through innovation and collaboration. Supported by approachable leadership and transparent communication, we’re empowered to make an impact on local government and the residents they serve. Grow your career alongside great people, where authenticity is welcome, successes are celebrated, and potential is nurtured.

What You’ll Do

As a Technical Support Engineer III, you will:

  • Provide top level technical support, service, mentorship, and training.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve customer issues with clear communication and thorough documentation.
  • Record all customer interactions with relevant details in ticketing software.
  • Build strong, effective working relationships with colleagues and customers.
  • Manage complex issues through in depth research, documentation, escalation, and collaboration with internal engineering teams.
  • Identify and advocate for trending issues, working with other teams to address high impact problems.
  • Expand your product knowledge across multiple CivicPlus products and integrations.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert.
  • Lead documentation on products, troubleshooting, and process best practices for staff and customers.
  • Consistently meet or exceed CivicPlus service level targets.
  • Train and mentor employees on troubleshooting, business processes, and product knowledge.
  • Lead and manage projects to ensure successful customer outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

We know that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the listed requirements, we encourage you to apply!

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and a proactive, self driven approach to solving problems independently.
  • Highly collaborative, with the ability to influence teams across the organization and build cooperation that drives shared success.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills that make technical information clear and create positive customer interactions.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL to troubleshoot and solve problems efficiently.
  • A customer focused mindset that anticipates needs and concerns and ensures a positive support experience.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple projects and deadlines through effective prioritization.
  • A drive to keep improving through training, personal growth, and feedback.
  • Technology degree or equivalent experience.
  • Ability to work through ambiguity with resilience and adaptability.
  • AI-forward mindset with a demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, and work quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively use AI tools to enhance productivity and outcomes.

Why CivicPlus?

This role offers:

  • The chance to grow into a subject matter expert across multiple CivicPlus products and integrations.
  • The opportunity to lead documentation and process best practices that shape how staff and customers work with our products.
  • A path to mentor and train teammates while leading projects that drive customer success.
  • Partnership with engineering and other teams to get the issues that matter most resolved.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Estimated Salary Grade: $26.00 - $36.39
    • The Anticipated Hiring Range: $27.00 - $30.00
    • The actual offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and is based on a 40-hour work week.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, Flexible Time Off, 401(k) plan, and more.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Introductory call with Talent Acquisition
  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager
  3. Panel Interview with CivicPlus team members, including an interview project activity
  4. Offer

Note: The process may vary slightly depending on the role.

Additional Information

  • CivicPlus is currently unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US.
  • We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the posting may close earlier at the discretion of the Talent Acquisition team.
  • At CivicPlus, we embrace AI and automation as tools that help people work smarter, move faster, and focus on higher-value work that strengthens communities. We encourage thoughtful, responsible use of technology to improve efficiency, support innovation, and enhance the employee and customer experience—while keeping human judgment, collaboration, and accountability at the center of what we do.

Equal Opportunity Commitment

CivicPlus is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We celebrate and support diversity for the benefit of our employees, products, clients, and communities. Reasonable accommodations are available during the interview process.

raw.description:
Join our team and build your career with momentum as we champion your growth, elevate your ideas and engage you in purpose-driven work that makes a real difference every day.


Who we are

Founded in 1997, Merrick Bank is an FDIC®-insured financial institution headquartered in South Jordan, Utah, with over $10 billion in assets. A wholly owned subsidiary of CardWorks Financial Group, Merrick Bank serves roughly five million cardmembers and more than 100,000 merchant customers nationwide.


What we do

We provide credit cards, recreational loans, deposit accounts, merchant services and bank sponsorships to consumers and businesses. As a leader in non-prime lending and merchant acquiring, we combine innovative technology with data-driven insights to help underserved consumers build and strengthen credit while delivering integrated, scalable payment solutions for businesses.

Merrick Bank ranks among the top 20 FDIC®-insured credit card issuers in the U.S. and among the top 15 merchant acquirers by transaction volume.

Position Summary and Role Impact:
The Enterprise Risk Management (“ERM”) team is responsible for implementing the risk governance program, risk oversight, and to provide an independent view of risks faced by CardWorks, its clients and their customers.


The Third-Party Risk Analyst II supports the overall direction of Third-Party Risk Management (“TPRM”) activities by identifying and assessing potential risks with current and potential third parties.

Essential Functions:

  • Identify and assess potential risks in current and potential third parties and provide written summaries of findings (background checks, legal cases, business reports, complaints, news, internet searches, etc.).
  • Assist in the oversight/ coordination of third-party risk management and the respective oversight and performance assessments.
  • Work with the vendor relationship owners throughout the organization for current and potential third parties to obtain necessary information for risk assessments (financials, audit reports, questionnaires, policies, etc.).
  • Assess, in writing, key risks that may arise from the Company’s outsourced activities and options for controlling these risks.
  • Assist in preparing TPRM reporting for management and committees, including board of directors.
  • Identify issues and make recommendations for improving the assessment/coordination process.
  • Adjust processes to adhere to changes in the regulatory environment.
  • Create and maintain operational procedures for TPRM processes.
  • Escalate suspected violations of law, regulations, or non-compliance with Company policies.
  • Adherence to the Company’s internal controls policies and procedures.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by VP of Enterprise Risk Management and/or reporting manager.

Requirements for Success:

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field required; or four (4) years of related work experience accepted in lieu of education
  • Two (2) years of related experience in Third-Party Risk Management
  • Additional experience with risk, audit or internal control monitoring experience preferred
  • undefined
  • Must possess strong analytical skills, system skills, and writing/ communication skills
  • GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) system experience preferable (Archer experience a plus)
  • Experience with Microsoft applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Visio)
  • Industry experience and general knowledge of third-party risk management
  • Demonstrate an ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships at all levels within the organization
  • Effective planning, time management, attention to detail, customer service, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure. Skilled at handling a variety of assignments simultaneously. Flexibility and willingness to work at a rapid pace under strict time frames.

Compliance with Laws & Regulations

  • Responsible for complying with all the Bank’s internal control policies and procedures.
  • Responsible for understanding and complying with all laws and regulations to which the Bank is subject.
  • Responsible for communicating problems in operations, noncompliance with the code of conduct, noncompliance with laws and regulations, policy violations, or illegal acts.

Why join us

We believe in putting people first by supporting our customers, employees and our partners while creating opportunities for everyone to reach their potential. From fostering work-life balance to rewarding good work and innovative ideas, we invest in what matters most, our people.

At Merrick Bank, you’ll be part of a collaborative, customer-focused team where you can grow your career while making a meaningful impact.


Our Employee Value Proposition

  • Competitive Pay, including a Bonus Target or Variable Pay Incentive Program
  • Benefits Package -Medical, Dental, and Vision (plus much more)
  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match
  • Short- & Long-Term Disability
  • Wellness Programs
  • Group Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Paid Vacation, Sick Days and bank Holidays
  • Employee Engagement Activities including Employee Appreciation Day, DEI Employee Resource Groups, Corporate Social Responsibility, Service Recognition

We offer a total rewards package comprised of a competitive base rate of pay, variable pay incentive programs based on the role, and a comprehensive benefit suite.  Offered rates of pay are determined based on job-related knowledge, relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.


We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to age, race, color, sex, or gender identity/expression (including pregnancy, childbirth, transgender status, or sexual orientation), religion or creed, ancestry, citizenship, national origin, disability, military or veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We do not tolerate discrimination, harassment, or retaliation. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. Everyone is welcome here, and we hire based on your ability to do the job, not any protected characteristics.

raw.title: Creative Director
raw.excerpt: About Us! At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life.
raw.description:
About Us!

At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life. For this opportunity, we’re proud to collaborate with the team at Fivestone Studios to find the unicorn, the one who will truly make a difference. Together, we ensure a smooth and human-centered hiring experience that reflects the studio’s vision.

About Fivestone Studios!

Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and make heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.

Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.

Your Mission

We are looking for an experienced Creative Director to lead the creative vision and experience design of immersive, interactive, and technology-driven projects, from initial concept through to final delivery.

This role calls for a senior creative leader with a strong foundation in visual design and art direction, combined with expertise in experience strategy, UX, storytelling, content production, and creative technology.

You will shape compelling user and audience experiences, establish distinctive creative directions, and ensure creative consistency across multidisciplinary productions.

We are particularly interested in someone who is hands-on in visual development, capable of personally creating initial concepts, treatments, and style frames, while directing sophisticated content production and maintaining creative oversight throughout the entire project lifecycle.

You will collaborate closely with creative leadership, producers, designers, content strategists, creative technologists, developers, and other multidisciplinary teams to align creative vision with experience design, technical feasibility, and production requirements. You will also work with clients and stakeholders to translate their objectives and feedback into cohesive, high-quality experiences.

PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.

Key Responsibilities

1. Experience Strategy & Design

  • Define the overall experience vision, creative premise and guiding principles.

  • Translate client objectives and audience needs into compelling, intuitive and engaging experiences.

  • Shape user journeys, interaction models and experience principles, considering usability, accessibility and context.

  • Identify opportunities to make experiences distinctive, meaningful and memorable.

2. Creative & Art Direction

  • Lead the creative direction across projects, defining the visual language, tone and overall approach.

  • Develop and present concepts, mood boards, visual references and creative treatments.

  • Direct visual design, motion, animation, content and storytelling to ensure a cohesive creative vision.

  • Maintain creative consistency and quality across all outputs and disciplines.

3. Creative Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead and guide multidisciplinary creative teams, providing clear direction, feedback and creative decisions.

  • Work closely with UX/UI Designers, Content Strategists, Creative Technologists, Developers, Animators, 3D Artists, Sound Designers and Producers.

  • Encourage collaboration, experimentation and creative problem-solving.

  • Ensure all disciplines remain aligned with the agreed creative vision and quality expectations.

4. Technology & Production Collaboration

  • Work closely with Creative Technology and Production teams to ensure concepts are technically and operationally achievable.

  • Understand relevant technologies, platforms and physical environments, recognising their opportunities and limitations.

  • Balance creative ambition with technical feasibility, scope, budget and schedule.

  • Identify potential constraints early and develop creative solutions without compromising the core experience.

5. Creative Oversight & Delivery

  • Maintain creative oversight from concept development through to final delivery.

  • Review designs, prototypes and integrated experiences, providing clear and constructive feedback.

  • Make timely creative decisions and guide adaptations throughout development and production.

  • Identify and resolve creative and experience-related issues, ensuring the final work maintains the quality, coherence and intent of the approved vision.

Requirements

Your Journey

Must Have

  • Experience: developing immersive and interactive experiences across physical and digital environments.

  • Senior Creative Direction Experience: Extensive experience leading the creative vision and execution of multidisciplinary projects from concept through final delivery.

  • Visual Design & Art Direction: Strong artistic foundation with the ability to independently establish visual direction and create initial concepts, treatments and style frames.

  • Experience Design: Proven expertise in shaping engaging user and audience experiences, including experience strategy, UX and interaction design.

  • Content Production: Demonstrated experience directing sophisticated and technically complex content production across animation, game engines, film, UI and interactive experiences.

  • End-to-End Creative Ownership: Ability to maintain creative leadership and involvement throughout development and production, ensuring the final experience reflects the approved creative vision.

  • Multidisciplinary Leadership: Experience guiding creative teams across visual design, motion, animation, content, UX/UI, 3D and creative technology.

  • Creative Technology Understanding: Strong understanding of technology-driven experiences, including technical possibilities, limitations and integration considerations.

  • Production Awareness: Ability to balance creative ambition with technical feasibility, production constraints, budgets and schedules.

  • Creative Communication: Ability to present concepts, communicate artistic direction, provide constructive feedback and collaborate effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams.

Job Description

We are seeking detail-oriented Imagery Analysts and Annotators to support a Navy project involving drone and maritime sensor imagery.

In this role, you will review machine-generated object labels, correct inaccurate bounding boxes, and identify objects that have been missed. The work requires precision, consistency, and the ability to maintain accuracy during repetitive annotation tasks.

No prior AI experience is required. However, U.S. citizenship and an active Department of Defense (DoD) Common Access Card (CAC) are mandatory for this project.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review machine-generated bounding boxes on still images and correct inaccurate labels.
  • Identify and annotate objects that have been missed by the model.
  • Apply labeling guidelines consistently across all assigned images.
  • Work within a secure Navy environment using the provided tools.
  • Maintain steady productivity and accuracy throughout annotation tasks.
  • Flag ambiguous cases for review rather than making assumptions.
  • Support video frame annotation as the project expands.

Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship.
  • Active DoD Common Access Card (CAC) – mandatory.
  • Strong attention to detail and patience for repetitive, accuracy-critical work.
  • Ability to learn and use new annotation software.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

raw.excerpt: At Evolve, we’re on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone.
raw.description:
At Evolve, we’re on a mission to make vacation rental easy for everyone. Our high-performing, customer-obsessed team runs on curiosity, communication, and accountability—working together to create exceptional experiences for our owners and guests. Whether solving big challenges, delivering outstanding results, or celebrating wins, we approach every day with purpose and passion. If you’re ready to join a mission-driven company where every teammate has the opportunity to thrive, Evolve might just be the place for you.

Why this role

Evolve is the largest tech-enabled vacation rental management company in North America, and evolve.com is our consumer marketplace. We are hiring a Senior Product Designer to own how travelers find, trust and book a stay with us.

You will lead product design across our direct booking surfaces: search, dynamic pricing, mobile checkout, promotions, and AI trip planning. You will collaborate in a dedicated pod: a PM, two full-stack engineers, and analytics all focused on evolve.com. If you are a hypothesis-driven e-commerce designer who balances customer trust and visual craft with conversion lift and works AI-native, come build with us.

What you’ll do

  • Design the Booking Funnel: Own the evolve.com path-to-purchase—search, listing pages, and checkout.
  • Search & Inventory Discovery: Shape intuitive search, filtering, and recommendation and Ai trip planning patterns that help travelers quickly find the ideal home or discover suitable alternatives.
  • High-Consideration Purchase UX: Design clear pricing architecture, fee structures, and value propositions that build guest confidence and reduce purchase anxiety.
  • Mobile Commerce: Optimize the end-to-end transaction flow on mobile web, prioritizing speed, clarity, and timely support at critical moments of hesitation.
  • Retention & Re-Engagement: Design high-leverage touchpoints across the guest lifecycle, including promotional incentives, cart recovery flows, referrals, and repeat-stay loops.
  • Hypothesis-Driven Experimentation: Collaborate with your pod to rapidly prototype, launch A/B tests, and make decisions grounded in data.
  • Solve from First Principles: Dig into funnel drop-offs, user research, and unit economics to uncover the root causes of friction and prioritize solutions by business impact.

What makes you a great fit

  • 7+ years of Product Design experience with a strong portfolio of high-consideration consumer e-commerce, travel/hospitality or marketplace experiences that drove measurable revenue or conversion lift.
  • Conversion Without Sacrificing Craft: You understand consumer purchasing psychology and can explain why a high performing page you built works.
  • A Builder Skillset: Mastery of visual design, interaction design, responsive design, and web performance paired with a comfort working fast and iterating in real time alongside engineers and PMs.
  • A Builder Tech Stack: You are already working in AI workflows and able to implement your prototypes.
  • Experimental Rigor: Complete comfort using quantitative data (funnel metrics, A/B testing, product analytics) and qualitative insights to validate hypotheses and design decisions.
  • High-Performance Mindset: You are customer-obsessed and embrace a growth mindset.

Compensation

For this role our salary range is $141,000 to $184,000, depending on relevant experience. This role will also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on both company and individual performance. Compensation for this role may vary to reflect local market conditions.

Location

All Evolve team members must live in one of our approved locations by their first day. We can hire from anywhere in the U.S. except D.C. and Hawaii. Some positions may also have restrictions based on compensation in the following states: California, Maryland, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, and Washington. If you live in Colorado, you can work remotely anywhere in the state, at our downtown Denver office, or a hybrid of both! If you're planning to move soon, please let us know, and we'll be happy to review your application again.

California Applicant Privacy Policy | Evolve

How we reward Evolvers

We’re intentional about offering benefits that empower every Evolver to thrive both professionally and personally because they’re more than perks—they’re investments in our customer-obsessed, high-performing team.

We believe in treating others as they want to be treated, providing benefits that deliver real value, and challenging the status quo to meet the diverse needs of our team. Whether it’s helping you take care of your health, plan for the future, or celebrate life’s milestones, our offerings are designed to support you every step of the way.

  • Financial Wellness: Industry-competitive pay, equity in the company, and a 401(k) with a 4% immediate vesting match.
  • Family Support: 16-18 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 10 weeks for non-birthing parents, plus infertility coverage.
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, with 100% employer-paid dental and vision for individual coverage, a low-cost medical option, 10 free mental health visits, and pet insurance.
  • Time to Recharge: Generous PTO, RTO (for full-time exempt employees), sick leave, holidays, and a personal holiday to celebrate what matters most to you.
  • Travel Perks: Annual Evolve travel credit after one year and discounts on stays at all Evolve properties.
  • Growth Opportunities: World-class onboarding programs, learning, and development resources to help you grow your impact.
  • Connection: Employee Resource Groups celebrating our diverse communities at Evolve.

How we work together

With our core values as our guide, every Evolver helps shape the company we want to work for and the people we want to be. We’ve cultivated a culture of collaboration, care, and responsibility that we can all be proud of, and we’re excited to see what you’ll bring as your authentic self.

Still curious about who we are and what we do? Read more about our business and our culture at .

EEO

At Evolve, we are committed to diversity and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified candidates will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, military service or veteran status, physical or mental disability, or any other legally protected characteristic. Evolve participates in e-Verify for all positions.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please let your recruiter know.

raw.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As a Client Relationship Manager you’ll have the opportunity to define our customer’s experience by being an expert source of knowledge to your assigned accounts. You’ll work closely with our implementation, sales, and support teams to help ensure that questions and issues are resolved in a timely manner and plans are optimized to meet customer goals. You’ll own customer happiness by marrying effective responsiveness with thoughtful proactive touch-points to anticipate customer needs before they ask.

What you get to do every day

  • Act as the single point of contact for the plan sponsors within your book of accounts
  • Provide timely, superior customer service, including problem solving and issue resolution
  • Communicate key plan features and requirements in a clear, concise and informative manner
  • Work cross-functionally to provide compliant and accurate valuation reports, participant statements, trust accounting, annual testing and reporting as applicable
  • Act as the voice of your customers by partnering with our marketing and product teams to share insights
  • Be the escalation point for any participants of your assigned plans
  • Assist clients with all ongoing plan design and document support, including understanding their responsibilities with IRS and Department of Labor regulations
  • Assist clients in meeting all IRS and Department of Labor deadlines necessary for qualified retirement plan
  • Maintain up-to date knowledge of present legislation and proposed legislative changes with regard to ERISA law through self-study and company-sponsored training sessions
  • Review or perform, as needed, the annual testing for plans, including ADP/ACP, Top Heavy, 410(b), 415, 401(a)(4),deductibility, and 402(g)
  • Review Form 5500 and coordinate with plan sponsor to help ensure timely filing
  • Assist auditors if a plan is subject to an audit
  • Assist IRS and DOL auditors, if the plan is subject to an IRS or DOL audit

What you bring to the role

  • 3-5+ years of experience in A-Z plan administration
  • Have a passion for solving problems and helping people
  • Strong ability to troubleshoot with a meticulous eye for detail
  • Communicate with confidence, professionalism and empathy
  • Remain composed in high-stress situations and convey empathy for our customers and their situation
  • Ability to work autonomously and take initiative to proactively service customers and resolve any issues
  • A “change is good” mindset allowing you to quickly adapt within a fast-growing startup environment
  • Bonus Points: Experience with FT William and/or ASC software systems

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. We take into account the cost of labor for each position in various markets across the U.S. The base salary for this position spans $70,000 - $75,000 annuallyand represents the minimum in our lowest geographic region to a maximumin our highest geographic region. The salary we offer to a new employee within this range is based on their location within the U.S., their relevant job-related skills, and experience. At Human Interest, base salary is one component of the overall total rewards package. Depending on the position, additional compensation components such as bonuses, commissions, and equity may be offered. All of our employees are offered a robust suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. In compliance with applicable laws, we do not inquire about salary history, or about criminal history prior to a conditional offer of employment.

Benefits -

  • A great 401(k) plan: Our own! Our 401(k) includes a dollar-for-dollar employer match up to 4% of compensation (immediately vested) and $0 plan fees
  • Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance
  • Competitive time off and parental leave
  • Addition Wealth: Unlimited access to digital tools, financial professionals, and a knowledge center to help you understand your equity and support your financial wellness
  • Lyra: Enhanced Mental Health Support for Employees and dependents

  • Monthly work-from-home stipend; quarterly lifestyle stipend
  • Engaging team-building experiences, ranging from virtual social events to team offsites, promoting collaboration and camaraderie.

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

  • Certified as a Great Place To Work® (2023-2025)
  • Fortune Best Place to Work in the Bay Area (2024)
  • Best Places to Work by Built In (2023-2024)
  • America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes (2020-2022, 2024)
  • A Top Company by Y Combinator (2020-2023)
  • Inc. Fastest Growing Companies (2021)

At Bishop Fox, security isn't just a job—it's our passion. As leaders in continuous offensive security and penetration testing, we deliver world-class customer experiences. Trusted by over a quarter of the Fortune 100, half of the Fortune 10, and top global media companies, we help safeguard digital landscapes. Our Cosmos platform, honored as Best Emerging Technology by SC Media, exemplifies our commitment to innovation.  

Joining Bishop Fox means collaborating with a curious and dedicated team. You'll tackle complex challenges for some of the world's most recognized organizations, securing their networks against real-world threats. With nearly 20 years of industry contributions—including 16 open-source tools and 50 security advisories published in the past five years—we're committed to making the digital world safer. 

We’re seeking remote, US or Mexico-based hacking professionals focused on red teaming to join our team – and help us build a more secure world. 

Who You Are and What You’ll Do

You are a born red teamer; you see problems and solutions in everything. You instinctively know your way around source code. You’ve plundered apps and pillaged networks (legally, of course). You have a passion for hacking that goes beyond a career – it’s a way of life for you. At this point, you may have accumulated a few disclosures, written blog posts, and given some industry talks. 

With Bishop Fox you’ll be running red teaming engagements, starting with research and including profiling organizations, defining attack objectives and crafting attack tree graphs and other key planning efforts. You will then perform operations based on planning to achieve the attack objectives through a variety of potential attack paths, including network, web applications, physical, social engineering, and others. You will help our customers understand their attack surface by communicating, ability to respond to incidents, report on steps taken, and issues discovered. Additionally, you’ll provide thoughtful, tailored, and actionable recommendations. 

As a senior-level consultant, you’ll solve challenging technical problems and build creative solutions in a client-facing role. As a trusted advisor, you’ll provide your expert opinion to help our clients navigate difficult business decisions including how to prioritize critical findings. And as a senior penetration tester, you’ll lead small teams on one-of-a-kind engagements, mentor co-workers, and contribute significantly to the advancement of our consulting practice. 

Requirements 

  • 5+ years of offensive security experience supporting a variety of adversary emulation engagements (red teaming and purple teaming) with clients from a variety of industries.
  • Working knowledge of all common operating systems such as Windows, MacOS, Linux, ChromeOS
  • Expertise in Windows Active Directory exploitation and lateral movement
  • Working knowledge of “cloud” platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP and O365/Google Workspace) and container technologies (Kubernetes/Docker)
  • Hands-on experience with c2 frameworks like Sliver, Nighthawk, Mythic, and others
  • Experience with custom tool and payload development, as well as reverse engineering, and evasion techniques
  • Experience researching and developing EDR evasion techniques.
  • Proficiency in multiple programming languages (preferably Python, Golang, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, C/C++, PowerShell, and/or Bash)
  • Network and web-related protocol knowledge (e.g., TCP/IP, HTTP, HTTPS, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience with social engineering, conducting reconnaissance, development, and delivery of phishing/vishing pretexts as well as an understanding of email security technologies and other related countermeasures
  • Experience assessing the security of AI systems, with a focus on tool misuse, authorization and trust boundaries, and sensitive data exposure.
  • Experience developing and using AI-enabled capabilities, including autonomous agents and multi-agent systems, to support reconnaissance, attack planning, and execution during Red Team engagements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills 

Nice to have: 

  • Expertise in exploit development and/or assembly (x86/arm)  Threat modeling, threat intelligence, or incident response experience 
  • Exerience with DevOps and CI/CD technologies 
  • Experience conducting physical penetration testing engagements, including entry skills, RFID hacking, and alarm bypasses 
  • OSCP/E, CRTL/CRTO, GPEN, or GXPN certifications can be helpful, but are not a necessity 

Why Bishop Fox 

At Bishop Fox, we're driven by a simple mission: deliver exceptional quality to our clients, foster a vibrant and fulfilling environment for our team, and champion excellence within our industry. Our core values, which we live by every day, are: 

  • Be Excellent to Each Other 
  • Do the Right Thing 
  • Do What You’ll Say You’ll Do 
  • Get Better Together 
  • Give a Sh*t 
  • Get Better Together    

At Bishop Fox, we're committed to providing benefits that support your well-being and professional growth. Here's a glimpse of what we offer:    

  • Generous Time Off and Company-Wide Holidays    
  • Team Events and International Travel Opportunities    
  • Work From Home Support    
  • Monthly Allowance for Cell Phone and Internet    
  • Training Budget    
  • Retirement; 401k Matching for Traditional and Roth Accounts in the US    
  • Health Insurance Options Including Medical, Dental, Vision    
  • Paid Parental Leave

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.  All new hires must pass a background check as a condition of employment.

Position Purpose: Provides in-depth business knowledge and advanced technical support to one or more business areas through developed and ad hoc analysis/reporting , as well as designing and programming complex, new processes/reports. Acts as subject matter expert for department or business unit on business systems/applications. This role is focused on translating Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Risk Adjustment business requirements into production-ready technical solutions, including Encounter RA Prioritization and Encounter RA Chart Process support. Analyzes company functions, processes, and activities to improve computer-based business applications for the most effective use of money, materials, equipment, and people. Performs application/system design and implementation. Documents development requirements. Consults with end users to test and debug applications to meet client needs. The ideal candidate brings advanced SQL, Snowflake, Databricks knowledge, healthcare data integration experience, data quality, regulatory compliance, and reusable documentation experience.


  • Develops ad-hoc reports to conduct data analysis and validation.
  • Partners with business analysts, Risk Adjustment stakeholders, IT, and vendor teams to understand provided Medicare Advantage and Medicaid business requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and support process improvements through SAS solutions and future Snowflake capabilities.
  • Conducts business analysis and recommends technical alternative solutions to management as to course of action that best meets the organization's goals.
  • Analyzes provided requirements, procedures, and data needs to automate processing, improve existing business systems, and support production-ready SAS code for Encounter Risk Adjustment Prioritization and Encounter Risk Adjustment Chart Process workflows, with future Snowflake migration support.
  • Creates multi-user, real-time, robust database solutions by integrating complex healthcare datasets, including claims, enrollment, provider, pharmacy, clinical records, and vendor chart data.
  • Acts as a technical subject matter expert to convert provided business requirements into system analysis, technical design, advanced SAS/SQL programming, Snowflake modernization, and documentation of business applications/systems.
  • Modernizes legacy SAS ETL workflows into scalable Snowflake architecture using Snowflake SQL, Snowpark Python, and automated pipeline orchestration concepts such as Tasks and Streams.
  • Implements validation, reconciliation, and data quality frameworks to support CMS audit standards, state Medicaid requirements, and compliant Risk Adjustment encounter submissions.
  • Builds reusable SAS, SQL, and Snowflake data assets, modular code libraries, and technical documentation to reduce development time and support knowledge transfer across data and actuarial teams.
  • Research, evaluate and assess the financial impact of issues identified in data/processes
  • Analyzes requirements, procedures, and problems to automate processing or to improve existing business systems
  • Creates multiuser, real-time, robust database solution
  • Acts as subject matter expert to provide business and technical expertise in requirements solicitation, system analysis, technical design, programming and documentation of business applications/systems
  • May be responsible for monitoring and reporting to management on the status of departmental projects: Anticipates and identifies issues that could inhibit achieving the project goals and objectives, and implementing corrective actions and mitigation strategies.
  • Provides oversight and resolves complex issues, optimizing performance, resolving problems, and providing timely follow-up on identified issues.
  • Provides guidance and training to staff on process, procedures and issue resolution
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards

Education/Experience:
Required A Bachelor's Degree in a related field: Required or equivalent work experience in technical data analysis, conducting system analysis meetings, developing system design documents, developing project plans with achievable milestones and deadlines, and mediating different department demands to gain approvals on system scope and design.

Preferred Educational/Experience:

Master's degree in a related field, i.e., Mathematics, Computer Science, etc

May be considered in lieu of some of the required experience (not to exceed 2 years)

Candidate Skills/Experience:


Required Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in SQL
  • 4+ years of experience in Snowflake
  • Databricks knowledge
  • SAS knowledge

Preferred Skills:

  • Preferred 1+ year of experience in Healthcare
  • Preferred experience modernizing SAS ETL workflows into Snowflake using Snowflake SQL, Snowpark Python, and automated pipeline orchestration.
  • Preferred experience with Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Risk Adjustment, encounter submissions, claims, enrollment, provider, pharmacy, clinical, and vendor chart data.

Licenses and Certifications :

A license in one of the following is preferred:

  • SnowPro Certification
  • SAS Certification

Pay Range: $87,700.00 - $157,800.00 per year

At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules.   • Liderar técnicamente iniciativas de arquitectura y automatización, asegurando un ciclo completo desde el análisis profundo y la ejecución hands-on hasta su puesta en producción.
  • Evaluar y desafiar soluciones existentes, proponiendo activamente mejoras de arquitectura sustentadas en fundamentos técnicos sólidos.
  • Diseñar e implementar estrategias integrales de gobierno del dato, seguridad y gestión granular de accesos mediante AWS Lake Formation, políticas de IAM y roles.
  • Definir e implementar estándares de ingeniería, frameworks reutilizables y buenas prácticas transversales a toda la organización.
  • Garantizar la observabilidad, performance y escalabilidad de los pipelines y servicios de datos.
  • Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios (Data Engineering, MLOps, Analytics Engineering, Seguridad y Arquitectura) alineando requerimientos técnicos con objetivos de negocio.
  • Participar activamente en tareas operativas y de mantenimiento de plataforma (gestión de permisos, roles, resolución de incidentes y tuning de procesos), utilizándolas como insumo directo para evitar problemas recurrentes.
  • Brindar mentoring técnico al equipo y compartir conocimiento con la comunidad interna de Data & AI.

Requisitos / Requirements

Must-Have

  • +5 años de experiencia hands-on reciente desarrollando y operando soluciones de datos en entornos cloud productivos y de alta exigencia.
  • Ecosistema AWS enfocado en datos: dominio profundo y criterio de uso para servicios clave como S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, así como herramientas de gobernanza y control de accesos (AWS Lake Formation e IAM).
  • Python para Data Engineering: nivel avanzado en el desarrollo de pipelines limpios, scripts de automatización, librerías orientadas a datos y testing.
  • Snowflake: experiencia práctica en ingesta, modelado analítico y optimización de performance y costos.
  • Orquestación: experiencia sólida gestionando flujos productivos complejos (Airflow o Step Functions), con foco en manejo de dependencias, paralelismo y reprocesos.
  • DevOps y Automatización: experiencia demostrable en Infraestructura como Código (Terraform o CloudFormation) y pipelines de CI/CD (GitLab).
  • Autonomía y criterio técnico senior: capacidad para articular y defender decisiones de diseño, evaluar trade-offs entre arquitecturas y operar las herramientas core sin depender de un onboarding técnico extenso.
  • Mentalidad de ownership, product thinking y alta orientación a la resolución colaborativa de problemas operativos.

Nice-to-Have

  • Conocimientos generales en plataformas cloud adicionales como GCP o Microsoft Azure.
  • Experiencia en plataformas de datos de escala masiva en el sector financiero o fintech.

raw.excerpt: OverviewNational Debt Relief (NDR) is seeking a Principal AI & ML Architect to design and build the AI and machine learning systems that power our Data Science and Applied AI teams.
raw.description:
Overview

National Debt Relief (NDR) is seeking a Principal AI & ML Architect to design and build the AI and machine learning systems that power our Data Science and Applied AI teams. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Data and AI, this senior individual contributor serves both teams equally, helping shape shared architecture standards while staying hands-on in code. A core focus of this role is helping design NDR’s agentic architecture: the frameworks, patterns, and platforms that allow AI agents to reason, use tools, and act reliably across both predictive ML and Generative AI use cases. You will partner closely with the Directors of Data Science and Applied AI, as well as Data Engineering and Analytics Platforms, to move solutions from prototype to secure, scalable production. This is a unique opportunity for a technically deep, pragmatic architect who enjoys both whiteboard design and production delivery to shape how AI is built across a mission-driven company. This is a highly collaborative role, and strong teamwork and interpersonal skills are required.

Responsibilities

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

  • Partner with Data Science and Applied AI team members to design NDR’s agentic architecture, including:
    • Agent orchestration patterns (single-agent, multi-agent, and human-in-the-loop workflows)
    • Tool and API integration standards, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and function calling
    • Memory, context management, and retrieval (RAG) layers
    • Guardrails, evaluation, observability, and cost controls for agents in production
  • Collaborate with both teams on reference architectures and reusable components so they can build AI and ML solutions on a common foundation.
  • Stay hands-on: prototype, write production-quality code, and work alongside engineers and data scientists to deliver high-priority solutions.
  • Contribute to the design of end-to-end ML systems, from feature pipelines and model training through deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
  • Help determine where agents and LLMs should call predictive ML models (and vice versa), combining both into cohesive solutions.
  • Work with Data Engineering and Analytics Platforms to help ensure data, infrastructure, and platform choices support AI and ML workloads at scale.
  • Contribute to build vs. buy evaluations for AI platforms, frameworks, and vendors, prioritizing scalable, secure, and cost-effective options.
  • Help mature MLOps and LLMOps practices, including CI/CD for models and agents, versioning, testing, and production monitoring.
  • Champion robust governance, security, privacy, and compliance for AI systems operating in a regulated financial services environment.
  • Participate in architecture and code reviews, and help document shared standards and best practices.
  • Share expertise with peers across the Data and AI organization, contributing to a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
  • Communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, and roadmaps clearly to technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Stay abreast of evolving AI and ML tools, models, and agent frameworks, and bring forward recommendations on when to adopt them.

Qualifications

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. Master’s or PhD is strongly preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in ML engineering, data science, AI engineering, or software architecture roles.
  • 3+ years in a senior, staff, principal, or architect-level role setting technical direction across multiple teams.
  • Demonstrated success designing and deploying production-grade ML models and Generative AI applications at scale.
  • Hands-on experience designing and shipping agentic AI systems (LLM agents, tool use, multi-step workflows) to production.
  • Preferred Experience
    • Experience in financial services or a related regulated industry.
    • Familiarity with Salesforce integrations and data workflows.
    • Experience with Amazon SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, or similar enterprise AI/ML platforms.
    • Experience with voice AI or conversational AI for telephony platforms.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Expert Python skills and a track record of writing production-quality, well-tested code.
  • Strong SQL proficiency (Snowflake preferred) for data preparation and model enablement workflows.
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or similar).
  • Strong grounding in classical ML, including supervised and unsupervised learning, time series, anomaly detection, and NLP.
  • Experience with MLOps and LLMOps tooling, including model registries, experiment tracking, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring.
  • Experience deploying models and services via APIs using tools such as FastAPI and Docker, with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Ability to influence without authority and build consensus across teams with different priorities.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex architecture to executive and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience applying an AI-first approach to development, using AI coding assistants and agentic tools to accelerate delivery.
  • Preferred Skills
    • Knowledge of AI governance, model risk management, and responsible AI practices.
    • Exposure to collaborative tools such as JIRA and Miro.

National Debt Relief Role Qualifications:

  • Computer competency and ability to work with a computer.
  • Prioritize multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Punctuality expected, ready to report to work on a consistent basis.
  • Attain and maintain high performance expectations on a monthly basis.
  • Work in a fast-paced, high-volume setting.
  • Use and navigate multiple computer systems with exceptional multi-tasking skills.
  • Remain calm and professional during difficult discussions.
  • Take constructive feedback.
  • Available for full-time position.

Compensation Information

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for each position across the US. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This good faith pay range is provided in compliance with NYC law and the laws of other jurisdictions that may require a salary range in job postings. The salary for this position is $180,000 to $207,000 annually.

About National Debt Relief

National Debt Relief was founded in 2009 with the goal of helping an expanding number of consumers deal with overwhelming debt. We are one of the most-trusted and best-rated consumer debt relief providers in the United States. As a leading debt settlement organization, we have helped over 450,000 people settle over $10 billion of debt, while empowering them to lead a healthier financial lifestyle and feel free to live their best life. At National Debt Relief, we treat our clients like real people. Our purpose is to elevate, empower, and transform their lives.

Rated A+ by the Better Business Bureau, our goal is to help individuals and families get out of debt with the least possible cost through conducting financial consultations, educating the consumer and recommending the appropriate solution. We become our clients' number one advocate to help them reestablish financial stability as quickly as possible.

Want to learn more about who we are? Connect with us on social!

Benefits

National Debt Relief is a team-oriented environment full of rewards and growth opportunities for our employees. We are dedicated to our employee's success and growth within the company, through our employee mentorship and leadership programs.

Our extensive benefits package includes:

worum gehts?

In dieser Schlüsselrolle bist du das Bindeglied zwischen internen Teams und externen Partnern. Du sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe, transparente Kommunikation und stellst sicher, dass Meilensteine zuverlässig erreicht werden – mit Freiraum für eigene Ideen, flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen und einem Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt.

das wirst du tun

  • Portfoliosteuerung: Du übernimmst die kaufmännische und organisatorische Führung eines dynamischen IT- und Cloud-Projektportfolios – von der Planung bis zum Projektabschluss.
  • Finanzen & Forecasts: Budgets, Margen und Soll-Ist-Vergleiche hast du jederzeit im Blick. Du erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und machst Zahlen verlässlich planbar.
  • Standards & Qualität: Mit schlanken Workflows und erprobten Quality Gates sorgst du dafür, dass Best Practices projektübergreifend gelebt werden.
  • Rückenwind für Tech-Teams: Ob Cloud Engineers, Developers oder Consultants – du hältst deinen Teams organisatorisch den Rücken frei und stellst sicher, dass Scope und Budget auf Kurs bleiben.
  • Commercial Hygiene: Du prüfst Projektzeiten, sicherst die Abrechenbarkeit und übergibst unserem Finance-Team eine saubere Datenbasis für reibungslose Abrechnungen.
  • Insights & Reporting: Anhand moderner Tools erstellst du aussagekräftige Reports fürs Management. Wenn ein Projekt aus dem Ruder läuft, lieferst du nicht nur Zahlen, sondern direkt pragmatische Lösungsansätze.

das bringst du mit

  • Background: Erste Erfahrung im Projektcontrolling, Multiprojektmanagement oder PMO – idealerweise im IT-, Cloud- oder Beratungsumfeld.
  • Zahlenverständnis: Praktische Berührungspunkte mit Budgetierung, Kostenanalyse, Margensteuerung und Forecasting. Du kannst Finanzdaten nicht nur verwalten, sondern strategisch interpretieren.
  • Fokus & Weitblick: Auch bei vielen parallel laufenden Projekten behältst du den Überblick, setzt klare Prioritäten und weißt genau, wann Detailtiefe gefragt ist.
  • Tool-Affinität: Routinierter Umgang mit zeitgemäßen PM-, ERP- und Ticketsystemen (z. B. Jira, Confluence oder modernen Cloud-ERP-Lösungen).
  • Mindset: Du agierst als verlässlicher Sparringspartner auf Augenhöhe – für Delivery Team genauso wie für Finance und Management. Dich zeichnen Hands-on-Mentalität und Entscheidungsfreude aus.
  • Sichere Kommunikation: Verhandlungssichere Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Teamfähigkeit und Drive: Du überzeugst mit Ergebnisorientierung und der Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unserem diversen Team.
  • Wachstums-Mindset: Du willst dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. Du bringst Neugier für neue Methoden und Tools mit und hast Lust darauf, dein Profil in einer wachsenden EPM-Organisation gezielt auszubauen.

das hast du davon

  • Flexibilität pur: Arbeite so, wie es zu deinem Leben passt – remote im Bundesgebiet, hybrid, oder in einem unserer Offices in Deutschland (Magstadt, Darmstadt, Berlin, München, Hamburg, Köln, Ulm, Heidelberg, Frankfurt).
  • Workation: Arbeiten & neue Orte entdecken? Nutze bis zu 30 Tage Workation im Jahr und verbinde Job & Abenteuer.
  • Auszeiten: Mit 30 Tagen Urlaub tankst du Energie, wann immer du sie brauchst.
  • Deine Hardware, deine Wahl: Mac, Windows oder Linux – du entscheidest, womit du am liebsten arbeitest.
  • Weiterkommen: Schulungen, Labs und Zertifizierungen bei AWS, Azure, Google & SAP – wir pushen dein Cloud-Know-how.
  • Feedback, das zählt: Regelmäßige Entwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche, damit du genau weißt, wo du stehst.
  • Mehr als Basics: wähle zwischen Spendit Card, oder Wellpass oder Deutschlandticket. On top Kita-Zuschuss und Bikeleasing als weitere Extras für dein Leben abseits des Laptops.
  • Teamspirit: Ob Teamevents, Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier – wir feiern Erfolge zusammen.

Job Description:

Job Title: Delivery Director

Location: Remote: USA/Canada
Reports to: VP, Professional Services

Employment Type: Full-time

This is an existing vacancy.


About the Role:

The Delivery Director is the senior leader accountable for the successful planning, execution, and completion of client engagements across one or more JD Power OEM programs. Working alongside client stakeholders and internal account teams, you provide strategic direction, leadership, and hands-on guidance to delivery teams, ensuring every project lands on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.


This is a dual-mandate role. You are the primary point of contact for stakeholders, keeping them informed of progress and managing their expectations, and you lead the project managers and delivery professionals who execute the work, owning governance, budgets, risk, and quality across a portfolio of concurrent engagements.


Your work determines whether JD Power delivers what it promised, on schedule and within budget, across a portfolio of concurrent OEM engagements. By setting clear governance, holding teams to rigorous quality and financial standards, and surfacing risk before it becomes a client issue, you make delivery predictable and repeatable. Strong performance in this role protects revenue and margin, strengthens client confidence in our ability to execute, and builds a bench of capable project managers and delivery leaders.


In this role, you will be responsible for:

Strategic Planning & Intake

  • Requirements Gathering: Lead initial client meetings, stakeholder interviews, and requirement sessions to understand project needs, goals, constraints, and success criteria.
  • Scope & Plan Definition: Work with project managers to define scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, timelines, resource requirements, and budget, and review and approve the resulting project plans, including work breakdown structures and dependencies.
  • Governance Structure: Establish project governance, team roles and responsibilities, communication strategy, quality standards, and documentation requirements for each engagement.
  • Strategic Alignment: Align project plans with client and organizational priorities, and anticipate changes to scope, schedule, or budget before they become problems.

Program Delivery & Execution

  • Execution Leadership: Implement delivery methodologies, direct project teams, and monitor progress against the baseline plan, taking corrective action when deviations arise.
  • Resource Allocation: Allocate personnel, technology, and vendor resources effectively so that tasks are completed on time and within budget.
  • Methodology Compliance: Ensure adherence to delivery standards and best practices, and track project metrics, performance indicators, and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
  • Reporting & Documentation: Deliver regular status reports covering progress, KPIs, milestones, risks, issues, and decisions, and keep plans, schedules, and budgets.

Quality, Risk & Financial Management

  • Quality Assurance: Set quality expectations for each engagement, work with the QE team to confirm those standards are met before deliverables reach the client, and step in when quality issues arise.
  • Risk Management: Ensure project managers identify, assess, and mitigate risks, review the risk picture across your engagements on a regular basis, and communicate significant risks to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Budget Management: Oversee budgets across your engagements, monitor revenue and margin against plan, review forecasts from project managers, and act early on variances or overrun risk.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve cost, efficiency, and delivery processes across your portfolio, and share lessons learned across teams.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Identify clients, sponsors, vendors, and other affected parties, understand their priorities, and build positive relationships through regular, transparent communication.
  • Expectation Management: Set realistic goals, timelines, and deliverables, solicit stakeholder feedback, and address concerns proactively.
  • Negotiation: Negotiate scope changes, deliverables, and priorities to resolve conflicts and reach agreements that protect project success.
  • Executive Communication: Facilitate internal and client meetings that drive toward a decision, solution, or clear next step, and communicate the big picture whenever project parameters change.
  • Risk & Escalation: Raise issues with internal leadership and sales early, and escalate in a timely and tactful manner.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Vision & Accountability: Set clear goals for the team and define roles and responsibilities so every member understands their contribution to the project.
  • People Leadership: Lead, coach, and mentor project managers and delivery professionals, including remote team members, through regular one-on-ones, constructive feedback, and performance management.
  • Team Culture: Foster collaboration, trust, and ownership, empower team members to make decisions, resolve conflict constructively, and recognize achievements.

Required Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required in business administration, project management, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline.
  • Experience: 7+ years of project or program delivery experience leading complex, multi-workstream engagements from initiation through completion, with a track record of on-time, on-budget delivery.
  • Industry Knowledge: Automotive industry experience preferred, including work with OEMs or with an agency or solution provider serving OEMs.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated success leading and developing multidisciplinary teams, including remote team members, and inspiring accountability and high performance.
  • Delivery & Technical Literacy: Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle (Waterfall, Agile, DevOps, CI/CD) and a general understanding of IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, and data analytics sufficient to engage credibly with technical teams.
  • Tools: Proficiency with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Asana, or similar.
  • Financial & Risk Acumen: Strong command of budgeting, forecasting, and cost control, with proven risk management skills.
  • Strategic Acumen: Ability to align project objectives with business goals, assess business impact and ROI, and plan for change management across stakeholder groups.
  • Communication & Negotiation: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with confidence presenting to senior audiences and negotiating scope, priorities, and deliverables.
  • Problem Solving & Resilience: Sound decision-making in ambiguity, adaptability as circumstances change, and a commitment to continuous learning.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel to client locations as program needs require.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, Certified ScrumMaster, or PMI-ACP preferred.

Compensation and Benefits:

This position has a starting salary range of CAD $125,000-$136,000 / USD $160,000-$175,000 per year. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.


Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

· We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

· We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

· We make things easy. We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

· We get it done. We focus on execution, accountability, and results.

· We start with trust and prove it every day. Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.


Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact for accommodation request.


Data Privacy

JD Power does not disclose your personal data to unauthorized third parties. However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. JD Power may from time to time also use third parties to act on JD Power’s behalf. Job Description

What you will do

The Director, Patient Experience leads strategy for a connected patient experience across the journey, including point-of-care, onboarding, persistence, patient stories, and community engagement. The Director partners closely with the Direct to Patient (DTP) team, which owns DTP strategy and operations, to integrate relevant DTP pathways and touchpoints into the overall patient experience. The role aligns patient-facing work with Healthcare- Professional (HCP) Promotion, Corporate Affairs, Patient Advocacy, and field and Sales Training.

What sets this role apart

  • Define a patient experience that is connected across care, onboarding, and ongoing support.
  • Establish a patient community in partnership with Corporate Affairs and Patient Advocacy.
  • Ensure patient experience tactics and training are coordinated with physicians, field teams, and Sales Training.

Key responsibilities

Patient Experience Strategy and Journey

  • Set the patient experience strategy across the patient journey and partner with the DTP team to integrate relevant DTP pathways and touchpoints into that experience.
  • Define priorities and principles for point-of-care, onboarding, persistence, patient stories, loyalty, and community engagement.
  • Translate patient and caregiver needs into connected programs that are timely, useful, and aligned to the broader brand experience.
  • Identify journey gaps and opportunities in partnership with Consumer, HCP, DTP, and relevant patient support teams.

Community, Corporate Affairs, and Advocacy

  • Partner with Corporate Affairs and Patient Advocacy to establish the community, ambassador, and influencer approach.

HCP Promotion and Training Integration

  • Coordinate with HCP Promotion to ensure patient experience tactics are aligned with physician needs and HCP promotional plans.
  • Ensure patient education and training are coordinated across physicians, field teams, and Sales Training.
