Are you interested in driving policy enforcement and continuously improving our global cloud infrastructure?

Are you ready to bridge the gap between engineering innovation and enterprise compliance?

Join our Enterprise Security Team

The Technology Reliability Governance team safeguards infrastructure by identifying risks, conducting assessments, and engaging technical teams effectively. Threats to critical operations are monitored to ensure swift mitigation and maintain exceptional resilience and uptime. Collaborating with engineering leaders, the team develops policies and frameworks aimed at preventing service disruptions and sustaining operational reliability.

Lead our Compliance Team

Ensure organizational adherence to regulatory requirements by developing, implementing, and monitoring compliance programs that mitigate risks and enhance ethical practices.

As a Compliance Manager, you will be responsible for:

  • Establishing, tracking, and strictly enforcing governance policies across the engineering organization, with a primary focus on engineering operations and operational standards.
  • Overseeing the operational lifecycle of vulnerability management, collaborating with engineering teams to ensure prompt remediation and reduced risks across infrastructure.
  • Collaborating closely with security architects, engineers and stakeholders to design controls for compliance and IT minimum control standard
  • Developing and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) and dashboards to track policy adherence, open vulnerabilities, and audit readiness across engineering.
  • Serving as the bridge between engineering, security and audit teams, ensuring our control environment procedures are well-documented, tested, and consistently followed.
  • Translating policies and industry frameworks (such as CIS benchmarks or NIST guidelines) into actionable technical specifications and engineering workflows.
  • Participating in post-incident reviews and threat modeling to identify systemic compliance gaps and recommend structural improvements.

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Demonstrate 8+ of relevant experience in policy, compliance, or technical program management within an engineering-focused environment with practical expertise.
  • Demonstrate deep, hands-on experience designing and managing vulnerability management programs, patch compliance tracking, and remediation SLAs.
  • Demonstrate expertise in engineering and operations technologies, encompassing secure software development lifecycles (SDLC).
  • Have working knowledge of standard security frameworks and benchmarks (e.g., NIST, CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001) used to shape governance.
  • Excel at cross-functional communication, bridging the gap between mandates and developer velocity by turning policies into clear, achievable technical requirements.
  • Be capable of identifying operational and security risks before they impact platform reliability and driving accountability across engineering teams.

Our focus is simple:

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Automation & Data Analytics Specialist (Moving & Storage)

Full-time | Remote | Hiring through Hyre for a U.S. moving and storage company

About the Client

Our client is a multi-location moving and storage company with operations in Bakersfield, Phoenix, and Santa Rosa. They handle local and interstate moves and run on daily data: sales performance, driver incentives, customer quality, safety, and payroll.

About the Role

The client relies on advanced data analytics and reporting systems to drive operational performance across all departments. You will implement and refine their existing Driver Scorecard dashboard, then build similar dashboards for every department, automating them for daily execution with clear SOPs for ongoing management.

Design scalable department scorecards, eventually phasing out spreadsheets in favor of a dedicated reporting platform. This role also prepares the incentive and bonus data that feeds payroll, so accuracy is non-negotiable.

What You'll Do

Automation and Process Improvement

  • Automate recurring manual work: pay period setup, multi-system data pulls, incentive calculations, and previous-day job feeds

  • Build live executive dashboards so managers can self-serve instead of waiting on reports

  • Include validation checks, a documented SOP, and a manual fallback with every automation

  • Support fleet data in Samsara and Motive, including preventive maintenance schedules, as needed

Build Department Scorecard Systems

  • Design and implement scalable department scorecard systems, evaluating transitions from spreadsheet-based models to dedicated BI platforms or custom web reporting applications as business needs expand. Structure each workbook with raw source tabs, a master consolidated tab, an editable incentive and weights matrix, calculation tabs, an executive summary dashboard, and printable individual scorecards

  • Combine weighted performance pillars (for example revenue, attendance, customer satisfaction, claims, safety, and conduct) into one overall score and standing such as Exemplary, Standard, Coaching, or Disciplinary Review

  • Write and maintain Google Apps Script that refreshes outputs, runs scheduled and on-edit triggers, and keeps calculation logic protected

  • Document every metric in a calculation index and column map so each formula is traceable and auditable

  • Build data quality checks that flag unmatched IDs, name mismatches, duplicates, and missing inputs before any score is used

Daily Scorecard Management and Report Delivery

  • Automate data syncs from previous-day data every morning for all three locations

  • Import and map data from SmartMoving, RingCentral, Qube Sheets, Asana, Motive, attendance records, Google Reviews, internal crew ratings, and damage claims into the correct source tabs

  • Keep employee profiles and IDs consistent across every source, and add new hires to every scorecard

  • Resolve data quality flags daily and document zero-activity exceptions with evidence

  • Submit each report to the appropriate manager on schedule: department scorecards, Driver Incentive Reports, QC reports, and the Interstate Booking Load Board

  • Flag data gaps and blockers early, with the owner named

Payroll and Incentive Programs

  • Verify qualifying jobs and apply driver credits in the scorecards and SmartMoving

  • Calculate tenure-based bonuses and proposed payouts from wages, tenure, and overall scores

  • Prepare payroll-ready incentive and bonus totals each pay period and submit them to the payroll manager for approval before cutoff

  • Reconcile incentive figures against job records and wage data before payout, and correct any errors

  • Update incentive matrix settings each evaluation period, including weights, targets, rating bands, penalties, and thresholds, in line with company policy

Quality Control and Review Checks

  • Audit previous-day jobs in SmartMoving and send customer QC emails

  • Consolidate missing estimate information and post the QC report in Asana

  • Complete weekly review checks across all locations, assign driver credits, and post the report

  • Track damage claims, incidents, and Motive safety scores for each driver

Documentation and Communication

  • Maintain SOPs and setup instructions for every scorecard and workflow you own

  • Handle ad-hoc data pulls and analysis requests from the client's leadership

  • Submit daily EOD and weekly EOW reports

What You Bring

Must Have

  • 5+ years in data analytics, reporting, or operations automation (moving, logistics, or field services preferred)

  • Expert-level Google Sheets: QUERY, ARRAYFORMULA, IMPORTRANGE, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and data validation

  • Advanced Google Apps Script, including custom menus, triggers, and scripts that rebuild output tabs

  • Experience building weighted scorecards, incentive models, or performance dashboards

  • Strong data and spreadsheet skills, including experience with dashboards like Google Canvas. Must be able to provide samples of scorecards, dashboards, or trackers you have built.

  • Experience preparing or validating payroll, commission, or incentive data

  • Experience reconciling data across a CRM, phone system, telematics, and project management tool

  • Strong written English and clear, concise reporting

  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office

Nice to Have

  • SmartMoving or another moving-industry CRM

  • RingCentral, Qube Sheets, Asana, Motive, or Samsara

  • Zapier, Make, APIs, and webhooks

  • Dashboard building in Looker Studio or similar

  • AI tools for data summaries, report drafts, or workflow automation

  • SOP writing

Tools You'll Use

SmartMoving, Google Sheets, Google Apps Script, Excel, Looker Studio, Gmail, RingCentral, Asana, Motive, Samsara, Qube Sheets, Google Docs

Schedule and Work Setup

  • Full-time, remote, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, during U.S. business hours

  • Previous-day reports due at the start of each business day

  • Monday and Friday check-ins with the client (15 to 30 minutes)

  • Overtime only with prior approval

Contractor Perks

  • Work with international clients while maintaining your independent contractor status.

  • Minimum 5 paid days off annually, plus US holidays.

  • Free access to career growth learning modules through Hyre Academy.

  • Scheduled rate increases based on applicable contract terms and performance.

Job Description: Photography and Cinematography Expert

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote – Worldwide

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Photography and Cinematography Experts to evaluate professional photo and video content for a specialized project. This role is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in photography, cinematography, camera operation, or video production.

You will review photographs, video clips, and creative briefs, assess technical and visual quality, and provide clear written explanations for your decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Evaluate photographs and video clips to determine which best meets the project brief and target audience.
  2. Assess exposure, focus, color accuracy, framing, lens selection, and camera movement.
  3. Identify technical issues such as image noise, flickering, clipped highlights, and incorrect frame rates or formats.
  4. Ensure photo and video content aligns with the brief and intended platform, including print, web, social media, broadcast, or film.

Required Qualifications

  1. Professional experience as a Photographer, Cinematographer, Director of Photography, Camera Operator, or Video Producer.
  2. Hands-on experience managing professional projects, including creative briefs, shooting, post-production, and final client delivery.
  3. Proficiency in professional cameras and editing or color-grading tools such as Adobe Lightroom, Photoshop, DaVinci Resolve, or Premiere Pro.
  4. Strong understanding of lighting, composition, camera settings, framing, and visual storytelling.
  5. Ability to evaluate technical and creative quality and clearly explain decisions.
  6. Strong written English communication skills.

Selection Process

  1. Application: Submit your resume and a short professional profile.
  2. Photography and Cinematography Interview: Complete a brief conversation about your experience with photography, video production, camera operation, and post-production. No preparation or written assignment is required.
  3. Experience Review: Your qualifications will be assessed against the project requirements.

Communicates findings effectively using visualizations, dashboards and presentations with the goal of optimizing business decisions and outcomes.

We are searching for the best talent for Clinical Education Specialist- Orthopedics.


The Clinical Education Specialist is responsible for the strategic design, preparation and execution of hands-on training experiences for Professional Education under North America Global Education Solutions. The Clinical Education Specialist also supports R&D, Marketing, Education Grants, and Meetings and Conventions. They must partner with colleagues to effectively teach and train on the safe and efficacious use of Johnson & Johnson products in a lab setting to external Healthcare Professional customers. They serve as the subject matter expert on anatomy, language of medicine, clinical procedures, disease states and all Johnson & Johnson technologies. They must collaborate and align priorities with Sales, Professional Education, R&D, and Marketing leaders to develop customized hands-on educational experiences that meet the goals and needs of multiple stakeholders. They must manage priorities and timelines well and be comfortable in a fast-paced environment. They must ensure compliance to all legal, regulatory and HCC policies to include Advamed, Pharma, ACCME, AATB and other global legal and regulatory bodies. The Clinical Education Specialist must ensure all field based programs are compliant with J&J guidelines through thorough formal on-site assessment of field based sites. This Clinical Education Specialist role will be supporting the DePuy Synthes operating business, prior experience in Sports Medicine or Joint Reconstruction medical devices is preferred.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Policies: Know and follow policies and procedures related to work activities performed in area of responsibility.

  • Training: Complete training in area of responsibility within allowed time period. Training is required for changes in existing policies & procedures, for new assignments & for implementation of new policies & procedures. Complete required periodic re-training in areas such as safety & environmental compliance.
  • Successful completion of designated primary sales training.
  • Successful completion of Clinical Education training evaluations.

  • Safety: Follow all company safety policies & other safety precautions within work area. Promote safety to all associates that enter work area. Follow Health Care Compliance guidelines as well as follow operating room training and safety standards (Bloodborne pathogens training, etc.).

  • Product, Clinical, and Disease State Knowledge: Extensive knowledge and understanding of the safe and efficacious use of Johnson & Johnson Products. All-encompassing understanding of surgical procedures across several specialties, relevant disease states and appropriate product application. Ability to teach and translate that knowledge into comprehensible education for different audiences.

  • Teaching: Exceptional communication skills and the ability to train, mentor and coach new associates in human and animal anatomy, medical language, and the procedure steps and appropriate product application in surgical procedures across many specialties. Demonstrate solid presentation skills to perform product in-services on animate, inanimate, cadaveric and other simulated models.

  • Program Development & Execution: Perform as the subject matter expert to the Johnson & Johnson business in Clinical Education, advising on appropriate models to meet learning objectives, hands-on education development and execution, and other clinical needs. Manage priorities effectively, acting with speed, flexibility and accountability to achieve goals.

  • Partnerships: Strong capacity to interact, dialogue and educate all levels of both internal and external customers in the Johnson & Johnson Institutes and in the field. Collaborate with Professional Education, R&D, Marketing, and Meetings and Conventions across all levels, creating effective solutions to drive the education business plan. Build and maintain partnerships with all stakeholders and facilitate key strategic relationships with facilities and third-party vendors.

  • Business Acumen: In-depth understanding of the Johnson & Johnson business, organizations and processes. Translate business requirements into Clinical Education strategy and plans.

  • Customer Insights: Acquire and translate customer insights to the broader organization as it relates to unmet needs and future educational and product offerings.

  • Market and Industry Knowledge: Understand and apply market, industry, competitor, and health care compliance, legal, and regulatory knowledge. Understands the external marketplace including competitor offerings and strategy, changing stakeholders, and applies knowledge to shape Clinical Education offerings.

  • Project Management: Lead Clinical Education projects through application of customer insights and strategic planning to develop and implement new education modalities. Contribute to innovative and viable products, service and/or solutions adding value. Develop measurable project plans with clear objectives, milestones, resource requirements, and deliverables.

Education and/or Experience

Location:

  • United States

Required:

  • Minimum 6 years experience in a business environment – preferably orthopedics Healthcare Industry or Clinical Setting.

Preferred:

  • Operating Room or Healthcare Professional facing experience.
  • Education and/or Training experience.
  • Product, Clinical and Disease State Knowledge of Orthopedics.
  • Experience in complex scheduling and execution of projects/events.
  • Experience working with Cadaveric Tissue

Other Skills and Abilities:

  • Collaboration and teamwork.
  • Big picture thinking with attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated strong organizational skills.
  • Strong presentation and public speaking.
  • Extensive product & procedure knowledge and applications.
  • Ability to utilize and learn new technology and applications.
  • Project leadership experience.

Physical and Other Demands:

  • Overnight travel may be required up to 70%.

On October 14, 2025, Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. raw.title: Staff Software Engineer - OpenTelemetry Python instrumentation | Germany | Remot
raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from Germany, UK, Ireland and Spain.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack

The Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications and infrastructure in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it.

The OpenTelemetry SDKs team's mission is to make sure our users succeed in instrumenting their software with OpenTelemetry. We work closely with the OpenTelemetry SIGs to make OpenTelemetry SDKs and instrumentation libraries a success. Members of this team are experts in at least one programming language and have a broad knowledge of various other programming languages.

In this role, you will focus on a language-specific implementation of OpenTelemetry in Python, with an emphasis on OpenTelemetry for Generative AI. You will get to work in an upstream-first approach, helping accelerate the OpenTelemetry project while bringing the innovations to Grafana labs products and offerings.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. We are looking for Engineers that are passionate about communicating with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities.

At Grafana Labs, ICs have a dedicated career path and do not have to become managers to progress in their career. Staff Software Engineers at Grafana have a large amount of experience across multiple areas. They are able to estimate, plan, coordinate and deliver large tasks spanning multiple systems. They actively coach and mentor other team members in their team and are able to identify and resolve issues with technology and product processes.

What You’ll Be Doing:

You will bring your software engineering expertise to develop improvements to the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, with a strong focus on AI applications and agent workflows. This is a hands-on role for someone with deep Python expertise and an interest in AI.

  • Collaborate in open-source communities. You will develop and maintain the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, working with maintainers and other vendors on specifications, APIs, and implementation decisions.
  • Build Python instrumentation for AI agents. Build instrumentation that connects agent runs, model calls, and tool execution, including across asynchronous code. Contribute to evolving OpenTelemetry conventions for generative AI, with care for sensitive data and metric cardinality.
  • Improve Python SDK performance. Use profiling and benchmarks to evaluate implementation approaches with the upstream community. Make sound tradeoffs around runtime overhead, compatibility, and maintainability.
  • Be visible as an OpenTelemetry expert. Teach others, promote best practices around OpenTelemetry, semantic conventions, and various technologies and frameworks. Both within Grafana Labs and in the broader OpenTelemetry community.
  • Support the technical direction and vision of the team, and contribute to business conversations on the OpenTelemetry strategy at Grafana Labs. Own projects from an ambiguous problem through design, implementation, testing, documentation, and release.
  • Partner in an open and respectful way. Lend your knowledge and skills to our GTM, Product and Support teams. Join customer conversations, investigate instrumentation issues, and turn what you learn into fixes and practical guidance.

As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so high agency and good communication skills are a must.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

At Grafana Labs, Staff Engineers are defined by the impact they have and the people they enable. You take ownership of complex problems, set technical direction, and help others deliver improvements that matter to customers and the OpenTelemetry community.

  • 8+ years of experience in software development, with strong proficiency in Python and experience debugging production software, language internals, libraries, and asynchronous code.
  • An interest in AI applications and agent systems, and curiosity about how to instrument and troubleshoot them. Prior experience building AI systems is helpful, but not required.
  • Experience working in open-source communities. You are eager to become an active member of the OpenTelemetry community, collaborate with maintainers and users, and keep learning across languages, frameworks, and the wider observability ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry, alongside experience with cloud-based software or systems engineering. You understand production environments and can assess operational risks.

Bonus Points For:

  • You have experience working on open source observability projects, ideally in OpenTelemetry or Prometheus.
  • Experience in Python instrumentation techniques, profiling, runtime diagnostics, or asynchronous context propagation
  • Experience in a hands-on technical leadership role, setting technical direction and leading project teams
  • Experience instrumenting AI frameworks or agent workflows, or working with OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for generative AI
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining Open Source projects, with evidence of successful pull requests and community collaboration
  • Rust experience is a plus for exploring potential Python SDK performance improvements, including Rust-backed implementations.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the compensation range for this role is EUR 113,000 - EUR 141,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

Join us in creating a better way!

At eHealth, our mission is to expertly guide consumers through their health insurance and related options when, where, and how they prefer. We’re creating a better way – one that’s transparent and trustworthy for both our consumers externally and our employees internally.

Move your career forward while connecting countless people to the life- changing, quality care they deserve. Our diverse team of innovators supports one another in solving some of the toughest challenges. We’re always on the lookout for creative opportunities to do right by our customers, and each other. Together, we’re creating a better way to work, united by our common passion to make a difference.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Principal, Product Manager, to lead eHealth’s eCommerce insurance marketplace and online consumer shopping experience. The ideal candidate is a strategic product leader who thrives in complex environments and is passionate about improving customer outcomes in healthcare.


You will design intelligent, personalized shopping experiences that clarify the historically challenging search for health insurance, earning consumer trust and maximizing conversion. This role will play a critical part in shaping the future of how online customers shop for healthcare by developing AI-first solutions. You will customize experiences for audience segments that range from brokers and employers seeking CHOICE (ICHRA) and traditional group coverage for their employees; individuals under 65 looking for individual and family plans; retirees turning 65 and aging into Medicare as well as individuals over 65 switching Medicare plans; and shoppers of all ages seeking gap and ancillary coverage (like dental, vision, and hearing) to supplement major medical coverage.


This role is responsible for defining the product strategy and roadmap, driving innovation across customer-facing experiences, and collaborating with cross-functional partners including engineering, data science, and business teams. Success in this role will be defined by the ability to improve the customer experience by delivering impactful product innovations and drive measurable business outcomes in a highly complex and evolving marketplace.

Key Responsibilities

Drive eCommerce Vision & Roadmap: Own the enterprise website strategy, priorities and roadmap, leading the online shopping and enrollment experience, turning the search for health insurance coverage into an intuitive, guided, high-converting e-commerce experience, prioritizing initiatives that maximize conversion, Average Order Value (AOV), and lifetime customer value (LTV) based on customer retention.

Implement AI-Native Experiences: Define and launch consumer-facing AI agents, chat-based enrollment guides, and non-deterministic engines designed to empower users to effortlessly and transparently search for plans, cross-examine benefits, premiums, compare Rx drug and doctor coverage, and understand out-of-pocket costs.

Architect Audience-First Segmentation: Establish framework models and global navigation paradigm that support users in dynamic audience segments based on roles (brokers, employers, individual shoppers), census and demographics, special needs like chronic conditions and dual-eligibility (Medicaid and Medicare), personal health intent and other criteria to trigger tailored e-commerce experiences.

Own Growth & Lifecycle Funnels: Oversee key growth metrics from conversion through digital marketing campaigns and organic entries through landing pages and educational experiences built in content management systems, dynamic shopping and enrollment experiences, activation, onboarding, lifecycle retention loops and support in concert with a trusted human advisor who can provide context to changes in plans and guidance as desired by the shopper.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Leadership: Collaborate deeply with Sales and Marketing, UX Design, Data Science, Engineering, Legal and Compliance teams to ensure all consumer experiences, AI recommendation spaces maintain data integrity, legal compliance, and human trust.

Responsibilities include:

  • Lead multi-year digital-commerce transformation initiatives spanning multiple product portfolios and business segments
  • Serve as a strategic product advisor to senior executives, shaping investment priorities, portfolio tradeoffs, and own enterprise website roadmap
  • Resolve complex dependencies and competing priorities across business and technology organizations
  • Mentor product leaders and raise product-management capability through coaching, standards, and thought leadership
  • Define and deliver enterprise-level outcomes across growth, customer trust, platform leverage, and long-term economics
  • Define product requirements, write user stories, and manage backlog prioritization
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to identify dependencies and influence system architecture and design
  • Champion product vision and build alignment across internal and external stakeholders
  • Serve as Product Owner within Agile frameworks, participating in all Scrum ceremonies
  • Own UX optimization and A/B testing roadmap, including success criteria
  • Optimize product development processes to improve delivery speed, quality, and team impact, including website release governance, stage-gate reviews, and peak-period change management
  • Be accountable for instrumentation, monitoring, issue prioritization, and risk escalation in partnership with Analytics and Engineering
  • Establish website platform and domain governance, accessibility, and legal and compliance coordination
  • Communicate product performance, metrics, and roadmap updates to stakeholders
  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to inform product strategy
  • Use data-driven decision-making to prioritize initiatives and measure success

Required and Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product management leadership and a track record of deploying large-scale consumer e-commerce storefronts, dual-sided marketplace engines, or complex fintech platforms with cross functional partners
  • Proven experience defining strategy, translating strategy into execution in a complex & matrixed organizational structure
  • Strong domain familiarity with health tech, healthcare insurance workflows, or utilization mechanics is highly desirable but not mandatory if you bring world-class consumer marketplace expertise
  • Experience going "zero-to-one" with generative AI products, prompt-engineered systems, or agentic automation workflows
  • A high aesthetic standard for empathetic product interfaces, and polished mobile/desktop consumer user design.
  • Analyticalfluency with business metrics like conversion rates, drop-off analytics, and financial profitability frameworks
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, computer science, engineering, or related field
  • Experience serving as Product Owner in Agile frameworks (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Experience with tools such as Atlassian suite, Jira, Miro, Figma, and generative AI platforms (e.g., Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT)

What we offer (benefits):

  • Generous benefits include medical, dental and vision beginning on your first day of employment
  • 401K with matching
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Employee stock purchase program
  • 12 company paid holidays and flexible time off (PTO for non-exempt)

Our Values: At eHealth, our core values guide our work:

  • One Team
  • Customer Centric
  • Innovation
  • Integrity
  • Quality
  • Accountability
  • Relentless
  • Financial Stewardship

*Please note the above is a summary of responsibilities; a full job description is available upon request.


Application deadline: December 7, 2026.

raw.description:
Gigstreem is a US based national Internet Service Provider, serving Residential (Single Family, MDU) and Commercial (MTU) clients with technology solutions in markets across the country.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Project Manager leads end-to-end execution of residential capital project launches, including low voltage and network hardware installations for our managed WiFi solutions. Every project is delivered on time, within budget, and to client satisfaction.

The role works with cross-functional partners through every stage of the project lifecycle. That includes translating services sold into the Internal Statement of Work, developing and running the project plan, coordinating teams and clients, and leading the post-launch financial and operational review.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

Project Initiation & Planning

  • Review and fully understand contract and pre-sale deliverables (Sales Budget, Scope of Work, Design, Circuit Provider plan, and revenue/conversion model) and translate services sold into the Internal Statement of Work.
  • Develop comprehensive project plans for all assigned projects, including requirements, objectives, timelines, budgets, milestones, and resource allocation.
  • Plan, manage, and execute projects involving low voltage cabling and network hardware installations.

Project Plan & Schedule Management

  • Create and update the project plan and schedule covering all in-scope items, tasks, responsibilities, and due dates.
  • Ensure each phase closes only after all deliverables are submitted.
  • Ensure all tasks and activities are QC’ed by the appropriate subject matter expert (SME).
  • Ensure punch-list completion and submission of all closeout materials.
  • Schedule and run closeout meetings and guide stakeholders through the Lessons Learned process.

Team Leadership & Coordination

  • Supervise and coordinate internal teams (CSM, Engineering, Design, Sales, Leadership), subcontractors, and vendors to achieve project goals.
  • Delegate and assign responsibilities; direct, motivate, and manage all project work and resources, ensuring efficient use of company resources.
  • Run regular project meetings and other communication channels so all stakeholders know their updates and responsibilities.
  • Mentor and guide new hires and other members of the PM team.

Technical Management

  • Oversee installation, testing, and commissioning of low voltage systems (structured cabling, fiber optics) and network hardware (routers, switches, access points).
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues during the project lifecycle, using company resources and management as needed.

Client Engagement

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for ownership clients and property managers.
  • Provide regular project and construction updates, including progress reports, milestones, and risk assessments.
  • Address client concerns promptly and professionally.

Budget & Resource Management

  • Prepare and track project budgets, review financial information, and enforce cost controls to promote profitability.
  • Manage procurement of equipment, materials, and resources required for installations.
  • Review and approve project-related expenses, invoices, and change orders.
  • Monitor accounts receivable and assist with collections as necessary.
  • Lead the post-launch financial and operational review.

Compliance, Quality & Documentation

  • Ensure the Construction Manager conducts site inspections to verify work quality and adherence to company standards.
  • Ensure proper documentation of installations, configurations, and as-built drawings.
  • Oversee all project documentation, including milestone and task status, internal and external reports, and executive summaries.
  • Produce reporting for cross-functional managers to ensure company policies are followed.

Risk Management

  • Identify project risks and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Resolve conflicts or delays during execution and escalate issues as needed.

Process Improvement

  • Evaluate business processes, procedures, and systems; develop and run improvement projects to drive efficiency and reduce cost.
  • Work cross-functionally to develop, document, and implement guidelines, evaluations, recruitment, and promotion processes.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Construction Management, Telecommunications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience in tenant finish-out project management, expediting, and logistics management.
  • Experience with inspections and regulatory compliance.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of structured cabling, fiber optics, and network hardware (routers, switches, access points).
  • Knowledge of technologies and materials used in telecommunications site designs.
  • Familiarity with industry standards and best practices (e.g., TIA/EIA, BICSI).
  • Awareness of general accounting and costing practices, including budgeting, invoicing, purchase orders, and accounts payable.
  • Proficient in project management tools (MS Project, Smartsheet) and technical documentation software (AutoCAD).
  • Proficient in CRM, ERP, billing, and other enterprise systems, and in Microsoft Office (Project, Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong leadership: giving direction, implementing action, and defining and measuring success, while working as part of a team.
  • Competency in customer experience, change and innovation, strategic thinking, relationship-building and influencing, and results-focused leadership.
  • Ability to identify project-impacting issues and work with the PM team to implement solutions.
  • Understanding of the critical milestones that drive operational excellence.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with people at all levels inside and outside the company.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented; able to manage multiple projects, budgets, and timelines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CAPM, PMP, or equivalent project management certification.
  • Networking certifications (e.g., CCNA, CompTIA Network+).

WHY JOIN GIGSTREEM

  • Lead a high impact team at a growing, innovative company serving the multifamily and property management industry.
  • Opportunity to shape the future of the account management function as we scale nationally.
  • Remote-first culture with collaborative, forward-thinking peers.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package, with strong growth potential.

This position is 100% remote. Applicants must have a dedicated home workstation for focused work and on-camera meetings.

COMPENSATION

The Project Manager leads end-to-end execution of residential capital project launches, including low voltage and network hardware installations for our managed WiFi solutions. Every project is delivered on time, within budget, and to client satisfaction.

The role works with cross-functional partners through every stage of the project lifecycle. That includes translating services sold into the Internal Statement of Work, developing and running the project plan, coordinating teams and clients, and leading the post-launch financial and operational review.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

Project Initiation & Planning

  • Review and fully understand contract and pre-sale deliverables (Sales Budget, Scope of Work, Design, Circuit Provider plan, and revenue/conversion model) and translate services sold into the Internal Statement of Work.
  • Develop comprehensive project plans for all assigned projects, including requirements, objectives, timelines, budgets, milestones, and resource allocation.
  • Plan, manage, and execute projects involving low voltage cabling and network hardware installations.

Project Plan & Schedule Management

  • Create and update the project plan and schedule covering all in-scope items, tasks, responsibilities, and due dates.
  • Ensure each phase closes only after all deliverables are submitted.
  • Ensure all tasks and activities are QC’ed by the appropriate subject matter expert (SME).
  • Ensure punch-list completion and submission of all closeout materials.
  • Schedule and run closeout meetings and guide stakeholders through the Lessons Learned process.

Team Leadership & Coordination

  • Supervise and coordinate internal teams (CSM, Engineering, Design, Sales, Leadership), subcontractors, and vendors to achieve project goals.
  • Delegate and assign responsibilities; direct, motivate, and manage all project work and resources, ensuring efficient use of company resources.
  • Run regular project meetings and other communication channels so all stakeholders know their updates and responsibilities.
  • Mentor and guide new hires and other members of the PM team.

Technical Management

  • Oversee installation, testing, and commissioning of low voltage systems (structured cabling, fiber optics) and network hardware (routers, switches, access points).
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues during the project lifecycle, using company resources and management as needed.

Client Engagement

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for ownership clients and property managers.
  • Provide regular project and construction updates, including progress reports, milestones, and risk assessments.
  • Address client concerns promptly and professionally.

Budget & Resource Management

  • Prepare and track project budgets, review financial information, and enforce cost controls to promote profitability.
  • Manage procurement of equipment, materials, and resources required for installations.
  • Review and approve project-related expenses, invoices, and change orders.
  • Monitor accounts receivable and assist with collections as necessary.
  • Lead the post-launch financial and operational review.

Compliance, Quality & Documentation

  • Ensure the Construction Manager conducts site inspections to verify work quality and adherence to company standards.
  • Ensure proper documentation of installations, configurations, and as-built drawings.
  • Oversee all project documentation, including milestone and task status, internal and external reports, and executive summaries.
  • Produce reporting for cross-functional managers to ensure company policies are followed.

Risk Management

  • Identify project risks and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Resolve conflicts or delays during execution and escalate issues as needed.

Process Improvement

  • Evaluate business processes, procedures, and systems; develop and run improvement projects to drive efficiency and reduce cost.
  • Work cross-functionally to develop, document, and implement guidelines, evaluations, recruitment, and promotion processes.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Construction Management, Telecommunications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience in tenant finish-out project management, expediting, and logistics management.
  • Experience with inspections and regulatory compliance.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of structured cabling, fiber optics, and network hardware (routers, switches, access points).
  • Knowledge of technologies and materials used in telecommunications site designs.
  • Familiarity with industry standards and best practices (e.g., TIA/EIA, BICSI).
  • Awareness of general accounting and costing practices, including budgeting, invoicing, purchase orders, and accounts payable.
  • Proficient in project management tools (MS Project, Smartsheet) and technical documentation software (AutoCAD).
  • Proficient in CRM, ERP, billing, and other enterprise systems, and in Microsoft Office (Project, Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong leadership: giving direction, implementing action, and defining and measuring success, while working as part of a team.
  • Competency in customer experience, change and innovation, strategic thinking, relationship-building and influencing, and results-focused leadership.
  • Ability to identify project-impacting issues and work with the PM team to implement solutions.
  • Understanding of the critical milestones that drive operational excellence.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with people at all levels inside and outside the company.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented; able to manage multiple projects, budgets, and timelines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CAPM, PMP, or equivalent project management certification.
  • Networking certifications (e.g., CCNA, CompTIA Network+).

WHY JOIN GIGSTREEM

  • Lead a high impact team at a growing, innovative company serving the multifamily and property management industry.
  • Opportunity to shape the future of the account management function as we scale nationally.
  • Remote-first culture with collaborative, forward-thinking peers.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package, with strong growth potential.

This position is 100% remote. Applicants must have a dedicated home workstation for focused work and on-camera meetings.

COMPENSATION

Salary range: $75,000-$100,000

Gigstreem is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. Job Title:

Business Development Manager, Formulated Solutions | Remote Germany or France

Job Description:

Why Work at Entegris

At Entegris, we help the world’s most innovative companies solve their toughest technology challenges. Our advanced materials and process solutions are critical to the manufacturing of semiconductors and other high-technology products that power modern life.

Our culture is built on innovation, accountability, integrity, and collaboration. We encourage employees to contribute ideas, take ownership, and work across functions and regions to create meaningful value for our customers and our business.    


The Role

Entegris is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager, Formulated Solutions to join our global Formulated Solutions team. This is a fully remote position based in either Germany or France.

In this highly visible role, you will help drive business growth by strengthening strategic customer relationships, developing new market opportunities, and helping shape the direction of our Formulated Solutions portfolio for the semiconductor industry.

This is a business development and product strategy role working at the intersection of customers, Sales, Product Management, and technology. You will translate customer and market needs into commercial opportunities and product priorities.

Partnering closely with Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Engineering, Operations, and Quality, you will help identify growth opportunities, guide strategic decisions, and bring advanced solutions to market.


What You’ll Do

  • Drive growth across strategic customers and develop new business opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to expand the Entegris portfolio in existing and new markets.
  • Build strong relationships with key customers and understand their evolving needs, priorities, and technology roadmaps.
  • Translate customer insights, market trends, and competitive dynamics into business opportunities and product strategies.
  • Partner with Sales to position Formulated Solutions offerings with strategic customers.
  • Provide market and customer insights that help shape product and portfolio strategies.
  • Connect Sales, Marketing, Product Management, and strategic planning to align commercial opportunities with product priorities.
  • Contribute to product lifecycle activities, including requirements, roadmaps, product introductions, sustaining activities, and end-of-life planning.
  • Apply commercial and financial insight to business cases, pricing, margins, and key performance indicators.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration to address complex customer and business challenges and drive timely execution.
  • Support the introduction and commercialization of innovative consumable products for semiconductor fabrication applications.
  • Develop trusted relationships with stakeholders across our global organization.
  • Travel to customer locations and Entegris facilities in Europe, the United States, and other international locations as required.

What We Seek

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant qualification.
  • Typically 8+ years of relevant experience in business development, product management, commercial leadership, or a related role within the chemical, semiconductor, advanced materials, or manufacturing industries.
  • A strong track record of developing business, growing customer relationships, and identifying commercial opportunities.
  • Experience with product management and the product lifecycle, including requirements, roadmaps, product launches, sustaining activities, and end-of-life decisions.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience with business cases, pricing, margin drivers, and KPIs.
  • The ability to translate customer and market needs into actionable business and product strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and align stakeholders across different functions and geographies.
  • Strong project leadership, communication, presentation, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • A collaborative working style and the ability to operate effectively in an international environment.
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally, up to 50% depending on customer and business needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the semiconductor industry or related advanced-technology markets.
  • Knowledge of semiconductor fabrication processes and related consumable products.
  • Familiarity with chemistries used in wafer cleaning, polishing, or etching applications.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, Power BI, Accolade, SAP, or Oracle.
  • Additional European language skills, particularly German or French, are an advantage.
  • Strong learning agility and the ability to quickly develop knowledge of new technologies, applications, and markets.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote position based in either Germany or France.
  • A comprehensive compensation and benefits package tailored to the country of employment.
  • A high-impact role at the intersection of business development, product strategy, and commercial growth.
  • The opportunity to work directly with strategic customers and influence the future direction of our Formulated Solutions portfolio.
  • Close collaboration with colleagues across Sales, Product Management, Marketing, Engineering, Operations, and Quality.
  • Exposure to customers, teams, and business opportunities across Europe, the United States, and other global markets.
  • A high degree of ownership, visibility, and international collaboration.

If you are a commercially minded business development professional who combines a strong understanding of customers and markets with the ability to influence product strategy, we invite you to apply and help shape the future of Entegris’ Formulated Solutions business.


Entegris is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background or identity.


Please submit your application and CV in English, as our hiring team works internationally.

We are looking for a Director of Digital PR to join our growing team at Wpromote! Our ideal candidate has a passion for building strong client relationships, deep experience leading digital PR strategy for B2B brands and campaign execution, and the ability to lead, train, and grow a team. A successful candidate is a true earned media expert - someone with a strong point of view on campaign concepting and data-led storytelling, and a clear vision for building brand authority for clients as search and discovery evolve alongside LLMs and AI platforms.
At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

-Remote-first culture

-Work from anywhere options*
-100% paid parental leave
-401(k) matching

-Annual Class Pass credits and more!

The total compensation package for this role will include benefits and an annual performance bonus.
This role has an associated annual target bonus component which is paid out based on a number of factors which include Company performance, department performance, and individual performance. Bonuses are not guaranteed and you must be an active employee in good standing and not on a Performance Improvement Plan to be eligible for the annual bonus.
*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions
**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!
***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship
Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams

If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

You Will Be

You Must Have

  • Experience developing and leading Digital PR campaigns for B2B clients, with an understanding of how to build stories around complex products, industries, and decision-makers.
  • 2+ years of people management experience leading and coaching a high-performing team
  • Advanced knowledge of Pitchbox (or comparable platform) and can use the tool inside and out
  • Experience building and executing enterprise Digital PR campaigns, including data-led studies and expert commentary programs
  • Demonstrated ability to lead outreach and placement strategy to improve earned media performance
  • Experience with SEO and PR tools such as Profound, Ahrefs, SEMrush, and Cision
  • Deep understanding of current and future digital trends, including how LLMs and AI platforms are changing content discovery and brand authority

  • Familiarity with reporting and visualization platforms, including Google Analytics and Looker Studio

As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.
Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.
We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

Agiloft is looking for a Sales Enablement Program Manager to build the programs that keep our go-to-market teams ramped, current, and ready drive growth to win. You'll own enablement programs from discovery to delivery, and ongoing skills development for product launches, certifications, and sales excellence that empower reps to achieve their targets.

You'll partner with Sales, Customer Success, Alliances, Product, Marketing, and RevOps to turn business priorities into measurable programs. This is a high-ownership individual contributor role for someone who builds programs, runs them, and proves their business impact with data.

Job Responsibilities

    What You'll Do

    • Own programs end to end. Own enablement programs end to end, from scoping and needs analysis through build, rollout, measurement, and iteration.
    • Translate strategy into programs. Partner with GTM leaders to turn business priorities into clear program goals, owners, and timelines, and communicate trade-offs and progress to leadership.
    • Facilitate and coach. Lead live trainings and workshops for audiences from new hires to senior leaders, and help front-line managers reinforce new behaviors in the field.
    • Drive ongoing development. Deliver skills training (discovery, qualification, deal strategy), product launches, competitive updates, and certifications using repeatable frameworks new content can drop into.
    • Create content that sticks. Build playbooks, battlecards, talk tracks, decks, role plays, and async modules with Product, Marketing, and subject matter experts.
    • Scale with technology and AI. Lead adoption of enablement tools and apply AI to streamline content creation, reporting, and knowledge sharing.
    • Collaborate on role-based onboarding. Work with Define "fully ramped" criteria by role and deliver learning paths that get new hires customer-ready quickly.
    • Measure impact. Track ramp time, certification completion, content usage, and field KPIs using Salesforce and LMS data; report results and iterate.
    • Collaborate & Utilize the GTM knowledge base. Keep messaging, collateral, and product content accurate, organized, and easy to find with the enablement team.

Required Qualifications

    What You Bring

    • 5+ years in sales or revenue enablement, learning and development, or a closely related role, including 3+ years managing programs end to end in B2B SaaS.
    • A track record of building and running programs, not just contributing to them, with measurable business results.
    • Strong facilitation, communication, and coaching skills: you can distill a complex topic and make it land with any audience.
    • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, building a coaching culture to enable reps to achieve growth goals.
    • Hands-on use of AI tools to automate processes and improve enablement content and delivery.
    • A data-driven approach, with experience building Salesforce and LMS reports that connect programs to field outcomes.

Location: Remote (US-based). Full time. Reports to the Head of Customer Success and Sales. Travel to 10-15 veterinary conferences a year (up to about 30%).

About the Role: pawlicy.com/careers

Every day, pet owners walk out of a vet's office having just said no to a treatment their pet needed, not because they didn't care, but because they couldn't afford it. Pawlicy Advisor exists to eliminate this problem. Pawlicy Advisor is a profitable venture-backed startup building the infrastructure that connects pet owners to the right financial protection for their pets, starting with the most trusted pet insurance marketplace in the US, distributed through thousands of veterinary practices nationwide. We help pet owners make better financial decisions for their pets. The company has delivered over 1 million unique quotes, has raised $19M+, has found product-market fit, and is now scaling.

Pawlicy Advisor is now hiring for an Onboarding Specialist, Vet Success.

Every week, new clinics sign up to partner with Pawlicy. Your job is to turn those signups into active partners who recommend us to pet parents. You'll own new partners from their first day, you're the voice they hear first, the person who gets them set up, and the one who makes sure the partnership takes off.

This is a phone-first, high-volume call role: you will make >40 calls a day. You will own and build relationships throughout onboarding. The role requires organization and follow-through as much as warmth and personality.

What you'll do

  • Conduct 200+ phone conversations every week
  • Run live onboarding calls with every new partner within its first 30 days.
  • Respond to veterinary teams with follow-up emails and calls same day
  • Maintain daily, up-to-date records in the internal CRM system
  • Travel to veterinary conferences several times a year to work our booth, meet clinic teams in person, and kick off onboarding for the clinics that sign up.
  • Get partners activated: accounts set up, teams trained, materials in use, and customers engaging.
  • Introduce our integrated partner program to eligible partners, and guide the interested ones through setup and go-live.
  • Keep clean records in Custify and Pipedrive so the team always knows where each account stands.
  • Stay with accounts that need extra support. Hand off accounts off to a strong start to our Customer Success team.
  • Spot patterns in what new partners struggle with and bring them back to the team so we can fix them.

What success looks like in your first six months

  • Every new partner in your book gets a live call by day 30.
  • Your cohorts hit our activation benchmarks by day 90.
  • Eligible partners in your book are moving onto the integrated program.

Requirements

  • 2+ years in a role where you handled 40+ calls a day: customer onboarding, recruiting, customer success, customer support, SDR, BDR, inside sales or a vet hospital CSR running callbacks. You enjoy being on the phone most of every day, and see direct communication as a way to get things done.
  • Comfortable building relationships on the phone and capable of building rapport in the first minute with a busy counterparty.
  • Organization at volume. You can juggle hundreds of accounts at different stages without anything slipping.
  • Comfort with a light, helpful upsell. You recommend the next step because it's good for the customer.
  • Comfort working in client management tools, whether that's a CRM, a customer success platform or a practice management system.
  • Able to travel to 10-15 conferences a year, typically 2 to 4 days each. You're comfortable meeting people face to face at a busy booth.
  • You work well remotely and set your own rhythm.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
  • Must be based in the USA.

Nice to have

  • Onboarding or implementation experience with customers, clients or patients.
  • Experience upselling or recommending products or services.
  • Veterinary clinic experience, preference CVT/RVT or practice management
  • Experience working trade shows, conferences or in-person events.
  • Familiarity with pet insurance, or with Custify, Pipedrive or Aircall.

Benefits

  • Base salary range: $65,000 to $85,000.
  • Bonus potential tied to onboarding results.
  • Startup equity grant.
  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) employer contributions; flexible vacation.
  • Remote-first within the United States.

Company

Navitus

About Us

Navitus - Putting People First in Pharmacy - Navitus was founded as an alternative to traditional pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) models. We are committed to removing cost from the drug supply chain to make medications more affordable for the people who need them. At Navitus, our team members work in an environment that celebrates diversity, fosters creativity and encourages growth. We welcome new ideas and share a passion for excellent service to our customers and each other.. Current associates must use SSO login option at to be considered for internal opportunities. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees and comply with all applicable nondiscrimination regulations, including those related to protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or handicap.

Pay Range

USD $116,019.00 - USD $145,024.00 /Yr.

STAR Bonus % (At Risk Maximum)

7.50 - Salaried Non-Management except pharmacists

Work Schedule Description (e.g. M-F 8am to 5pm)

M-F 8am to 5pm

Remote Work Notification

ATTENTION: Navitus is only able to offer remote work to residents of Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Washington DC, Wisconsin.

Overview

Due to growth, we are adding a Platform Product Manager to our team!

The Platform Product Manager owns the vision, strategy, and lifecycle of Navitus' claims adjudication platform and the connected enterprise platform capabilities that support PBM products and solutions. The portfolio includes claims processing, data and analytics, integration and APIs, clinical enablement, automation, and client-facing platform capabilities. This role turns claims adjudication platform capabilities into a cohesive, productized business portfolio through a two-in-a-box model that tightly connects business strategy, commercialization priorities, and technology delivery.

The Platform Product Manager establishes clear business ownership and decision rights, prioritizes investments based on customer, market, and enterprise value, and ensures platform capabilities are positioned, adopted, and scaled across products, clients, and business units. Operating across product, operations, clinical, data, market strategy, sales enablement, and client-facing teams, the position leads a product-centered platform operating model. The role translates claims adjudication platform capabilities into market-ready solutions, client value, adoption plans, sales support, and measurable business outcomes.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Own the claims adjudication platform product portfolio and serve as the accountable product leader for platform vision, strategy, roadmaps, investment priorities, performance, and lifecycle decisions.
  • Make and recommend portfolio tradeoffs based on customer value, enterprise strategy, market opportunity, financial impact, operational readiness, and delivery feasibility.
  • Align executive stakeholders and cross-functional leaders on platform priorities, sequencing, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.
  • Represent claims adjudication platform product strategy in enterprise portfolio, investment, commercialization, sales enablement, and client readiness forums.
  • Define and maintain a multi-year claims adjudication platform strategy and roadmap aligned with enterprise product strategy, market needs, client value, operational requirements, and commercialization priorities.
  • Manage the claims adjudication platform portfolio as a strategic product rather than a set of individual projects, with clear value propositions, customers, users, roadmaps, funding needs, and success measures.
  • Define platform capabilities as modular, reusable components that support multiple products, clients, channels, and business units.
  • Identify fragmentation, duplication, capability gaps, and legacy constraints, then establish plans to consolidate, modernize, replace, or retire capabilities.
  • Own business decisions for platform launch sequencing, adoption, enhancement priorities, market positioning, and lifecycle planning in partnership with accountable technology and operational leaders.
  • Maintain a transparent portfolio view of dependencies, risks, investment needs, and expected business impact.
  • Lead continuous discovery with clients, prospects, partners, product teams, engineering teams, operations, and other platform users to understand needs, pain points, and emerging opportunities.
  • Translate enterprise and product needs into claims adjudication platform capabilities, product requirements, roadmaps, and prioritized backlogs.
  • Prioritize work using customer value, business outcomes, risk reduction, platform reuse, delivery effort, reliability, and strategic fit.
  • Create effective feedback loops from production performance, users, clients, operations, and delivery teams to guide ongoing improvement.
  • Establish a consistent platform governance model for intake, evaluation, prioritization, investment, delivery, adoption, and lifecycle decisions.
  • Ensure platform roadmaps account for healthcare regulation, privacy, client commitments, market expectations, operational readiness, and commercialization requirements.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, information systems, engineering, data science, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, required.
  • 10+ years of progressive product management experience, including leadership of enterprise-scale platforms, platform portfolios, or complex technology products required.
  • Demonstrated experience commercializing complex business platforms, shared capabilities, transaction platforms, or enterprise products that support multiple clients, users, or business units required.
  • Experience building reusable capabilities that support multiple products, users, clients, or business units required.
  • Experience setting product strategy, managing roadmaps and backlogs, making investment tradeoffs, and measuring product outcomes required.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment and influencing executive, business, and technology stakeholders required.
  • Experience with agile product development, continuous discovery, design thinking, and product lifecycle management required.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate platform capabilities into customer, market, operational, commercial, and financial value required.
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
  • The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.

What can you expect from Navitus?

  • Top of the industry benefits for Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • 20 days paid time off
  • 4 weeks paid parental leave
  • 9 paid holidays
  • 401K company match of up to 5% - No vesting requirement
  • Adoption Assistance Program
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Educational Assistance Plan and Professional Membership assistance
  • Referral Bonus Program – up to $750!
