IMPAG is a renowned, internationally active trading and service company headquartered in Zurich, with subsidiaries in Germany, France, Austria, Spain, and Poland.

We combine market insight, technical expertise, and regulatory excellence to deliver innovative solutions for the personal care industry. To strengthen our growing Business Unit Personal Care in Warsaw, we are looking for a Regulatory Specialist Personal Care who combines strong expertise in personal care legislation and product safety with a structured, detail-oriented approach and a proactive, collaborative mindset.

Your mission @ IMPAG

You will be responsible for the Personal Care regulatory area at IMPAG Poland and will be a member of the international Regulatory Group within IMPAG Group. You will provide regulatory support to our Personal Care divisions, focusing on cosmetic legislation and ensuring compliance with European and national chemical regulations.

Work @ IMPAG

  • Ensure compliance with applicable chemical and product safety regulations, including REACH, CLP/GHS and relevant national and EU legislation.

  • Manage regulatory aspects of product onboarding, including the review, verification, and maintenance of product-related data and documentation.

  • Prepare, maintain and manage Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and regulatory documentation.

  • Classify products according to chemical and dangerous goods legislation.

  • Develop and verify product labeling in accordance with regulatory requirements.

  • Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on our product portfolio and business activities.

  • Provide regulatory guidance and support to employees across the organization, while coordinating with suppliers and customers.

  • Conduct regulatory research, data analysis and internal training activities.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of regulatory processes and compliance standards across the organization.

Benefits @ IMPAG

  • A challenging and diverse role combining regulatory affairs, product compliance and collaboration with international partners.

  • The opportunity to work with innovative ingredients and solutions for the personal care industry.

  • A collaborative and supportive team culture where expertise, initiative and knowledge sharing are highly valued.

  • A high level of autonomy and independence in managing your responsibilities and professional development.

  • International cooperation within our IMPAG Group and exposure to global regulatory developments.

  • Professional development opportunities, training and support to grow your regulatory expertise.

  • Attractive benefits and a long-term perspective in a stable, growing organization.

Culture @ IMPAG

  • We have been successful for more than 100 years and aim to achieve great things together.

  • We are courageous, responsible, reliable, and entrepreneurial in our thinking.

  • We work together and celebrate our successes as a team.

Requirements

Competences @ IMPAG

  • University degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, biotechnology, regulatory affairs or a related scientific field.

  • Experience in regulatory affairs, product safety or compliance within the chemical, cosmetics, personal care or related industry.

  • Good knowledge of European and national chemical legislation, especially REACH and CLP/GHS.

  • Understanding of product safety requirements and regulatory documentation.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining effective collaboration with cross-functional teams.

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.

  • Fluent in Polish and English; German would be a strong advantage.

  • Confident use of MS Office applications and regulatory data management systems.

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Product Operations team is looking for a hands-on builder to join our Platform team and help accelerate our enterprise-ready roadmap. You will support the Billing, Org & Auth, and Security product teams, working closely with R&D leaders to turn ambiguous questions into rigorous analyses, repeatable workflows, and internal tools used across our Product and Engineering organization.

You move ARR. Not "contribute to." Revenue (or an equivalent business result) grows because of decisions you made. You might investigate why enterprise customers stall on a security or permissions requirement, combine signals from thousands of support tickets and customer conversations to find what's blocking expansion, or build a dashboard that helps hundreds of product managers and engineers see how platform gaps translate into pipeline and retention risk.

This is an individual-contributor role for someone who has already shown they can build and ship. You do not need a technical background. However, you do need to use modern AI and development tools to move beyond a prototype: work with data, write and debug code using AI, validate the results, put a useful tool in front of users, and improve it until people trust and rely on it.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and, most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set you up for success and have built a culture of rapid career development, with countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: Our vision to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that encourages you to do your best.
  • You measure yourself by revenue outcomes: You want your work tied directly to ARR, and you're accountable for the result, not just the activity.

In this role, you will:

  • Drive ARR through platform decisions.Identify the enterprise-readiness gaps that most limit new business, expansion, and retention, and shape prioritization so that fixing them measurably moves ARR.
  • Accelerate enterprise-ready deliveryby partnering with the Billing, Org & Auth, and Security product teams to define priorities, remove blockers, and track progress against the commitments customers and Sales are waiting on.
  • Build and ship internal data and AI products that help Product and Engineering teams understand platform usage, customer friction, and the highest-impact opportunities to improve.
  • Analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured data, including product telemetry, support tickets, customer conversations, feature requests, surveys, and product metadata, to find patterns that would be difficult to see manually.
  • Turn one-time analyses into reliable, repeatable tools and workflows with clear data definitions, quality checks, documentation, and feedback loops.
  • Translate complex findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations for R&D leadership, while preserving the evidence and methodology behind them.
  • Quantify the revenue impact of platform investments and report on it, so every roadmap bet has a clear, defensible ARR case before and after launch.
  • Own projects end to end: scope the problem, identify and connect the right data, build the first version, launch it, measure adoption and business impact, and continue improving it.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully, checking outputs, debugging failures, and applying sound judgment rather than treating generated work as automatically correct.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in a role such as product operations, data or product analytics, business operations, consulting, technical product management, or another environment where you solved ambiguous problems with data and technology.
  • A demonstrated record of building and shipping something useful for real users, such as an internal tool, application, dashboard, automation, data product, or repeatable analytical workflow.
  • A track record of connecting your work to revenue or an equivalent business result (ARR, retention, expansion, cost), and the ability to show how your decisions caused it.
  • Experience structuring and analyzing messy or large datasets, validating the results, and explaining what the analysis does and does not prove.
  • Strong product and customer judgment: you start with the user problem and business outcome, not the technology.
  • Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain technical or analytical work to non-technical partners and executives without losing the important details.
  • High ownership, curiosity, and attention to detail. You are comfortable learning quickly, asking sharp questions, forming a point of view, and iterating through ambiguity.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in a B2B technology company or working closely with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Experience in Product Operations functions: defining and tracking product roadmaps and feature requests, and bringing the voice of the customer to every product conversation.
  • Familiarity with enterprise platform domains such as billing and monetization, identity, access, and org management, or security and compliance, and with what enterprise buyers require in each.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$126,000—$225,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

Building influencer/creator partnerships into a standalone, scalable, and profitable customer-acquisition channel—with a repeatable system for identifying winning creators, testing new opportunities, and aggressively scaling what works.

Responsibilities

We are seeking two IT Project Managers to join our growing team and drive the delivery of application development and technology projects/products. Reporting to the Project Management Office (PMO), these individuals will turn business priorities into results by taking initiative, creating momentum, securing decisions, removing obstacles, and holding stakeholders accountable for commitments.

Success in these roles means moving work forward. You will challenge assumptions, resolve competing priorities, and develop practical options when delivery is at risk. Strong planning and communication support this work; measurable business outcomes define success.

You will also use approved artificial intelligence (AI) tools and automation to simplify project administration and improve PMO processes and procedures, creating more capacity for problem-solving, stakeholder engagement, and delivery execution.

The Project Manager and Technical Delivery Manager work together as execution partners with clear, complementary responsibilities:

  • The Technical Delivery Manager owns engineering execution, including technical delivery planning and coordination of engineering work
  • The Project Manager drives the organization around engineering, aligning business stakeholders, vendors, decisions, cross-team dependencies, resources, and business readiness
  • Together, they drive the outcome, maintaining a shared view of delivery priorities, risks, tradeoffs, and commitments

Drive Outcomes and Accountability

  • Lead medium- to high-complexity technology projects from initiation through implementation and business acceptance, with clear ownership of commitments and measurable success criteria
  • Translate business objectives into actionable delivery plans with defined outcomes, accountable owners, and realistic timelines
  • Proactively secure decisions by identifying decision-makers, presenting options and tradeoffs, recommending a path forward, and following through to resolution
  • Resolve dependencies by coordinating across teams, challenging unnecessary sequencing, and negotiating commitments that enable progress
  • Identify delivery obstacles early and take action to remove them. Escalate issues with clear options, recommendations, and specific requests for support.
  • Develop and execute recovery options when delivery is at risk, working with the Technical Delivery Manager and business stakeholders to assess scope, timing, resource, and cost tradeoffs
  • Hold stakeholders, vendors, and project participants accountable for commitments, addressing missed commitments promptly and constructively

Enable Technical Delivery and Business Readiness

  • Own business and vendor coordination, cross-functional dependencies, stakeholder alignment, and organizational readiness
  • Work with business analysts to clarify requirements and help business customers evaluate solution options, costs, timelines, and readiness needs
  • Secure timely agreement on scope, priorities, acceptance criteria, and deliverables from sponsors and key stakeholders
  • Manage project scope, resources, finances, risks, and issues with a focus on informed decisions and successful delivery
  • Communicate progress through outcomes achieved, decisions needed, delivery risks, and actions underway
  • Work with product managers and owners to build forward-looking plans and roadmaps that connect technology delivery to business value.
  • Coordinate business readiness and implementation activities, confirming ownership for adoption, operational handoffs, and measurement of intended benefits.

Use AI and Automation to Improve PMO Effectiveness

  • Use approved AI tools and automation to reduce manual effort in status reporting, meeting summaries, action tracking, documentation, and routine coordination
  • Apply the time saved to resolving problems, accelerating decisions, removing obstacles, and supporting delivery teams
  • Challenge existing PMO processes and eliminate unnecessary meetings, reports, approvals, and duplicate data entry while preserving essential governance
  • Develop scalable, repeatable practices, templates, and workflows that improve delivery effectiveness and simplify how teams work
  • Use AI-assisted analysis to identify potential risks, dependencies, and planning gaps, validating findings with reliable data and accountable stakeholders
  • Partner with PMO leadership to pilot and scale improvements, measuring administrative effort reduced, decision turnaround time, delivery predictability, and other relevant outcomes
  • Apply human judgment and review to AI-generated outputs and follow company requirements for information security, privacy, and responsible AI use
  • Turn retrospectives and lessons learned into implemented improvements, and help teams adopt more effective tools and practices

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 7+ years of project management experience delivering medium- to high-complexity projects
  • 7+ years of experience in information technology and business/industry
  • Demonstrated success personally moving complex projects forward by securing decisions, removing obstacles, resolving dependencies, and recovering at-risk delivery
  • Experience managing software product delivery and partnering effectively with technical or engineering delivery leaders
  • Ability to lead through influence, challenge assumptions constructively, navigate competing priorities, and hold stakeholders accountable across organizational boundaries
  • Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to develop options, explain tradeoffs, and recommend a practical course of action
  • Applied understanding of Waterfall and Agile methodologies and the Systems Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Experience facilitating Agile practices, including sprint planning and retrospectives, in partnership with technical delivery leadership
  • Strong Jira knowledge, including planning, tracking, reporting, and workflow management
  • Experience improving PMO practices or leading AI adoption and workflow automation is a plus
  • Practical experience using AI-enabled tools or automation to improve project delivery or business processes, with the ability to validate outputs and assess measurable benefits
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and presentation skills, including the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders at all management levels
  • Experience managing project financials, resources, vendors, and cross-functional commitments
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred
  • Experience with cross-functional Salesforce project management is a plus

About Our Company

All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, genetic information or any other status or condition protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. raw.description:
Description

Unpacked for Educators is searching for a Senior Educator to run our teen programs, from school retreats to regional fellowships to Jewish camps. Working with the Senior Program Director, who sets program strategy, this person keeps Unpacked Scholars, our fellowships, and our camp programming on track. They serve as the day-to-day contact for partner schools and camps, coordinate our Education Associates, and spend real time in the room facilitating retreats and sessions. The teens in these programs return to their schools and communities ready to elevate the Jewish conversation, and this is the person who makes those experiences happen.

Unpacked for Educators is the education division of OpenDor Media, a leading global nonprofit media company. Through Unpacked Teens, we develop thoughtful young Jewish leaders, using retreats, fellowships, camps, and immersive experiences to help teens explore their identity, engage with Israel in meaningful ways, and build a national community.

Requirements

What this role owns:

  • Scholars and fellowships. Serve as the day-to-day contact for partner schools and sites. Keep Unpacked Scholars and our regional teen fellowships, in places like Bergen County,NJ, Houston, LA and through our USY partnership, running consistently and on schedule.
  • Camps Partnerships and programming. Lead our work with Jewish camps, from relationships with camp directors to site visits, staff training, and sessions that bring Unpacked content into informal, experiential settings.
  • Facilitation in the room. Facilitate retreats and fellowship sessions where teens explore Jewish identity and Israel with nuance and honesty, and build lasting relationships with teens.
  • Curriculum. Create and refine sessions, lesson plans and decks rooted in Project-Based Learning and experiential education, and review materials for quality before use.
  • Coordination and Mentoring the Education Associates. Coordinate Education Associates’ schedules and retreat prep, mentor them in facilitation and content, and support speaking engagements for Unpacked for Educators and ConnectED.

What we’re looking for

  • A program leader and a natural teacher. This role calls for someone who has taught in the classroom and can also take programs from plan to execution, with the logistics, partners, and deadlines that come with them.
  • Someone who comes alive in the room. We need a facilitator who loves leading a large group of teens and can help them explore hard questions honestly.
  • A relationship builder. This role depends on earning the trust of school administrators, camp directors, and teens, and on keeping those relationships strong between programs.
  • Calm across many moving parts. This role requires someone who stays organized and uses sound judgment when retreats, schedules, and deliverables all land in the same week.

What You Have:

  • 5+ years in Jewish and Israel education, including classroom teaching (ideally high school) and at least 2 years running or coordinating educational programs.
  • A bachelor's degree in education or Jewish studies.
  • Strong facilitation skills and comfort leading large groups of teens.
  • A track record of taking programs from plan to execution, including logistics, timelines, partner communication, and deliverables.
  • Deep Israel and Jewish content knowledge and the ability to design strong sessions and review the work of others.
  • Experience building working relationships with schools, camps, or community partners.
  • Organization and sound judgment with many priorities in motion.
  • Commitment to our core values, including being proudly Zionist and rooted in nuance and complexity.
  • Comfort with Google Workspace, Slack, Wrike, and Zoom, and day-to-day use of AI tools such as Claude.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, mostly national trips on weekdays, plus summer camp visits. Living in or near New York or New Jersey is a plus.

Bonus points for (Not required)

  • Experience in the Jewish camp field, as staff, educator, or partner.
  • Experience mentoring or supervising educators, staff, or counselors.
  • Familiarity with Project-Based Learning, Learning by Design, and experiential education.
  • Experience with grant reporting or program data.
  • Hebrew proficiency and familiarity with Israeli audiences.

Who We Are:

OpenDor Media is a leading global non-profit media company for the 21st century. We educate, entertain, and engage our audiences by bringing to life big ideas and authentic stories, and by celebrating all things Jewish.

At Unpacked for Educators (a division of OpenDor Media), our goal is to explore the Jewish story in all its complexity, intellectual depth and sophistication. Our goal is to help students see that Judaism is as meaningful and relevant as ever.

Our nuanced educational content and resources are used by a global community of educators around the world and across all political and religious spectrums.

We push the boundaries of innovation, creativity and good old hard work. From our leadership team to new and veteran team members, we all strive to embody our core values:

Fueled by creativity: We think and act creatively in everything we do with the agility and flexibility to apply creativity, whatever role we play.

Inspired by excellence: We are driven to excel at whatever we do. Our teams are always ready to go the extra mile to get the very best results.

Powered by positivity: We bring positivity to work every day, for a fun, creative and inviting work environment that brings out the best in everyone.

Driven by self-improvement: Like our content, no issue is taboo and we are open to constructive ways to improve and develop into the best professionals we can be.

Empowered by collaboration: We thrive on sharing knowledge, teamwork, being a “mensch”, and leveraging each and everyone’s talents to achieve a sum that is greater than the parts.

Benefits

Some benefits and perks of working at OpenDor Media

  • Fully remote with flexibility to work from anywhere
  • Competitive salary
  • Paid days off for Jewish and national holidays as well as vacation and sick time available
  • Comprehensive Healthcare coverage including health, dental, vision, company paid life and LTD insurance.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match
  • High level of autonomy and direct access to leadership
  • A warm, collaborative culture and great colleagues

Salary

Our target salary range for this position is $95,000 to $105,000 annually for a U.S.-based candidate. The final salary will be determined based on careful consideration of several factors, including the candidate’s location, experience in similar roles, and expertise related to the qualifications above.

Preferred Qualifications

raw.description:
About Kasa

Kasa is the leading tech-enabled hotel and apartment hotel brand and manager. We partner with owners of multifamily and boutique hospitality properties to deliver stylish, professionally managed accommodations to business and leisure travelers alike. We took the best that hotels and short-term rentals had to offer and created a new class of hospitality that is well-priced, reliable, and offers a large selection of great locations.

Unlike traditional hotel operators, we prioritize automation, AI-driven pricing, and data-driven decision-making to optimize revenue and improve guest experiences. Behind the scenes, we build technology that combines with our innovative operations to grow a globally scalable offering that delivers high-quality stays to guests. Our guests enjoy seamless check-ins, caring service, and attractive amenities — and if anything comes up, our on-site and remote guest experience team is available throughout their stay, ensuring our hospitality is rarely seen but always felt.

Role Overview

Kasa is seeking a visionary, systems-oriented Vice President of Financeto serve as the company’s top financial leader, reporting directly to the CEO. The mandate of the role is to build a high-precision finance engine that can support Kasa’s continued growth across a complex hospitality and real estate platform.

The VP of Finance will lead a global team of ~25 across the U.S., Mexico, and the Philippines and will transform the function into a faster, more automated, and more insightful function while maintaining best-in-class reporting accuracy for property owners and investors.

The priorities of this role are to:

  • Ensure accurate financial reporting across all entities and properties
  • Deliver predictable close and owner reporting cycles
  • Elevate the depth and value of financial reporting, including balance sheet, cash flow, and KPI segmentation
  • Drive efficiency and automation while maintaining accuracy and rigor

This role sits at the center of Kasa’s platform, touching every property, contract structure, and strategic initiative, and provides meaningful exposure to the Board, investors, and property owners as the organization's primary financial leader.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Reporting

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across corporate entities and 85+ property-level agreements
  • Oversee complex accounting including multi-contract structures, revenue recognition, intercompany allocations, and compliance with USALI, GAAP, and multi-jurisdiction tax rules
  • Lead external audits and maintain ongoing audit readiness
  • Ensure property-level and corporate reporting delivers accurate, insightful, and timely financial information

Revenue & Cash Integrity

  • Oversee cash reconciliations across bookings, leases, and multiple payment methods
  • Manage revenue adjustments, including cancellations, chargebacks, and timing differences
  • Maintain strong financial controls over bank accounts, cash, and owner-facing reporting

Operational Transformation & Automation

  • Audit and redesign workflows to improve efficiency, reliability, and scalability
  • Implement AI and automation in reconciliation, variance detection, and reporting, while maintaining rigorous internal controls
  • Streamline monthly close, reporting, and FP&A processes to increase speed and insight

FP&A, Strategic Growth & Capital

  • Lead budgeting, rolling forecasts, and cash flow planning at property and corporate levels
  • Provide actionable insights to inform CEO, Board, and leadership decisions
  • Partner on fundraising, debt refinancing, and strategic capital initiatives
  • Model new fee structures, contract economics, and growth initiatives to maximize profitability

Team & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Lead and develop a distributed finance team across the US, Mexico, and the Philippines
  • Build a culture of accountability, precision, and continuous improvement
  • Communicate clearly with Board, investors, executive leadership, and property owners

Qualifications

Industry & Experience

  • 15+ years leading finance teams in hospitality, travel, or real estate
  • Expertise with USALI, management agreements, and lease accounting
  • Experience managing multi-entity, multi-contract operations
  • Deep understanding of property-level P&Ls and owner reporting
  • CPA preferred; Big 4 a plus but not required with equivalent experience

Systems & Technical Expertise

  • Proficient in NetSuite, Adaptive Insights, and BI tools such as Looker
  • Skilled at integrating systems and streamlining workflows across AP, payroll, and revenue reconciliation
  • Strong knowledge of high-volume transactional accounting
  • Experienced partnering with product or engineering teams to improve systems and data flows

Forensic & Builder Mindset

  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to trace financial anomalies
  • Builds repeatable, controlled, and documented processes
  • Track record of simplifying complex financial systems
  • Forward-looking approach to AI and automation while maintaining strong controls

Communication & Leadership

  • Translate complex agreements and structures into clear, actionable insights
  • Serve as primary financial voice with leadership, Board, and investors
  • Collaborative, credible, and calm leader of distributed teams

Why This Role Is Different

  • You will “upgrade the engine while the plane is flying”
  • Finance is a strategic weapon at Kasa, not a back-office function
  • Significant autonomy, visibility, and long-term upside as the company continues to scale with a clear path to broader financial leadership as the platform evolves

What success looks like in the first year

Key Performance Indicator (KPI)

Target

Monthly Financial Close Timeline

Achieve a D+10 close (from the current 20 days).

Manual Intervention Rate for Revenue Reconciliation / Post Close Adjustments

Reduce the percentage of revenue reconciliations requiring manual intervention by >50%

Reduce post-close adjustments by >50%

AI/Automation Deployment

Deploy automations that provide material uplift in team output and efficiency (e.g., AI-Powered Revenue Reconciliation Triage Tool or AI-Generated Owner Narrative Drafting Tool) into production.

Documented control framework in place

  • Written close checklist
  • Reconciliation standards
  • Exception thresholds defined
  • Owner-reporting SLA adherence > 98%

Strategic Insights

Finance consistently surfacing actionable insights that directly inform pricing, cost structure, capital allocation, and growth decisions across the business.

Curious about the Kasa experience? Save 15% when you book on

Benefits

  • Leadership coaching: A growth mindset is a core value for Kasa. One of the ways we deliver on it is by offering complimentary external leadership coaching to Kasa team members.
  • Remote Work: With flexibility as a core value, and over three-quarters of the team working remotely, Kasa employees can work from anywhere, including our Kasa’s across the country!
  • Kasa Travel Credit: We love to travel! Kasa employees get an allowance of free stays with us in any of our locations, plus a discount on any night for friends and family.
  • The Pay: The starting base pay range for this role is between $186,000 and $200,000 and is set based on multiple considerations, including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified. This role may also be eligible for equity, bonus, perks, benefits, and Kasa Travel Credits.
  • Generous Stock Option Plan: At Kasa, our compensation philosophy is to offer a total compensation package that over-indexes on equity to encourage our team to think like owners (by being owners) and benefit from the value growth that our collective hard work creates.
  • Flexible PTO: Full-time exempt Kasa employees are encouraged to take time off as they need and see fit, ensuring that it’s not disruptive to their work.
  • 401(k) Plan: As you invest in yourself and your future, Kasa invests in you too.
  • Health Coverage: We’ve invested in comprehensive health insurance options to help when you need it most.
  • Other Perks: Qualifying full-time roles are eligible for a wi-fi stipend, cell-phone reimbursement, home office stipend, and more!

Kasa is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by law. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Kasa is an E-Verify participant. We will verify the identity and employment eligibility of all persons hired to work in the United States by matching information employees provide on the Form I-9 against records available to the Social Security Administration (SSA) and the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). raw.excerpt: IntroductionJoin us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!
raw.description:
Introduction

Join us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!We’re problem solvers, driven by our curiosity and creativity, in endless pursuit of solutions for our customers. Together, we champion the strength of our global teams. And, as trusted advisors, we go above and beyond, working together in a supportive and collaborative environment to ensure customer satisfaction. Through the company's continued growth, we challenge ourselves to be better, continuously learning and growing in our dynamic environment. Helping others is at the core of our culture, join us in finding fulfillment by giving back to our local communities as the united team that is AIT.  Find out what our people deliver.® means when you come move the world with us!  Hear directly from our teammates at AIT Worldwide Logistics and make us the next stop on your career journey.

Overview

The Manager, Operations Security and Compliance oversees high value cargo protection and ensures full compliance with federal and industry security programs, including CTPAT and TAPA FSR/TSR. The role conducts carrier security vetting, facility security assessments, and transport security oversight to prevent theft, tampering, and supply chain disruptions across domestic and international logistics operations.This position holds overall responsibility for ensuring that operational, transportation related security protocols are consistently followed in accordance with customer requirements and AIT standards. Focused on forwarding and logistics operations, not infrastructure security or workplace safety. Serving as the primary security liaison for key customer security leaders, the Manager guides secure cargo handling procedures and leads customer driven security audits and corrective action programs.Embeds security requirements into daily workflows to ensure consistent, high quality service delivery. It supports customer facing audits, investigations, and corrective action development, translating regulatory and customer expectations into practical operational controls, training materials, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

Responsibilities

  • Carrier Vetting & Partner Security Assurance:Conduct security risk assessments and due diligence for carriers, subcontractors, and service providershandling high‑value freight.Validate carrier compliance with CTPAT, TAPA TSR, and customer‑mandated security requirements, including driver controls, equipment standards, and chain‑of‑custody procedures.Review and maintain carrier security documentation, certifications, SOPs, and corrective action plans.Partner with Operations and Procurement to approve, restrict, or remediate carriers based on security risk findings.
  • Facility Security & Compliance:Perform facility security assessments aligned with TAPA FSR and CTPAT Minimum Security Criteria, including access control, CCTV, alarm systems, key control, visitor management, and secure storage.Identify vulnerabilities, assign risk ratings, and track corrective actions through closure.Collaborate with Warehouse leaders to ensure secure handling, staging, and storage of high‑value goods.Maintain facility security documentation, post orders, and access protocols in audit‑ready condition.
  • Transport & In‑Transit Security:Define and enforce transport security controls for high‑value shipments, including route risk analysis, secure parking, seal management, tracking, and escalation protocols.Support Operations with security planning for sensitive or high‑risk moves, ensuring controls comply with TAPA TSR and customer expectations.Participate in theft, loss, or tampering investigations, performing root cause analysis and recommending corrective and preventive actions.Coordinate with Customer Service on shipment‑level security requirements, exceptions, and incident.
  • Audits, Compliance & Risk Management:Prepare for and support CTPAT validations, TAPA audits, customer security audits, and internal assessments.Maintain accurate documentation, including risk assessments, corrective action logs, training records, and partner vetting files.Monitor regulatory and industry security updates and translate requirements into actionable internal procedures.Serve as a subject‑matter expert during audits, clearly explaining security controls to auditors and customers.
  • Training, Awareness & Cross‑Functional Collaboration:Develop and deliver security awareness training for Operations, Warehouse, Drivers, and Customer Serviceteams, with emphasis on high‑value cargo protection and insider threat awareness.Reinforce security culture by coaching frontline teams on proper procedures and escalation paths.Act as a trusted advisor to business units, balancing security, service, and operational efficiency.
  • Incident Response & Continuous Improvement:Respond to security incidents involving theft, loss, or suspicious activity.Lead investigations with Global safety and Security to document findings and ensure corrective actions are implemented and verified.Analyze trends and recommend improvements to reduce future risk.
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Complies with all policies and standards
  • The wage range for this position is $64,190.00 - $96,290.00 and may vary based on geography as well as relative knowledge, skills, abilities, and experience

Qualifications

Education• High School Diploma or GED (required) • Bachelor's Degree in security management, Criminal Justice, Logistics, Risk Management, or Logistic Industry or equivalent degree (preferred) Experience• 5+ years experience in supply chain security, logistics security, or compliance which includes hands‑on experience with CTPAT, TAPA FSR/TSR, or customer security programs and exposure to high‑value freight, transportation security, or warehouse security operations. (required) Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities• Strong working knowledge of CTPAT Minimum Security Criteria and TAPA standards. High• Ability to conduct risk assessments, audits, and investigations. High• Excellent cross‑functional communication skills, with the ability to influence without authority. High• Practical understanding of logistics operations, warehouse workflows, and transportation processes. High• Strong documentation, reporting, and analytical skills. Medium• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and security tracking tools. Medium• Operationally focused security professional, combining operational excellence with security acumen Medium• Comfortable working cross-functionally across Operations, Warehouse, Global Security Operations and Customer Service Medium• Demonstrated executive presence, calm, methodical, and decisive during incidents Medium• Balances risk mitigation with service delivery to internal stakeholders and customers MediumLicenses and Certifications• Certified Purchasing Professional (CPP) - () • AOSH Certified Safety Officer (CSO) - () • - CTPAT certification experience () • - TAPA FSR/TSR training or certification () • - CPP, PSP, CSO, or similar security credentials ()

What AIT Can Offer You

In addition to your base compensation, you may be eligible for a bonus based on achievement of business and/or individual performance metrics (dependent on position). Benefits offered include Medical, Prescription, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, Disability, Supplemental Health, Employee Support, Paid Parental Leave, Pet Insurance, 401(k) and Tuition Reimbursement. In addition, teammates may be eligible for up to 10 to 20 days of vacation (depending on tenure), 2 personal days, 1 floating holiday, 5 sick days, 5 volunteer hours, and 6 company holidays (plus Veterans Day for Veterans) annually.

About AIT Worldwide

AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps companies grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure their raw materials, components and finished goods. For more than 40 years, the Chicago-based supply chain solutions leader has relied on a consultative approach to build a global network and trusted partnerships in nearly every industry, including aerospace, automotive, consumer retail, energy, food, government, high-tech, industrial, life sciences and marine. Backed by scalable, user-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door-to-door deliveries via sea, air, ground and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 150 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe and North America, AIT’s full-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services.

AIT Worldwide Logistics is an Equal Opportunity Employer – M/F/Veterans/Disabled. If you are unable to apply online due to a disability, contact Human Resources at 630-766-8300 ext 5218.

Job Description: Fashion and Interior Styling Expert

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote – Worldwide

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Fashion and Interior Styling Experts to evaluate styling concepts, outfits, room setups, and creative briefs. This role is ideal for professionals with backgrounds in fashion styling, wardrobe styling, interior design, set styling, or home styling.

You will review styling work, assess fit, proportion, color, materials, and overall suitability, and provide clear written explanations for your decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Evaluate outfits and interior setups to determine which best meets a specific brief, season, client, or project requirement.
  2. Assess fit, proportion, scale, color coordination, and material selection.
  3. Identify practical issues, including incorrect sizing, unsuitable fabrics, or items that do not fit the intended space.
  4. Evaluate whether styling concepts align with the project brief, budget, and setting.
  5. Provide concise written explanations supporting styling decisions and recommendations.
  6. Create or improve styling briefs, mood descriptions, and shopping lists.

Required Qualifications

  1. Professional experience as a Fashion Stylist, Wardrobe Stylist, Personal Stylist, Interior Stylist, Set Stylist, Prop Stylist, or Home Stylist.
  2. Hands-on experience managing real-world projects, including brief development, sourcing, fittings, installations, and client delivery.
  3. Strong understanding of styling principles, including fit, proportion, color coordination, materials, and spatial suitability.
  4. Ability to evaluate styling concepts and clearly explain why one look or space works better than another.
  5. Strong written English communication skills.

Selection Process

  1. Application: Submit your resume and a short professional profile.
  2. Styling Interview: Complete a brief conversation about your experience with fashion and interior styling, sourcing, and project execution. No preparation or written assignment is required.
  3. Experience Review: Your qualifications will be assessed against the project requirements.
  4. Onboarding and Initial Task: Selected candidates will receive project guidelines and complete an initial task for review before proceeding.

We are seeking a compassionate registered nurse (RN) to join our growing team! In this role, you will provide critical after-hours support, triaging hospice patients and family needs over the phone wit professionalism and empathy. Utilizing best-in-class technology, IntellaTriage provides round-the-clock direct access to licensed, registered nurses using client-customized protocols for patient-centered, compassionate care. We are growing rapidly and excited to support our clients’ nursing staff in the field by leveraging our remote team of nurses to manage after-hours care delivery.   • Ability and comfort with typing documentation and notes in a fast-paced environment
  • Must be able to handle stress and multitask when receiving calls

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Key responsibilities

  • Provide telephone triage for hospice patients and families
  • Assess patient conditions and determine appropriate next steps
  • Collaborate with on-call teams to coordinate care and resources

raw.title: Sourcing Project Manager
raw.excerpt: About the teamZillow’s Procurement team helps the business move faster and smarter by building trusted supplier partnerships and thoughtful sourcing strategies across the company.
raw.description:
About the team

Zillow’s Procurement team helps the business move faster and smarter by building trusted supplier partnerships and thoughtful sourcing strategies across the company. Within Strategic Sourcing, you’ll work with cross-functional stakeholders to balance cost, quality, and risk while bringing structure, insight, and innovation to how we buy. This team plays an important role in supporting Zillow’s goals by helping teams make informed decisions and deliver value at scale. Within the team, our Sourcing Center of Excellence also owns the tools and processes behind how we buy, from intake workflows to Source-to-Pay platform configuration, so sourcing stays consistent, compliant, and easy for teams to use.

About the role

The Sourcing Project Manager develops and executes sourcing strategies that optimize total cost, quality, and risk across Zillow’s spend categories. You will also serve as a functional owner of our Sourcing tools and sourcing-enabled processes, blending hands-on deal execution with process ownership, tooling administration, and digital transformation to drive process improvements across the sourcing and intake-to-procure lifecycle while independently managing competitive events, renewals, and new sourcing requests while. You will conduct market and supplier analysis, lead competitive sourcing events, negotiate contracts, and partner with stakeholders to deliver value and innovation in support of business objectives.


You will get to

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Finance, Legal, Risk, Technology, Business) to align sourcing plans with budget and business needs, and to ensure sourcing governance, compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Support the development of category strategies, sourcing playbooks, and standard tools that promote consistency and compliance.
  • Maintain accurate sourcing documentation, contract records, and savings tracking to communicate value delivered to leadership.
  • Drive Source-to-Pay tool requirements gathering, workflow configuration, and system enhancements.
  • Drive adoption of the supplier segmentation and categorization framework.
  • Conduct process mapping and implement workflow improvements that advance digital transformation and process efficiency.
  • Apply Agile and Lean methods to sourcing, tooling, and process-improvement initiatives.
  • Lead moderately complex strategic sourcing initiatives from opportunity identification through supplier selection and award.
  • Analyze spend, demand, and market data to identify sourcing opportunities and inform category strategies.
  • Negotiate commercial terms, service levels, and pricing with suppliers to optimize total cost of ownership and manage risk.
  • Develop and execute RFx events (RFI/RFP/RFQ), including requirements gathering, evaluation criteria, and bid analysis.
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $93,900.00 - $150,100.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $89,200.00 - $142,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or Supply Chain management.
  • Experience leading end-to-end sourcing events (RFPs, competitive bids) and delivering measurable cost or value improvements.
  • Experience analyzing spend or market data to inform sourcing strategies and supplier selection.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to align sourcing initiatives with Business needs.
  • Experience managing supplier performance and Resolve issues across multiple categories.
  • Strong analytical skills grounded in total cost of ownership, with the ability to influence stakeholders and communicate complex concepts clearly.
  • Preferred Experience with process-improvement methods (Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, Kaizen, or Design Thinking) and administering sourcing or procure-to-pay platforms.
  • Or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. description: The OpportunityAI is changing the economics of legal practice.

raw.title: Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) & Co-founder - AI for Small Law Firms
raw.excerpt: The OpportunityAI is changing the economics of legal practice.
raw.description:
The Opportunity

AI is changing the economics of legal practice. Work that once took hours can increasingly be done in minutes, creating both enormous leverage for lawyers and new pressure to win and serve more clients efficiently.

Yet solo practitioners and small law firms still operate with many of the same constraints: missed calls, slow follow-up, intake handled between client matters, inconsistent marketing, and administrative work competing with billable time. Building larger intake, administrative, and marketing teams is expensive and increasingly unnecessary.

BloomLex is building a different model: a managed AI workforce that helps small law firms grow without growing their team.

The customer thesis has been validated through live pilots, and multiple deployments are moving into production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, repeatability, and scalability. The companies that successfully deploy trusted AI workers into professional-service verticals over the next 18 months have an opportunity to define entirely new categories. We intend to be one of them.

The Venture

BloomLex is building an AI workforce for solo practitioners and small law firms, helping them win and serve more clients without adding headcount.

We call the broader shift the Rise of the Solo: AI gives an individual lawyer or small firm access to capabilities that historically required a much larger organization.

Unlike self-serve software, BloomLex is fully managed. We configure, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve the AI workforce for each firm. Our customers evaluate us on outcomes — calls answered, prospective clients captured, consultations booked, demand generated, follow-up completed, and time saved — not on how much software they configure themselves.

Our AI workforce starts with two teammates:

Ava — AI Front Desk. Ava answers calls 24/7, handles structured intake, screens and routes inquiries, books consultations, performs outbound callbacks and follow-up, and integrates those interactions into the firm's workflow.

Claire — AI Marketing Assistant. Claire helps firms generate and nurture demand through content, digital marketing, campaign management and optimization, lead nurturing, and ongoing marketing execution.

Together, Ava and Claire address both sides of growth: Claire helps create demand; Ava helps ensure that demand is captured and converted.

They are also the beginning, not the end, of the platform. Our roadmap expands the AI workforce across the operational side of the practice — including custom workflows and additional specialized AI roles — all delivered through the same managed model and coordinated around the lawyer.

The Partnership

The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, live pilots are running, and the technology and deployment infrastructure are being built for scale.

What remains is to complete the founding team with a commercial co-founder — someone who will own revenue and go-to-market with the same conviction, urgency, and sense of ownership as the CEO and CTO.

This is not a role where you inherit a sales team, a mature playbook, and a predictable funnel. You will help discover and build those things.

You will personally close early customers, determine which channels scale, refine the commercial model from real market evidence, and then build the organization capable of repeating it.

This is a co-founder and leadership role, not simply a sales hire. You will join the CEO and CTO as one of three co-founders, with founder-level equity, founder-level responsibility, and a meaningful voice in go-to-market, pricing, hiring, fundraising, product direction, and company strategy.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CRO, you will own the commercial journey from first conversation through acquisition, retention, and expansion.

  • Early Revenue — Personally convert pilots and prospects into paying customers and establish the first repeatable sales motion across solo practitioners and firms of up to five lawyers.

  • Go-to-Market — Refine and operationalize our ICP, positioning, messaging, and Rise of the Solo narrative, turning them into outreach, demos, pipeline, and closed revenue.

  • Pipeline & Channels — Determine which acquisition channels actually work — outbound, content, paid acquisition, referrals, partnerships, communities, events, and others — and concentrate resources behind the ones that can scale.

  • Partnerships & Distribution — Build relationships with legal business coaches, bar associations, legal communities, consultants, complementary technology providers, and other potential distribution partners.

  • Pricing & Commercial Economics — Own pricing, packaging, expansion strategy, customer acquisition economics, retention targets, and the path toward increasing revenue per firm as the AI workforce expands.

  • Customer Success & Retention — Stay close to early customers, understand why they buy and why they stay, and build the commercial processes that turn adoption into retention, expansion, referrals, and advocacy.

  • Customer Proof — Turn early wins into measurable case studies, testimonials, references, and commercial proof around the outcomes lawyers care about.

  • Fundraising — Help tell the growth story to investors through credible traction, metrics, unit economics, forecasts, and a clear path to scale.

  • Team — Once the motion is working, recruit and lead the sales, partnerships, and customer-success organization needed to scale it.

Co-Founder Profile

We're looking for a builder first and a sales executive second.

You are likely someone who has spent enough time inside an established company to know how a professional revenue organization works — but would rather build one than inherit one.

You should bring:

  • A strong record of full-cycle selling, ideally into the legal market or another fragmented SMB/professional-services vertical.

  • The confidence to personally prospect, run demos, negotiate, close, onboard, and expand early customers before hiring people to do it for you.

  • A strong understanding of how small-business buyers make decisions, what creates trust, and how to turn an early-stage product into a compelling commercial proposition.

  • Ideally, an existing network within legal technology, solo and small-firm legal communities, bar associations, legal services, or adjacent channels.

  • Strong commercial judgment — including the willingness to challenge assumptions about positioning, pricing, channels, or markets when the evidence says we should.

  • Entrepreneurial drive: you are ready to move from selling someone else's company to building one of your own.

  • Comfort with an early-stage compensation model weighted heavily toward ownership and revenue creation rather than a conventional executive salary.

  • The ability to operate as a principal, not an employee — making decisions with the long-term value of the company in mind and doing whatever work is necessary at this stage to move it forward.

Early-stage go-to-market leadership, experience selling AI or automation products, and experience selling into the legal profession are strongly preferred. Candidates should be able to operate effectively across North American time zones.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we needWe are looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join the LabArchives team, a small, dedicated group building industry-leading Electronic Laboratory Notebook (ELN), Inventory, and Scheduler products used by researchers and institutions around the globe.

In this role, you will partner closely with product, operations, and support teams to design, build, and maintain the backend systems that power the LabArchives suite of products. You will have a substantial impact on our development process and our products, applying your passion for technology to all of our systems and processes while helping grow LabArchives globally.

In this role you will get to:

We are looking for people with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent combination of education and 9+ years of experience, along with a technology enthusiast’s mindset and a passion for learning and continuous improvement. You will bring deep hands-on experience in backend and database development, and be comfortable collaborating closely with team members across several departments.

  • Strong server-side development experience with Node.js, including building and maintaining APIs and services.

You may also have:

  • Interest in scientific or educational technology and its impact on how research gets done.

Total Rewards

Dotmatics utilises a national market-based approach to base pay benchmarking and pay band development. The candidate's final starting pay is based on job-related skills, experience, job specific qualifications & location. In addition to base salary, Dotmatics has implemented a total rewards strategy, which is the combination of compensation, benefits and recognition.

Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

This is the range that we, in good faith, believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.

About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you!

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

The APD Adjuster investigates and settles physical damage claims arising from rental vehicle accidents, including damage to the rental unit, third-party vehicles, and property. You determine coverage, liability and value, then close each file quickly, fairly and with clear documentation.

Who you are

  • Excited about building a tech-driven claims organization
  • Passionate about the customer experience
  • You're empathetic and patient with everyone you interact with
  • Driven by a sense of urgency (without working around the clock)
  • Creative in finding the right resolution that serves the insured's best interest
  • You're comfortable with conflict—see it as conversational, not adversarial
  • Curious about the whole story so you can make the right decisions early
  • Anti-status quo—you don't just wish things were different, you make them different
  • A strong communicator
  • You have a sense of humor (claims are hard enough as it is!)

What you'll do

  • Open, investigate and manage a caseload of APD claims from first notice of loss to closure.
  • Detailed coverage analysis, risk shifting, and policy investigation.
  • Review rental agreements and program terms to confirm coverage, exclusions and deductibles.
  • Contact renters, claimants, body shops and appraisers within required timeframes; take recorded or written statements.
  • Evaluate damage through estimates, photos and appraisals; negotiate repair and total loss settlements.
  • Determine liability and apportion fault using police reports, statements and physical evidence.
  • Handle loss of use, towing, storage, diminished value and related expense claims.
  • Identify subrogation and recovery opportunities and refer them with complete supporting documents.
  • Flag potential fraud, injury exposure or litigation risk and escalate to the right adjuster or lead.
  • Keep timely, accurate file notes and reserves; meet carrier and program service standards.
  • Follow state regulations and client handling instructions on every file.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of auto physical damage or commercial auto claims experience.
  • Working knowledge of vehicle repair, estimating and total loss valuation.
  • Strong negotiation, written communication and time-management skills.
  • Comfort with a high-volume, deadline-driven caseload and a claims system such as Glance or similar.
  • High school diploma required; bachelor’s degree or AIC/CPCU progress preferred.
  • Active adjuster license: resident-state license where available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license. Willing to obtain any additional required licenses within 60 days, including state testing.

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Additionally, we will

  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Redwood Finance Automation Engineer, Germany

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Germany. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will build what the solution design sets out. You will configure the close and reconciliation processes, build the integrations with the ERP and the systems around it, and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

Close processes built and configured end to end: task lists, dependencies, approvals and the automated steps between them. Automated account reconciliation, including matching rules and exception handling. Journal entry automation, from data preparation and validation through to posting in the ERP. Integration with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and other source systems, through standard connectors, file and API interfaces. Intercompany, accrual and reclassification steps automated alongside the close. Workflow logic in REL or JavaScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on delivery on Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance), where you built close, reconciliation or journal processes yourself on at least one live implementation. 5 or more years in finance systems or automation engineering. Working knowledge of SAP FI/CO postings and master data, or the Oracle equivalent, and where ERP integrations tend to break. Workflow scripting in REL or JavaScript, and hands-on ERP integration. A finance-side understanding of the record-to-report cycle and month-end controls.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood RunMyJobs workload automation. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A current Redwood certification. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

Finance Research Expert

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote – Worldwide
Compensation: $30–$60 per hour
Time Per Task: Approximately 4–8 hours

Job Description

We are seeking experienced Finance Research Experts to contribute to an AI training and evaluation project focused on financial research and analysis.

In this role, you will create finance-related research questions based on real US public companies, provide verified answers supported by reliable sources, and evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy.

Candidates must have hands-on experience reviewing US SEC filings and a strong understanding of US GAAP.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Develop finance research questions requiring detailed analysis of US public company filings, including 10-Ks, 10-Qs, 8-Ks, proxy statements, earnings releases, and investor presentations.
  2. Create questions that require identifying specific financial figures, disclosures, and information from complex financial documents.
  3. Develop questions involving conflicting figures across multiple documents, such as original versus restated financials or adjusted versus reported results.
  4. Verify the correct fiscal period, filing version, and latest amended documents before finalizing answers.
  5. Provide accurate, well-documented answers supported by reliable sources and references.
  6. Test research questions against current AI models and identify questions that produce incorrect answers.
  7. Refine ambiguous questions to ensure they have one clear and verifiable answer.

Required Qualifications

Candidates should have hands-on experience working with US financial filings in one or more of the following areas:

  1. Equity Research or Investment Analysis: Sell-side or buy-side research covering US public companies.
  2. Investment Banking or Corporate Development: Experience with M&A, equity capital markets, deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history, and subsidiary structures.
  3. Credit or Restructuring Analysis: Experience reviewing credit agreements, bond terms, and bankruptcy filings.
  4. SEC Reporting or Audit: Big Four audit or corporate reporting experience, including restatements, financial footnotes, and reporting changes across filings.
  5. Corporate Law or Due Diligence: Experience in securities law, KYC, investigations, and tracing entities, executives, and related parties across records.

Additional Requirements

  1. Strong understanding of US GAAP and SEC reporting requirements.
  2. Ability to read and analyze lengthy financial filings, including detailed footnotes and tables.
  3. Excellent financial research, analytical, and verification skills.
  4. Strong written English communication skills.
  5. Ability to provide clear, accurate, and source-backed explanations.

Selection Process

  1. Application: Submit your resume and a short professional profile.
  2. Finance Interview: Complete a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. No preparation or written assessment is required.
  3. Experience Review: Your background and expertise will be evaluated against project requirements.
  4. Onboarding and First Task: Selected candidates will receive project guidelines and begin with an initial task, which will be reviewed before proceeding with further assignments.

Compensation Structure

  • Payment ranges from $30 to $60 per hour.
  • Each task typically requires approximately 4–8 hours.
  • Work is conducted remotely, with worldwide participation.
