raw.description:
Solution Sales Engineer

About Revenova

Revenova is a Chicago-based provider of cloud transportation management solutions and the only TMS fully built on Salesforce. Since 2014, freight brokers, 3PLs, carriers and shippers have used Revenova to bring CRM, AI and logistics together on one platform.

The platform covers load building and real-time quoting with Artimus AI, lane and rate analytics with LaneIQ and RateIQ, carrier and fleet management, real-time freight tracking, customer portals, accounting integration and advanced reporting. It supports multimodal freight, including LTL, FTL, flatbed, bulk and drayage, and connects with partners such as DAT, project44, Samsara and Cleo.

About the Role

Location:Remote

This is a dedicated Solution Sales Engineer role. You will be a trusted advisor to our prospects, the industry expert on our new business deals, and the bridge between Sales, Implementation and Product.

Account Executives lead the discovery call and overview demo, then bring you in to take the conversation deeper. From there, you partner with them through close, so they can focus on running the deal while you prove how Revenova solves the prospect's problems. This is a consultative sale. You stay with each deal through long sales cycles, often three to six months, and act as an advisor, not just a technical resource, who shows prospects their future state in Revenova.

Across teams, you make sure scope is clear before signing so Implementation can deliver on time, and you bring what you hear from prospects back to Product to help shape the roadmap.

What You'll Do

  • Lead in-depth, consultative sessions after the overview demo to uncover the root cause of each prospect’s operational and business pain (Critical Business Issues and Impact of those issues)

  • Turn those findings into a value-based story and deliver tailored, in-depth demos in the prospect's own language and industry context

  • Partner with Account Executives on deal strategy, technical positioning and next steps from the overview demo through close

  • Lead the preparation of Objectives Findings for the prospect highlighting what we learned, path to signature, assessment of critical issues and impact and how Revenova will uniquely solve those challenges to differentiate from competitors

  • Respond quickly to late-stage needs, including follow-up demos, executive presentations, and SOW and scope questions

  • Define accurate scope for each deal and provide a clean handoff to the implementation team

  • Track competitors' products and positioning so every demo addresses the alternatives a prospect is weighing

  • Serve as the bridge between Sales, Implementation and Product, sharing prospect feedback, scope details and market trends with each team

  • Help Account Executives build product and industry knowledge through enablement and coaching

What You'll Bring

  • 3+ years of experience as a Solutions Engineer or Sales Engineer at a B2B or SaaS company, delivering software demos and/or supporting the full sales cycle

  • A consultative, trusted-advisor approach, with the curiosity to keep asking questions until the real problem is clear

  • Strong presentation skills, with a track record of value-based demos that lead with outcomes instead of features

  • Experience supporting complex, high-value deals with sales cycles of three months or longer

  • The ability to manage several active deals at once and respond on the prospect's timeline

  • Clear communication with audiences from operations staff to executives

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Salesforce, including configuration or administration

  • Hands-on knowledge of how freight brokerages, trucking companies and/or shippers operate day to day

  • Experience with TMS platforms and the transportation, broker and logistics workflows they support

  • Familiarity with consultative selling methods

  • Knowledge of freight accounting, carrier management or load quoting tools

  • Prior work in a hands-on operational role at a brokerage, carrier or shipper

How Success Is Measured

  • Win rates of greater than 50% on the deals you support

  • Average deal size of greater than $150,000 ARR on enterprise opportunities and ~$50,000 ARR on SMB

  • Clear, accurate scope at signing that leads to achievable expectations for the Revenova implementation team with achievable on-time go-lives

  • Strong partnership with Account Executives, who rely on you as a trusted advisor to their prospects

  • Prospects who see clear business value in Revenova before they buy

raw.description:
Docuvera builds technology that supports the highly regulated pharmaceutical industry, where quality, trust, and compliance genuinely matter. Our people help shape the future of digital content in life sciences, so let us tell you more about what we do at Docuvera, why we do it, and what it means for you.

About Docuvera

Our story

Docuvera is the industry leader in governed, structured content authoring for the life sciences industry and as a pioneer in this space, we are proud to support top global Pharma companies. Born out of Author-it in 2017, Docuvera is now a member of the cormeo family of companies, an exciting step that strengthens our global reach and long-term growth.

Our mission

We are on a mission to help our customers harness the power of digital innovation, accelerating their ability to safely get their life changing products to market faster.

For our customers, Docuvera empowers them to drive digital transformation in how they manage their content. Docuvera turns their content into small, reusable components (building blocks). A component is written and approved once, then reused confidently and consistently across many documents, projects, and regions.

For our team, it means delivering real world impact through ground-breaking solutions to technically complex problems.

About the role

The part you'll play

We're seeking a Product Manager who can bring CMC expertise. As a Product Manager, you’ll be responsible for executing Docuvera’s product strategy, working closely with functional leads in Engineering, Sales, and Services to dive deep and solve customer pain points. Our customer-centric philosophy extends across everything we do. We work to translate customer, market, and business needs into clear, prioritised product requirements that guide the ongoing development of Docuvera’s services. Working closely with our customers and internal delivery teams, the role helps shape practical, user-focused solutions and supports their successful delivery through an iterative, agile approach.

  • Wrangling and defining context, checking scope and requirement, ensure problem statement and solution are building the platform.
  • Support the collection, assessment, and prioritization of customer requirements for future versions of Docuvera services.
  • Gather input from customer interactions, internal stakeholders, competitive analysis, and market research to inform product decisions.
  • Collaborate with Product Management peers to help define and refine the user experience for Docuvera services.
  • Assist in defining business and functional requirements for product enhancements (e.g., writing user stories or use cases).
  • Break larger product ideas into well-defined, incremental features that can be delivered iteratively.
  • Create and maintain product documentation, specifications, and planning artifacts as needed.
  • Work with engineers to review and validate user experience designs, including participating in usability testing.
  • Collaborate with our Tech and Engineering teams to support agile delivery, including backlog grooming and sprint planning.
  • Communicate product updates and feature details internally and, when appropriate, with customers and other external stakeholders.

Why it matters

You’ll know, and we’ll know, this role is successful when you consistently focus the team on what matters most: turning validated customer insight and clear business priorities into well-scoped, incremental product outcomes that reduce customer pain and move the business forward. Success looks like a prioritized roadmap and backlog that reflect strategic trade-offs, repeatable discovery and validation practices that reduce risk before build, crisp requirements engineering trusts, and reliable, timely releases that close customer pain points. Equally important is how you deliver: you build trust internally and externally, lift others, bring calm and clarity through change, and model the judgment and accountability we value.

What we'll expect of you

Your experience

You’ll bring 2–4 years of experience in Product Management, Associate Product Management, Business Analysis, or a related role, with experience working on SaaS or enterprise software products, ideally in a customer-facing or cross-functional environment.

You’ll have hands-on experience gathering requirements through customer feedback, stakeholder collaboration, competitive analysis, or market research, and be able to translate user needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and use cases. You’ll be familiar with agile or iterative development and working with engineering teams in a sprint-based environment, and bring experience and interest in using AI and automation in your work.

Exposure to workflow, search, collaboration, content management, data migration, or related enterprise services would be a plus, as would an interest or experience in life sciences, including pharmaceuticals, biotech, or medical devices.

Strong written and verbal communication skills will help you collaborate across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success, supported by a team-first mindset and confidence working with distributed or remote teams.

Your approach

A positive mindset wins every time. We expect you to have a positive, curious approach to your work, to take ownership of meaningful outcomes, and embrace new technologies. As we grow and build our AI capabilities across the business, the way we work will continue to evolve. Your willingness to learn, adapt, and work well with others will be central to our shared success.

With the flexibility and trust we offer comes responsibility, and we appreciate the willingness to connect with our global team as needed to make sure the job gets done.

Certifications desired

A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent education and/or experience is desired but not required.

What you can expect working with us

Where we're based

Our team works across New Zealand, Asia, the UK, Europe and the United States. Our CEO is in the US, and the rest of our leadership team is spread between the US and New Zealand. You’ll find most of our technical teams in New Zealand and Asia, and most of our customer facing and sales teams in the US and Europe. That global mix is intentional and brings a wonderful range of experience and perspective.

Our style

We’re a down-to-earth bunch, where virtual doors are open, ideas are welcome and people are approachable. Working mostly remotely across time zones takes a some coordination, so we collaborate asynchronously, share information clearly and keep things moving even when we’re not online together.

The experience you can expect

We want our people to do meaningful work and keep growing their careers, in a place full of likeminded people. Since Docuvera is part of the ever-changing software industry, but with customers in the highly regulated pharma industry, there's no shortage of interesting technical challenges that have a significant customer impact.

The qualities or traits of our people which directly impacts our culture, performance, and how we get work done day to day are captured in these six words: Go-Getter, Torchbearer, Trailblazer, Shapeshifter, Elevator, and Steward.

Go-Getters and Torchbearers own it and deliver. They focus on what matters most, take initiative, and drive results without chasing perfection. They take accountability, communicate early, and act in the team’s best interests.

Trailblazers and Shapeshifters improve and adapt. They stay curious, challenge how things are done, and look for better ways forward. They approach change with positivity and calm, helping others find clarity and maintain momentum.

Elevators and Stewards lift others and lead by example. They listen, collaborate, and give credit where it’s due. Through professionalism, optimism, and integrity, they build trust and help others succeed.

What we provide

  • Flexibility: genuine trust in how you manage your work, helping you balance professional and personal commitments. Your contribution is more important than where you work or how visible you are.
  • Tools: we heavily invest in modern systems and AI technology to support you to do your best work.
  • Growth: we have a strong track record of internal career progression, with growth shaped by access to both funded and free learning, coaching, and mentoring opportunities.
  • Leave: a range of leave benefits, including year-end appreciation leave, birthday leave, parental leave, and long-service leave.

We also have the use of confidential, fully funded employee assistance support. Other entitlements may vary depending on location and eligibility (such as unlimited PTO and healthcare benefits for the US).

Keen to know more?

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information about working with us and follow us on LinkedIn to check out what we've been up to recently.

Key information about our recruitment process

  • Accessibility: if there’s anything we can do to make our recruitment process more inclusive or accessible for you, please let us know. We’re happy to accommodate different needs where we can.
  • Use of AI: we use AI tools to complement our recruitment process but all interviews and hiring decisions are made by our people. We may use AI to support certain stages of the hiring process, but they do not replace human interaction or decision making.
  • Process outline: we usually run two online interviews, each about an hour long, with one or two members of our team. Some roles may also include a technical exercise to help us understand your approach and skills.
  • Timing: we’ll keep applications open until we find the right person and we’ll do our best keep you updated how things are progressing.

Requirements

We're hiring a finance generalist who runs the numbers, owns the close, and automates the routine so the team spends its time on analysis and decisions.

Grip is the AI-powered, end-to-end event platform built for engagement. Commercial event organisers like Ascential, Hyve, Emerald and Clarion Events use Grip to build, maintain and track relationships between participants across multiple events. We operate as a three-entity group across the UK, US and Serbia.

You'll report to the Head of Finance and sit in a small team. The expectation is explicit: every manual process you inherit is a candidate for automation, and success is measured by how much of your week moves from processing to analysis.

Essential

  • 2–4 years in a finance role covering month-end close and management accounts.

  • Part-qualified or qualified ACCA, CIMA or ACA, or working towards it.

  • Hands-on Xero experience; comfort with multi-currency and multi-entity accounting.

  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets: lookups, pivots, array formulas, building schedules from scratch.

  • Evidence of using AI tools or automation to remove manual work, with a measurable result.

  • Understanding of subscription revenue, deferred revenue and SaaS metrics.

Nice to have

  • Maxio, Salesforce, Stripe, Avalara, Moss or Revolut Business.

  • Building with LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT), workflow tools (Zapier, Make), Apps Script, SQL or Python.

  • Intercompany, transfer pricing or US sales tax exposure.

  • Events industry experience.

Profile

  • Treats a repeated task as a design problem, not a routine.

  • Checks the output of automation as rigorously as their own work.

  • Explains numbers clearly to non-finance budget holders.

  • Comfortable working remotely across UK, US and Serbian time zones.

🚀 Expectation of the role:

Responsibilities

  1. Management accounting & month-end close

  • Own the monthly close across UK (GBP), US (USD) and Serbia (RSD) entities to a WD3 timetable.

  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations, prepayments, accruals, fixed assets, depreciation and payroll journals.

  • Run intercompany reconciliation and FX revaluation, and post the group's consolidation adjustments.

  • Produce monthly management accounts with variance analysis against budget and prior period.

  • Maintain department and vendor-level cost reporting and flag spend trends to budget holders.

  • Maintain the 13-week cash forecast and bank balance reporting; support payroll funding.

  • Support year-end, audit files and liaison with external advisors in each jurisdiction.

2. Revenue, billing & AR

  • Validate closed-won deals from Salesforce and ensure accurate invoicing through Maxio and Xero.

  • Own deferred revenue calculations and revenue recognition compliance for subscription contracts.

  • Reconcile the Stripe clearing account and Lead Retrieval PAYG revenue.

  • Manage multi-currency AR and collections, and resolve billing queries with Go-To-Market teams.

  • Support US sales tax compliance: Avalara reconciliation and reporting to our tax advisors.

3. AI, automation & systems

  • Build, test and maintain AI agents for finance workflows on a flag-and-approve basis: a human reviews before anything posts.

  • Map every recurring task on the close calendar and score it for automation potential.

  • Improve integrations between Xero, Maxio, Salesforce, Stripe and our spend platforms.

  • Document each process so it can be run, audited, or handed to an agent.

  • Track and report time saved and error rates before and after each automation.

4. Business partnering & analysis

  • Produce SaaS metrics: ARR, net revenue retention, churn, gross margin and CAC payback.

  • Support budgeting, reforecasts and board pack preparation.

  • Run ad-hoc analysis on pricing, vendor spend, headcount cost and unit economics.

5. Residual transactional work

  • AP processing, payment runs, expense and reimbursement processing, and the shared finance inboxes, with a mandate to shrink this through automation.

Cashback healthcare plans, Company training sponsorship, including professional qualification support

Clear career progression pathways

raw.excerpt: POSITION DESCRIPTION: NCHC is seeking a Publications Conversion Specialist to lead the digital migration of NCHC's peer-reviewed publications catalog from the BePress Digital Commons platform to Tizra, NCHC's new digital publishing platform.
raw.description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION:
NCHC is seeking a Publications Conversion Specialist to lead the digital migration of NCHC's peer-reviewed publications catalog from the BePress Digital Commons platform to Tizra, NCHC's new digital publishing platform. This is a temporary, fully remote, full-time position with an initial 12-month appointment and the possibility of extension based on project progress. The Publications Conversion Specialist reports directly to the Executive Director (ED) and works in close coordination with the Publications Board, Blackout Design (NCHC's design and layout partner), and Tizra's conversion team.

Blackout Design, NCHC's design and layout partner, is rebuilding the publication PDFs and uploading them to Tizra. The Specialist's work begins with the scholarly infrastructure that follows: establishing NCHC's CrossRef membership, assigning Digital Object Identifiers (DOIs) to every article, collecting and registering author ORCID iDs, writing and standardizing metadata, remediating accessibility, and coordinating NCHC's applications to JSTOR, Scopus, and Clarivate. This work will give NCHC a persistent, fully controlled digital home at www.nchchonors.org and the scholarly infrastructure needed to measure and grow the impact of honors education research.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in digital publishing, metadata, or digital archives; meticulous attention to detail; the ability to manage a large, long-running technical project independently; and a demonstrable commitment to the mission of the National Collegiate Honors Council. Experience in honors education or scholarly publishing is valued.

The scope of the project is substantial. NCHC's repository includes the Journal of the National Collegiate Honors Council (JNCHC), Honors in Practice (HIP), and the NCHC Monograph Series, representing more than 26 years of peer-reviewed scholarship and more than 18,000 pages.

ABOUT NCHC:
The National Collegiate Honors Council (NCHC) focuses on supporting honors education among colleges and universities. It serves as a professional association for honors programs and colleges and students, providing resources, support, and networking opportunities for educators involved in honors education. NCHC aims to advance honors education by fostering collaboration among honors programs, sharing best practices, and promoting excellence in teaching and learning.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Coordinate the migration of all content from the BePress Digital Commons platform to Tizra, working with Blackout Design (which is responsible for rebuilding and uploading the publication PDFs) and with Tizra's conversion team
  • Establish and manage NCHC's CrossRef membership and oversee DOI assignment across the full backfile and all new content
  • Collect ORCID iDs from current and past authors and register each against their respective DOIs through CrossRef
  • Collaborate with publication authors to write abstracts for the backfile, including pre-2019 issues and non-native PDFs, and assign keywords selected from the existing Honors Education keyword set developed by NCHC's Metadata Specialist
  • Write, clean, and standardize metadata across the full repository to enable proper indexing
  • Rebuild accessibility standards across all digital content
  • Route all links from the Digital Commons infrastructure to new DOI-based addresses
  • Update bibliographic records in NCHC's library indices (EBSCO, Cengage/Gale, and ERIC) to include persistent DOI links
  • Support the creation of dynamic cross-reference links (internal and external) throughout the catalog
  • Maintain clear documentation of conversion workflows, metadata standards, and project status so that NCHC staff can sustain the work after the appointment concludes
  • Coordinate the JSTOR application process and subsequent submissions to Scopus and Clarivate
  • Support NCHC's later evaluation of rebuilding publications as re-flowable digital content once the DOI and metadata work is complete
  • Provide regular progress reports to the Executive Director and the Publications Board
  • Other duties as assigned

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • A bachelor's degree in library or information science, digital humanities, English, communications, publishing, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience);
  • Demonstrated experience in digital publishing, digital archives, metadata creation, or a similar technical editorial role;
  • Working knowledge of scholarly metadata and persistent identifiers, including DOIs, CrossRef, and ORCID;
  • Demonstrated experience with document and PDF remediation, including digital accessibility standards (such as WCAG);
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage a high-volume, multi-year project independently and to deadline;
  • Excellent collaboration, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with remote partners and external vendors;
  • Candidates should possess a strong commitment to NCHC's mission and to higher education more broadly

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • A master's degree in library and information science or a related field;
  • Experience with a digital publishing or content management platform such as Tizra, BePress, or other similar tools.
  • Experience with HTML, XML, or JATS and with metadata standards for scholarly publishing;
  • Familiarity with the indexing and application requirements of JSTOR, Scopus, and Clarivate;
  • Experience working with a scholarly journal, university press, or professional association publications program;
  • Experience in honors education

COMPENSATION:

This is a temporary, fully remote, full-time position with an initial 12-month appointment and the possibility of extension based on project progress. The position carries an annual salary of $68,000. Employer-sponsored health benefits are not included.

Vonage is transforming its business support systems across lead-to-cash, billing, rating, customer identity, account management, data, analytics and platform services. Strategy & Roadmap:

Process Transformation:

  • Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS and back-office systems: CRM, billing, rating, analytics, identity, APIs and integration architecture

Chief Digital Officer (CDO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Digital Officer (CDO) is responsible for developing and executing the organization's digital strategy, leading enterprise-wide digital transformation, and leveraging technology to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, innovation, and business growth across insurance and investment operations.

The CDO will oversee digital platforms, technology-enabled business transformation, automation, data-driven innovation, and digital product development. Working closely with executive leadership and business units, the role will ensure that digital capabilities support the organization's strategic objectives, enhance competitiveness, and deliver secure, scalable, and customer-centric financial services.

2. Key Responsibilities

Digital Strategy & Transformation

  • Develop and implement the organization's enterprise-wide digital strategy and transformation roadmap.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize business processes through technology, automation, and digital innovation.
  • Align digital initiatives with corporate strategy, business growth, operational priorities, and customer expectations.
  • Lead large-scale digital transformation programs across insurance, investment, finance, and corporate functions.
  • Establish digital governance frameworks, transformation priorities, budgets, and performance measures.

Digital Platforms & Product Development

  • Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of digital platforms, customer portals, mobile applications, and online service channels.
  • Drive digital insurance solutions, including online policy applications, premium payments, claims submissions, renewals, and policy servicing.
  • Support digital investment platforms for account management, portfolio reporting, transactions, and client engagement, where applicable.
  • Collaborate with product, technology, and business teams to develop innovative digital financial products and services.
  • Ensure platforms are scalable, accessible, user-friendly, and aligned with customer and business requirements.

Technology Innovation & Emerging Solutions

  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, cloud computing, robotic process automation (RPA), blockchain, and advanced analytics.
  • Promote technology adoption to improve underwriting, claims processing, customer service, risk assessment, investment operations, and reporting.
  • Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and evaluate the commercial value of new technologies.
  • Establish partnerships with fintech companies, insurtech providers, technology vendors, and digital solution providers.
  • Monitor digital industry trends and translate relevant innovations into practical business opportunities.

Data & Analytics

  • Develop a data-driven organizational culture through effective data governance, analytics, and business intelligence.
  • Oversee digital analytics capabilities to support customer insights, business performance, risk assessment, and strategic decision-making.
  • Collaborate with data teams to develop dashboards, predictive models, and reporting systems.
  • Improve data accessibility, quality, accuracy, and consistency across business units.
  • Ensure responsible data use and compliance with applicable privacy and data protection requirements.

Operational Automation & Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual and repetitive business processes.
  • Drive workflow digitization across underwriting, claims, policy administration, investment operations, finance, HR, and compliance.
  • Improve process efficiency, service turnaround times, productivity, and cost effectiveness.
  • Promote integration between enterprise systems, CRM platforms, policy administration systems, and financial applications.
  • Measure the operational impact and return on investment of digital transformation initiatives.

Cybersecurity, Data Protection & Digital Risk

  • Work closely with IT, information security, risk, and compliance teams to ensure secure digital operations.
  • Promote cybersecurity awareness and responsible technology practices.
  • Ensure digital platforms comply with applicable financial services regulations, privacy laws, and data protection standards.
  • Support business continuity, disaster recovery, and technology resilience initiatives.
  • Establish appropriate controls for third-party technology providers and digital service partners.

Digital Customer Experience

  • Improve customer journeys through seamless digital onboarding, self-service, communication, and service delivery.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Experience Officer, marketing, and business teams to improve digital customer engagement.
  • Use customer feedback, analytics, and usability testing to enhance digital platforms.
  • Expand digital access to insurance products, investment services, and financial information.
  • Promote consistent experiences across websites, mobile applications, branches, and other customer touchpoints.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead digital transformation, digital product, data, and technology strategy teams.
  • Establish digital performance objectives, budgets, governance structures, and delivery accountability.
  • Collaborate with the CIO, CTO, CISO, COO, CXO, and business leaders to coordinate technology priorities.
  • Manage relationships with technology vendors, implementation partners, consultants, and strategic digital partners.
  • Present digital strategy, transformation progress, investment requirements, and performance results to the CEO and Board.

3. Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Master's degree in Technology Management, Digital Transformation, Business Administration, or a relevant discipline preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in digital transformation, technology leadership, IT strategy, digital product development, or technology-enabled business innovation.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership or executive technology/digital management position.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, wealth management, fintech, or other regulated financial services.
  • Proven track record of leading enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of digital platforms, cloud technologies, enterprise systems, automation, data analytics, and emerging technologies.
  • Experience managing technology budgets, digital projects, vendor relationships, and cross-functional teams.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity, data governance, regulatory compliance, and technology risk management.
  • Strong strategic thinking, commercial awareness, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Progress against the enterprise digital transformation roadmap.
  • Digital adoption and active usage rates across customer channels.
  • Percentage of business processes digitized or automated.
  • Reduction in operational costs and manual processing time.
  • Digital customer acquisition and onboarding rates.
  • Digital platform availability, reliability, and performance.
  • Customer satisfaction with digital products and services.
  • Return on investment (ROI) of digital initiatives.
  • Data quality, analytics adoption, and reporting effectiveness.
  • Cybersecurity incidents and digital risk mitigation performance.
  • Delivery of digital projects within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Revenue generated or supported through digital channels.

We’ve been a trusted partner to the world’s largest financial institutions for over a decade, with AI running in production at global banks including HSBC and Standard Chartered. We automate the compliance decisions that stop money laundering and terrorism financing, at scale, in production, on real cases.

Now our customer base across Asia-Pacific and the Middle East is growing fast, with Tier 1 banks and insurers moving into implementation. We’re headquartered in Singapore, and we’re hiring a Solution Architect who works in our customers’ time zone and represents Silent Eight in every technical conversation with them.

The Role

This is a senior, hands-on, customer-facing technical role, with no people management involved. You’ll be the primary technical point of contact for our customers in Asia-Pacific and the Middle East, involved from the very first Proof of Value, where we show our software working on a customer’s own data, through deployment, production go-live and third-line support. When something doesn’t work on the customer’s side, you’re the one who finds out why and gets them unblocked. You’ll also support existing customers as they adopt new services, and act as the bridge between customers and our engineering team in Poland.

The role is fully remote, based in Singapore (preferred) or Poland, and works on Singapore time (GMT+8), with some flexibility. Travel is occasional, roughly twice a year, typically 2–3 days on site with a customer at project kick-off to discuss the implementation and technical details.

What You’ll Do

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for Silent Eight customers in Asia-Pacific and the Middle East

  • Answer customers’ technical questions in pre-sales and Proof of Value calls: what the technology can and can’t do, and what we can configure for them

  • Run Proof of Value engagements, demonstrating our software on customer-provided data

  • Partner with clients to understand their infrastructure, tooling, technical and business requirements

  • Design and implement scalable, secure and maintainable solutions that integrate seamlessly with client systems

  • Evaluate custom requests, present clear and feasible solution proposals, and provide effort estimations and delivery roadmaps

  • Prepare high-quality documentation: design diagrams, architecture overviews and technical specifications

  • Guide project teams and customer infrastructure teams through installation, go-live and post-implementation adoption

  • Provide third-line support: investigate issues in customer environments, test solutions yourself and get customers unblocked

  • Collaborate with Sales, Engineering and Product to align technical solutions with business goals

  • Bridge customers and our engineering team in Poland, keeping hand-overs across time zones smooth

What We’re Looking For

  • At least 3 years of experience in solution or software architecture

  • English language at least C1 level

  • Hands-on experience deploying and troubleshooting workloads on Kubernetes (pods, deployments, services, ingress, configuration and secrets), in the cloud or on-premise

  • Working knowledge of cloud building blocks such as managed Kubernetes, managed databases (e.g. PostgreSQL), object storage, networking and access policies (experience with AWS, Azure or GCP is a plus)

  • Strong background in Java and good knowledge of microservices and distributed systems (Python is a plus)

  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, design patterns, integration patterns and test-driven development

  • Experience designing and running production-grade deployments, both in the cloud (containerized workloads on Kubernetes) and on-premise (services running directly on VMs)

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Good working knowledge of Linux systems

  • Ability to create clear, concise architecture documents and diagrams

  • Practical, hands-on approach to problem solving, including testing solutions in your own environment before getting back to the customer

  • Eagerness to learn and keep up with new technologies

  • Patience and composure when explaining technical topics to non-technical customers

  • Confidence in presenting to customers and leading customer meetings independently

  • Based in Singapore or Poland, with availability to work on Singapore time (GMT+8)

  • Experience delivering to banks or insurers in regulated environments (e.g. MAS, APRA) is a strong plus

What We Offer

  • A B2B contract (Poland) or an employment contract (Singapore) with a competitive salary

  • Paid days off to balance work and life in the way that suits you best

  • Fully remote work, forever, with occasional travel to customers

  • A quarterly wellness allowance

  • Real opportunities for promotion and development within the organization, including paid Development Days and in-house training

  • A product that already works, with AI in production at Tier 1 banks, so you’re designing around something real

  • Passionate leadership and a collaborative team

  • The chance to be an integral part of an award-winning, fast-growing RegTech company that values a friendly working atmosphere

Process

  • Recruitment screening with People Ops — 30 min

  • Initial technical interview with one of our engineers

  • Meeting with the Hiring Manager, Darek

Poznaj Onwelo

Onwelo jest partnerem technologicznym, który dostarcza kompleksowe usługi, od strategii i architektury, przez wdrożenia, po utrzymanie, w obszarach transformacji cyfrowej, danych i automatyzacji. Nasz zespół liczy ponad 400 specjalistów z silnymi kompetencjami seniorskimi, a na koncie mamy 300+ zrealizowanych projektów dla dużych organizacji w Polsce, Europie i USA. Działamy z kilku polskich miast oraz z biur w Niemczech, Szwajcarii i USA, łącząc lokalną obecność z globalnym zasięgiem.

O projekcie

Poszukujemy doświadczonego SeniorAI Engineer/ML, który dołączy do zespołu rozwijającego rozwiązania dla klienta z branży life science/healthcare.

PoszukujemySenior ML Engineer/ AI Engineerktóry nie tylko posiada szeroką wiedzę z zakresu Machine Learning i Data Science, ale przede wszystkim potrafiprojektować i dostarczać kompleksowe rozwiązania AI klasy produkcyjnej— od koncepcji i eksperymentu, przez architekturę i implementację, aż po wdrożenie, monitoring oraz dalszy rozwój.

Istotnym obszarem projektu jest rozwójAgentic AI— systemów wykorzystujących autonomicznych agentów, tool calling, RAG, pamięć, orkiestrację workflow oraz integrację modeli LLM z istniejącymi systemami i źródłami danych.

Twoje zadania

  • Budowanie i interpretowanie modeli ekonometrycznych (. MNK, modele log‑log, uogólnione modele liniowe)

  • Projektowanie, rozwój i wdrażanie rozwiązań opartych na Machine Learning, Generative AI oraz LLM

  • Projektowanie i rozwój rozwiązań wykorzystującychGenerative AI oraz Large Language Models

  • Budowanie i rozwijanie produkcyjnych systemów AI – od prototypu po wdrożenie i utrzymanie

  • Podejmowanie decyzji dotyczących wyboru modeli, frameworków, architektury oraz strategii wdrożenia

  • Integracja modeli LLM z istniejącymi systemami, API i źródłami danych

Kogo szukamy

  • Masz min. 8-10 lat komercyjnego doświadczenia w obszarze Machine Learning, Data Science

  • Bardzo dobrze znasz język Python oraz biblioteki wykorzystywane w uczeniu maszynowym

  • Posiadasz praktyczną znajomość bibliotek i frameworków takich jak scikit-learn, PyTorch lub TensorFlow

  • Tworzenie rozwiązań wykorzystujących . RAG, tool calling, workflow orchestration i pamięć agentów

  • Praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu systemów agentowych i agentic workflows

  • ZnaszDocker, Git oraz CI/CDi rozumiesz proces dostarczania oprogramowania na produkcję

  • Potrafisz pracować z relacyjnymi bazami danych i językiem SQL

  • Swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim, minimum na poziomie B2

  • Potrafisz efektywnie współpracować w zespołach projektowych i jasno prezentować rozwiązania techniczne

Technologie

  • Python

  • Machine Learning / Deep Learning

  • PyTorch / TensorFlow / scikit-learn

  • Generative AI oraz Large Language Models (LLM)

  • SQL

  • Docker

  • Git oraz CI/CD

  • Cloud: Azure, AWS lub GCP

  • Narzędzia i praktyki MLOps

raw.description:
Responsibilities

Sargent & Lundy is one of the largest and most experienced power industry engineering and consulting firms. We have a unique and exciting opportunity to join our Consulting group in the role of a Project Manager. This position will require you to lead and execute work associated with the development, financing, and execution of power generation projects.

This position is being added to support continued growth of the Sargent & Lundy Consulting group, which regularly provides technical and financial due diligence, asset transaction support, project development services, independent engineering services, owner’s engineering services, and long-term planning support. This position will require a great deal of face-to-face interaction with power project developers, utilities, investors, legal advisors, and financial institutions during the execution of consulting services work for the firm.

Common responsibilities include:

  • Develop consulting project execution plan to meet client’s needs
  • Reviewing deliverables such as reports and studies
  • Lead project team by providing clear instruction including technical approaches
  • Manage hours and work performed to budget and scope
  • Develop staff expertise through training and mentoring
  • Prepare proposals for consulting project opportunities
  • Supporting multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring a high quality standard is met
  • Traveling occasionally to visit project locations and client offices.

This is a remote/virtual position. Candidate can be based anywhere within the United States.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

This position requires a Bachelor's degree in electrical, mechanical, or civil engineering (other engineering disciplines or finance/economics may be considered) with 15 or more years of experience in the power industry, including:

  • Owner’s engineer, independent engineer, and/or design engineer experience for development and execution of power generation
  • Experience managing teams of engineers
  • Experience and technical knowledge in multiple power generation technologies – solar, battery energy storage, wind, and thermal
  • Experience performing feasibility studies for power projects
  • Experience in long-term power supply and transmission planning projects is a plus
  • Experience in project finance or financial modeling of power projects is a plus
  • Experience with project contracts such as power purchase agreements, asset transfer agreements, and EPC contracts is a plus
  • Prior experience in a consulting role is a plus

Technology & Innovation

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

About Sargent & Lundy

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

The total compensation package for eligible positions will include a base salary or an hourly rate and a comprehensive benefits package, reflecting our commitment to rewarding performance and supporting the overall well-being of our employees. raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About The Role

Samsara’s mission is to improve industrial efficiency, safety, and quality at a massive scale, through the use of sensors and software. Our suite of IoT products and software platform brings the benefits of sensor data to traditional industries like transportation, food and beverage distribution, construction, state and local government, and K-12 education. We help our customers transport food, medicine, and other goods safely across the country, monitor deliveries for unsafe conditions, and help fleet managers improve the efficiency of their operations.

Samsara’s Product Design team is responsible for crafting user-friendly features, workflows, and interfaces that our customers use every day to run their operations. This involves talking to customers, working with engineers and product managers to understand problems, rapidly designing and iterating on mocks and user flows, and communicating ideas effectively to stakeholders. We also build design systems that underpin all our products to ensure a consistent and cohesive user experience.

We’re looking for an experienced product design director who will build out an already high-caliber group of designers and help shape the product experience for all our customers.

This is a remote position based in the United States. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead, grow, coach and mentor a team of design managers
  • Engage with customers to deeply understand their operations and people
  • Ship high-quality designs based on these customer needs
  • Collaborate with partners to define opportunities and deliver a best-in-class experiences
  • Define and drive the product design strategy across product areas
  • Create and refine tools, systems and processes that improve team health and output
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4-6 years (or more) of product design management experience
  • Strong portfolio that showcases ability to lead teams that ship elegant solutions to complex problems

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Track record of shipping step-changes to the UX that drive customer and business impact
  • A history of hiring, growing and retaining great talent
  • Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners to ship high quality experiences
  • Experience identifying and instituting changes that improve employee experiences
  • Expertise in providing feedback that accelerates career growth and improves product quality
  • A desire to improve yourself, the team, and product experiences

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$235,600—$294,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

100% Remote | Full-time Contractor
Schedule: Monday through Friday, covering 9am–5pm Eastern European Time (EET)
Location: Open to candidates in EMEA or APAC who can cover European hours. Not open to US-based candidates.

About Gymdesk

Gymdesk is category-leading gym management software, built for gym owners, martial arts school owners, and studio owners who want to run and grow their business. Thousands of fitness and wellness businesses run on Gymdesk, and we're proud to sit at 4.8 stars on Capterra. We recently closed a $32.5 million growth investment from Five Elms Capital, and we're building out the team to match.

About the Role

Our customers are small business owners. They are teaching classes, signing up new members, and running front desks, often all at once. When something in Gymdesk doesn't work the way they expect, they need a fast, clear answer from someone who knows the product and cares about getting it right.

The Customer Support Representative is that person. You will answer questions by phone, chat, and email, troubleshoot account and technical issues, and make sure every customer leaves the conversation with a clear answer or a clear next step. You will join our Customer Support team, part of our wider Customer Success team, and report to our VP of Customer Success and our Customer Support Team Lead. You will work alongside Onboarding, Customer Integrations, Sales, and Engineering.

At its heart, this role is about problem solving: answering customer questions, addressing their concerns, and troubleshooting issues until they're resolved.

Why This Work Matters

For most gym owners, Support is the part of Gymdesk they talk to most. Every conversation shapes how they feel about the product and about us.

  • For our customers, a quick, accurate answer means billing runs on time, classes stay booked, and they can get back to their members.

  • For their members, many of the issues you solve are ones members feel directly: a payment that didn't go through, a class they couldn't book, an app that won't log in.

  • For Gymdesk, customers who feel well supported trust the product more, use more of it, and stay with us longer. What you hear also helps Product and Engineering decide what to fix next.

This role is where a customer's question turns into confidence in Gymdesk.

What You'll Own

Customer conversations

  • Answer customer questions by phone, chat, and email, handling a high volume of conversations each day (often 50 or more).

  • Give clear, accurate answers about how Gymdesk works, in plain language that a busy gym owner can act on right away.

  • Follow up on open issues so every customer knows what is happening and what comes next.

Troubleshooting and escalation

  • Investigate and resolve technical and account-related issues, including billing, scheduling, member records, and settings.

  • Recognize when an issue needs more help, and escalate it to Engineering with clear steps to reproduce, screenshots, and customer impact.

  • Coordinate with Onboarding, Customer Integrations, and Sales when a question belongs with another team, so customers get a smooth handoff instead of a runaround.

Records and knowledge

  • Keep accurate, complete ticket records in HubSpot, including the issue, steps taken, and outcome.

  • Tag recurring questions and bugs so the team can spot patterns.

  • Become an expert in Gymdesk, and keep up with new features and changes as they ship.

Improving the experience

  • Suggest and help write help-center articles, saved replies, and templates that answer common questions faster.

  • Share customer feedback with the Support Team Lead, Product, and Engineering about what confuses or frustrates customers.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means customers feel heard, get accurate answers quickly, and come away more confident in Gymdesk. Here is what we hope your first few months look like:

  • First 30 days: Comfortable with Gymdesk's core features. Handling chat and email conversations with support from the team. Escalations written clearly and completely.

  • 60 days: Handling phone, chat, and email independently at a steady daily volume. HubSpot ticket records current and complete. Comfortable knowing what to solve and what to escalate.

  • 90 days: A go-to resource on the team for common issues. Contributing saved replies or help-center updates. Sharing patterns from customer conversations with Product and Engineering.

Who You Are

  • 1–3 years of experience in customer support, customer success, or a similar customer-facing role.

  • Service-minded at heart. You get energy from helping people, and you take pride in following through.

  • Patient and clear when explaining something technical. You can walk a gym owner through a billing setting or a scheduling issue in plain, reassuring language.

  • Calm and organized at a fast pace, able to juggle many conversations and prioritize what matters most.

  • A curious troubleshooter who digs into the "why" behind an issue instead of stopping at the first answer.

  • A clear, professional communicator in writing, on the phone, and over chat, with fluent English.

  • Comfortable working through a CRM or ticketing system (such as HubSpot), Slack, and other remote-work tools.

  • A quick learner who enjoys becoming an expert in complex software.

  • Familiar with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for drafting replies, summarizing conversations, or finding answers, and interested in using them thoughtfully.

  • Comfortable in a growing company where processes are still being built.

  • Nice to have: experience in SaaS support; familiarity with HubSpot help desk or service pipelines; experience with billing or payments questions; or experience serving fitness, martial arts, or wellness businesses.

Tools You'll Use

About your tasks

  • Lead end-to-end UX research, from defining research objectives and selecting appropriate methodologies through to participant recruitment, fieldwork, analysis and communicating actionable insights.
  • Improve the end-to-end prescription and pharmacy experience, exploring how customers discover our services, redeem prescriptions, navigate pharmacy processes and receive medication, identifying opportunities to simplify complex or unnecessary steps through digital solutions.
  • Translate research into measurable product improvements, collaborating with Product Management, Design and Product Analytics to combine qualitative insights with behavioural data, funnels, segmentation and experimentation to influence product decisions and customer outcomes.
  • Advance our research practices through AI and knowledge sharing, leveraging tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and Codex to support research preparation, synthesis and insight sharing, while ensuring research quality, responsible data handling and supporting colleagues in applying effective research methods.

About you

  • Extensive experience in UX Research or Product Research, with a proven track record of independently leading research initiatives within complex e-commerce, digital healthcare or health-tech environments.
  • Strong expertise across qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, including user interviews, usability testing, surveys, exploratory research, behavioural analysis and research synthesis, with the ability to select the most appropriate methods for different business challenges.
  • Experience working closely with Product Analytics, combining research findings with product performance data to inform decisions. Familiarity with tools such as Contentsquare or FullStory is an advantage.
  • A proven ability to influence product strategy and decisions, translating complex research findings into clear, actionable recommendations and demonstrating measurable impact on product or customer outcomes.
  • Practical experience using AI tools within research workflows, such as ChatGPT, Claude or Codex, with an understanding of how to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and use these tools responsibly.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, present findings and influence cross-functional Product teams.
  • Native or equivalent German language proficiency, enabling you to conduct nuanced research with customers on sensitive healthcare topics, alongside fluent professional English for collaboration in an international environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience within e-health, e-pharmacy, telemedicine or other digital healthcare services.
  • Experience conducting research involving sensitive personal information, vulnerable participants or regulated products.
  • Knowledge of inclusive research practices, accessibility and health literacy.
  • Experience with longitudinal research or diary studies.

Why join us?

At Redcare Pharmacy, your research will help shape how people access and manage their healthcare, making important customer journeys easier, clearer and more accessible.

You'll have the opportunity to influence both immediate product improvements and the longer-term direction of our Pharma experience, working alongside multidisciplinary teams in a growing, technology-driven organisation.

We value curiosity, methodological expertise and a strong customer focus, and we're looking for someone who can challenge existing thinking and help us make better product decisions through meaningful research.

About your Benefits:

In order to provide our employees with the best possible support for their individual needs, we offer a wide range of benefits:

  • Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office, we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU.
  • Redcare events: We promote teambuilding through creative team events, and celebrate our successes together at regularly scheduled parties.

While this is a remote position based in Germany, it may require occasional on-site collaboration at our offices in Sevenum or Cologne, depending on business and team requirements.

About Redcare Pharmacy:

As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values join us and start your #Redcareer today.

About the role

Accessing prescription medication should be simple, transparent and reassuring. However, navigating prescriptions and healthcare services can often involve uncertainty, unfamiliar processes and complex customer needs.

As a Senior UX Researcher, you'll play a key role in understanding these challenges and shaping how millions of customers interact with our digital pharmacy services.

You'll own and drive research across our Pharma domain, uncovering customer needs, challenging assumptions and translating insights into meaningful improvements across our digital products and pharmacy processes.

Working closely with Product Designers, Product Managers, Engineering and Product Analytics, you'll help ensure that customer insights are at the heart of our product decisions.

This is an opportunity to have a real impact on how people access and manage their medication, while helping shape the future of digital healthcare.

raw.excerpt: We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) — the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI-powered applications and experiences with agility and ease.
raw.description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) — the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI-powered applications and experiences with agility and ease.

We're proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a Principal Rust Engineer and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward.

At Progress, you'll lead the technical direction of the search engine behind our Agentic RAG product: a distributed Rust platform for vector, full-text and knowledge-graph search, developed in the open as part of the NucliaDB project. You'll work from low-level index data structures up to the distributed architecture, together with ML, product and platform teams, and directly affect the quality, speed and cost of our product.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the architecture and roadmap of our distributed search and indexing engine, written in Rust.
  • Design and implement vector, full-text and graph indexes (HNSW, quantization, multi-vector, Tantivy) and the query and filtering layer on top of them.
  • Evolve how indexes are built, merged, sharded and replicated on object storage, PostgreSQL and NATS.
  • Lead large migrations and performance work, based on profiling and benchmarks, without customer downtime.
  • Contribute to the Python services, SDKs and PyO3 bindings built on the engine, keeping public APIs stable.
  • Keep the system observable, reliable and secure across Kubernetes deployments and CI/CD.
  • Write design proposals, review code, mentor senior engineers and represent the project in the open-source community.

Your background:

Technical skills

  • Extensive experience building and running high-performance production systems, including technical leadership.
  • Expert Rust: async (Tokio), concurrency, memory-mapped I/O, profiling and low-level optimization (e.g. SIMD).
  • Deep knowledge of search engine internals: approximate nearest neighbour search, vector quantization, inverted indexes and ranking.
  • Experience designing distributed data systems: storage engines, sharding, replication and consistency trade-offs.
  • Solid experience with PostgreSQL, object storage (S3, GCS, Azure) and messaging (NATS JetStream or Kafka).
  • Strong Python, ideally with PyO3, asyncio, FastAPI and Pydantic.
  • Experience running services on Kubernetes with observability and CI/CD (ideally GitHub Actions).

Professional skills

  • Ability to set technical direction and deliver it incrementally.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English, including design documents.
  • Comfortable owning critical production systems and making decisions under pressure.
  • You measure before optimizing and know when to simplify or remove code.
  • Willing to mentor others, comfortable in a remote-first, global team.
  • Additionally, it would be beneficial if you have:
  • Experience with Tantivy, Lucene, vector databases or other search engines.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs or graph-based retrieval (GraphRAG).
  • Familiarity with embedding models, including multi-vector models (e.g. ColBERT).
  • Experience maintaining open-source projects, including dependency auditing and licensing.

If this sounds like you and fits your experience and career goals, we'd be happy to chat.

Compensation

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan Enrollment

Vacation, Family, and Health

  • 23 vacation days annually
  • Birthday day off
  • Community service time off
  • International Women's Day - March 8 is an official holiday for all employees

raw.description:
We're Sharp Performance

Sharp Performance exists so that everyone who answers the call has someone in their corner who has walked in their shoes.

We help first responders and their spouses thrive through confidential coaching from people with similar lived experience. Our coaches have carried the badge, worn the gear, or stood beside someone who did. Through our mobile platform, we connect law enforcement, firefighters, and other frontline professionals with coaches who understand the job because they have lived it.

We're early-stage and backed by amazing investors. The team is small enough that your work shows up in the rollout, the product, and the customer's experience within weeks. If building something that matters alongside people who hold a high standard sounds better than a safe seat somewhere else, come build it with us.

The Opportunity

Sharp Performance is hiring an Events Coordinator to own the logistics behind every trade show and conference we attend, from contract to wrap-up, and to support our go-to-market team. You will report into Growth Marketing and work across Marketing, Sales, and Business Development.

Our field team's job is to book meetings and work the booth. Your job is to make sure everything around them is booked, shipped, and set up on time and on budget.

This role suits a seasoned organizer who likes owning the details end to end and wants to see their work show up on the show floor.

What You'll Do

Before each event

  • Register the booth and team, and manage exhibitor deadlines, forms, and badge lists
  • Negotiate and manage vendor contracts, tracking deposits, payment dates, and cancellation terms
  • Build and track a budget for each event
  • Order print materials, booth graphics, and giveaways, and ship everything the booth needs so it arrives on time
  • Build a Notion prep doc for each event with the schedule, booth setup instructions, staffing, meetings, and key contacts

Travel and hospitality

  • Book flights and hotels for the team
  • Make restaurant reservations for customer dinners and team events

After each event

  • Arrange return shipping and keep an inventory of booth materials
  • Reconcile invoices and expenses against the budget
  • Record costs and lessons learned to plan the next event better

Speaking engagements and GTM support

  • Find and book speaking engagements for our Business Development team, a group of former public safety leaders who represent Sharp in the market
  • Keep a shared calendar of upcoming events, deadlines, and speaking opportunities
  • Support go-to-market leaders with travel, scheduling, and logistics as needed

What Success Looks Like

  • Every event runs on time and on budget, with no missed deadlines
  • The field team arrives to a booth that is ready and a prep doc they can rely on
  • Business Development has a steady calendar of speaking slots

What We're Looking For

You have 5 to 7 years of experience in event coordination, executive assistance, or both, including trade shows or conferences. Experience with events in public safety, government, or adjacent markets is a plus.

You also bring:

  • Experience running several events at once with overlapping deadlines
  • Comfort negotiating with vendors and reading contracts
  • Experience building and tracking event budgets
  • Experience booking group travel and managing calendars for a busy team
  • Clear written communication, and the habit of documenting everything so others can follow it, ideally in Notion
  • Calm under pressure when plans change the week of an event

Why You'll Want to Be Here

You will own how Sharp shows up in the market and work closely with the people we serve. Sharp is a Series A company growing quickly, already working with 100+ public safety agencies, and backed by Andreessen Horowitz and investors behind some of the world's most successful technology companies. Your work helps improve the health, performance, and longevity of the people who run toward danger.

The package includes:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Access to the same performance coaches we offer our clients

Sharp Performance is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

We continue to grow our Pricing & Commercial Finance team and are seeking a Senior Analyst, Commercial Finance to support financial decision-making across the client lifecycle. This individual will play a key role in new client pricing, ongoing client profitability and forecasting, and financial modeling and pricing for expansions and renewals with existing clients.


The Senior Analyst will partner with team members and cross-functional stakeholders to develop financial models, evaluate growth opportunities, monitor client financial performance, and translate financial and operational data into meaningful insights. This role will support commercial decisions related to new business opportunities, client scope expansions, renewals, and other contract changes.


The ideal candidate will develop a deep understanding of Ensemble’s business, operating model, and client economics and will be comfortable working across multiple data sources and systems, including Workday, Adaptive Planning, and Power BI. This individual will also leverage AI, automation, and scalable analytical tools to simplify processes and improve the speed and quality of financial analysis.


This role is remote and will report to the Manager, Pricing & Commercial Finance.

Essential Job Functions:


New Client Pricing


  • Perform financial due diligence for new client opportunities, analyzing historical financials, payroll, accounts payable, staffing, vendor costs, and other key inputs to identify risks, opportunities, and service gaps for large health systems
  • Develop financial models for new client opportunities, translating due diligence findings and operating assumptions into expected revenue, cost, and profitability
  • Support the pricing proposal and internal approval process, preparing analyses and materials that clearly communicate proposed economics, assumptions, and risks to leadership
  • Analyze early post-go-live financial performance against pricing and implementation assumptions to identify variances and inform future pricing decisions

Expansions & Renewals


  • Develop financial analyses and pricing proposals for client expansions, renewals, and contract changes, evaluating the financial impact of scope changes and trade-offs across cost, pricing, contract terms, and expected profitability
  • Track upcoming renewals and contractual milestones to support timely financial analysis and pricing decisions
  • Support the incorporation of approved contract changes into financial forecasts and client profitability expectations in partnership with Operations, Accounting, and other stakeholders

Client Financial Performance & Forecasting


  • Develop and maintain client financial forecasts and profitability analyses, incorporating key financial and operational drivers to maintain an accurate outlook on client performance
  • Monitor client performance against pricing and forecast assumptions, identifying deviations in staffing plans, vendor roadmaps, and other key drivers of profitability
  • Partner with Operations and Partnership Success (client relationship leaders) to analyze risks and opportunities, develop actionable recommendations, and monitor progress against identified actions
  • Develop and maintain reporting and analytical tools that provide visibility into client financial performance, outlook, and key risks and opportunities

  • 3-4+ years of relevant experience in consulting, finance, FP&A, pricing, financial due diligence, or a related analytical role
  • Healthcare finance or health system experience preferred
  • Pricing and/or financial due diligence experience preferred, particularly with complex client or service-based businesses
  • Strong financial modeling, quantitative, and analytical skills, with the ability to analyze revenue, cost, profitability, and key financial trade-offs
  • Ability to work with incomplete or complex financial and operational data, identify gaps and inconsistencies, develop reasonable assumptions, and draw well-supported conclusions
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, with the ability to identify risks and opportunities and translate analysis into meaningful insights
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including Operations and client-facing teams
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly present financial analysis and conclusions
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar analytics experience preferred
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines
  • Curiosity and comfort leveraging AI and automation to simplify processes and improve financial analysis and decision-making
  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.
  • Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.
