Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Why This Role Matters:

Vonage is transforming its business support systems across lead-to-cash, billing, rating, customer identity, account management, data, analytics and platform services. This role provides the senior direction and momentum to simplify and modernize that landscape - ensuring platform decisions support scale, resilience, commercial growth and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategy & Roadmap:

  • Define and own the BSS transformation roadmap, aligned to Vonage's commercial, operational and customer experience ambitions
  • Translate business needs across lead-to-cash, billing, rating, identity, account management, data and platform services into clear priorities and design principles
  • Challenge legacy ways of working and driving toward a simpler, more scalable and better-integrated future-state BSS landscape.

Governance & Change Management:

  • Establish and lead transformation of governance, controls and decision-making mechanisms to keep execution aligned with approved strategy, scope, roadmap, and architecture
  • Ensure a clear separation between transformation and BAU, while maintaining strong connectivity with operational teams on migration, adoption and change impacts.

Legacy Scope Management:

  • Partner with the Sr. Director of BSS to ground the roadmap in the current-state landscape and enforce a firm boundary preventing net-new functionality being added to legacy systems - minimizing the delta the programme must close.

Budget & Risk:

  • Own the transformation budget: forecasting, spend tracking, and ensuring investment decisions are aligned to priorities and business value
  • Own risk identification, mitigation planning and escalation, ensuring risks are visible, assigned, and actively managed across workstreams.

Stakeholder & Senior Leadership

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Finance, Sales and Commercial teams to align scope, sequencing, dependencies and delivery outcomes
  • Act as the senior business and product voice for the transformation, connecting platform decisions to commercial impact, operational efficiency and customer value.

Vendor Evaluation:

  • Lead vendor evaluation including RFPs/RFIs, evaluation criteria, response coordination and structured selection aligned to transformation objectives
  • Drive measurable, time-boxed validation of vendor capabilities, integration feasibility and technical fit before platform commitments are made, ensuring decisions are evidence-based.

Process Transformation:

  • Work with stakeholders across functions to identify, document and roll out end-to-end process changes required to support future-state BSS capabilities.

What You'll Bring:

Required:

  • Senior experience leading large-scale BSS, OSS, lead-to-cash, billing, rating, CRM, identity or platform-services transformation programmes
  • Ability to shape strategy, establish governance, align senior stakeholders, and turn ambiguous needs into clear priorities
  • Hands-on experience in end-to-end business process transformation and re-engineering across multiple stakeholder groups, including change and adoption of ownership
  • Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS and back-office systems: CRM, billing, rating, analytics, identity, APIs and integration architecture
  • Proven ability to make trade-offs across scope, sequencing, investment, risk, technical debt and business value
  • Credible with senior technical, product, commercial and operational stakeholders; able to influence without direct line authority.

Nice to Have:

  • Background in telecoms, CPaaS, UCaaS, SaaS or other high-volume transactional technology environments
  • Experience with systems migration, platform consolidation, acquisition integration or business process re-engineering
  • Familiarity with scaled agile delivery, product operating models, transformation governance, data models, APIs and integration patterns.

How you'll benefit:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Ericsson Care Line
  • Discretionary Time Off (DTO)/Hourly Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Volunteer Time (VTO)
  • Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process.

$220,000—$290,000 USD

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

raw.description:
We are looking for an empathetic, detail-oriented, and proactive Accessibility Specialist to provide dedicated accessibility strategy, auditing, and remediation coverage across our client deliverables.

Note: This is a seasonal, fixed-term coverage role expected to run from December 2026 through May 2027 (specific employment dates are subject to change based on project needs).

Accessibility Specialists wear many hats—serving as auditor, educator, coach, technical advisor, and advocate for inclusive design. In this role, you will act as a key subject matter expert across cross-functional teams, ensuring our digital products, interfaces, and document deliverables not only meet but exceed Section 508, WCAG 2.2 AA, and ADA standards. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in assistive technologies, HTML5, and web standards, along with a passion for removing barriers and delivering high-quality digital experiences for Veterans and the public. Prior experience in federal government contracting or consulting is highly valued.
A typical day for a Coforma Accessibility Specialist might include performing accessibility audits and design reviews, reviewing Figma mockups for inclusive design practices, or advising developers on proper coding and VA Design System fixes. You might also audit and remediate non-web document formats (such as PDFs, Google Docs, or Microsoft Office files), support Veteran-Facing Services (VFS) teams in preparing for official VA 508 office audits, or provide assistive tech support for user research sessions to capture real-world accessibility observations. The best part of your day will be mentoring peers and celebrating when a delivery team successfully ships an accessible, barrier-free digital tool.
This role requires a persistent, positive, and growth-oriented mindset, along with a high degree of initiative and autonomy. You will thrive here if you are curious, highly collaborative, and dedicated to embedding accessibility throughout the entire product lifecycle—from initial strategy to measuring success. If you’re passionate about improving lives through digital products and services, Coforma is a great company for you.
$135,884 to $150,235 Annualized Salary + Benefits
Placement within this range will be based on the competency level of the candidate. An offer will be made at one of the following tiers:
  • Tier 1 — $135,884.40: Meets stated qualification and experience requirements. May need guidance and training beyond onboarding to perform the more complex functions of the role.

Director, Regulatory Response and Examination Management

BRIEF DESCRIPTION OF SUNSTRONG MANAGEMENT
SunStrong Management is a leading independent asset management and servicing platform specializing in residential and commercial solar energy portfolios. SunStrong provides end-to-end services including operations and maintenance, customer billing and support, asset performance management, and investor reporting. The company partners with leading capital providers to optimize clean energy assets at scale, supporting the growth of distributed renewable energy while delivering reliable performance and exceptional customer experience. This is a remote position.


THE DIRECTOR, REGULATORY RESPONSE AND EXAMINATION MANAGEMENT POSITION

SunStrong Management is building out its regulatory response and examination management function to support a growing national portfolio. This role owns it.
SunStrong Management operates across a national footprint, which means a continuous flow of inquiries, examinations, and information requests from state regulators, federal agencies, investors, and quasi-governmental entities. Each arrives with its own scope, requirements, and timeline.
The Director of Regulatory Response and Examination Management designs that function and runs it. This is an opportunity to shape a regulatory response operation at real scale, with executive visibility and the authority to set how it works.
The person in this seat is accountable for driving matters to resolution, not for reporting status. Success is measured by items closed, deadlines met without escalation, and a process that holds up under examination.

Position Summary
The Director, Regulatory Response and Examination Management leads the organization's response to regulatory inquiries, audits, examinations, and enforcement matters affecting its solar asset management operations and underlying project portfolios. This role serves as the primary point of coordination between the company, its regulators, and internal stakeholders during examinations conducted by state public utility commissions, FERC, ISOs/RTOs, tax authorities, environmental agencies, and investor/lender compliance reviews. The Director builds and manages the frameworks, processes, and teams needed to respond accurately, efficiently, and defensibly to regulatory requests while minimizing operational and financial risk.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Regulatory Examination & Inquiry Management
  • Serve as the primary organizational lead for managing regulatory examinations, audits, inquiries, subpoenas, and data requests from federal and state regulators (e.g., FERC, state PUCs, ISOs/RTOs, IRS/tax equity auditors, and environmental agencies).
  • Develop and execute examination response plans, including timelines, document production strategy, subject-matter expert coordination, and escalation protocols.
  • Serve as a liaison with regulators and outside counsel, ensuring consistent, accurate, and timely communication throughout examinations.
  • Track examination status, findings, and required remediation across the solar asset portfolio, maintaining a centralized examination log for leadership and board reporting.
Response Coordination & Documentation
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Legal, Asset Management, Engineering, Finance, and Operations teams to gather, validate, and produce accurate data and documentation in response to regulatory requests.
  • Draft and review formal regulatory responses, data requests, and correspondence, ensuring alignment with legal strategy and factual accuracy.
  • Maintain document management protocols and privilege logs to support examination readiness and defensible response practices.
Regulatory Risk & Compliance Program Development
  • Build and maintain a regulatory examination readiness program, including mock audits, response playbooks, and staff training on examination protocols.
  • Monitor evolving regulatory requirements affecting solar generation assets, interconnection compliance, RPS/REC programs, tax equity structures, and market participation rules; assess impact on the portfolio.
  • Partner with Compliance and Risk teams to identify examination trends and root causes, driving corrective action and process improvements.
  • Support development of policies, procedures, and internal controls that reduce regulatory risk exposure across the asset portfolio.

Stakeholder & Leadership Engagement
  • Prepare executive and board-level briefings summarizing examination status, findings, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Advise senior leadership on regulatory risk implications for acquisitions, financing, and portfolio transactions.
  • Manage and mentor a team of regulatory analysts/specialists, building examination management capability and bench strength.
  • Engage with external counsel, consultants, and industry associations on regulatory strategy and emerging examination trends.


REQUIREMENTS
  • 10+ years of experience managing relationships with and responses to third-party regulators and investors, including state regulatory agencies, federal agencies, examination bodies, and institutional investors or capital partners
  • Demonstrated experience running multi-jurisdiction regulatory response or examination programs, including concurrent matters with independent scopes and deadlines
  • Experience designing, improving, and scaling regulatory response processes, not solely operating within an established one
  • Experience managing document collection and production at volume, including coordination across multiple source systems and business units
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional accountability without direct authority over the people doing the work
  • Strong written work product, including the ability to prepare first drafts suitable for legal and compliance review
  • Sound judgment handling confidential, privileged, and sensitive material

Preferred
  • Background in mortgage servicing, consumer finance, solar finance, or another heavily regulated consumer-facing industry
  • Experience with state licensing examinations and audit readiness
  • Familiarity with formal information request and subpoena response mechanics
  • Experience managing outside counsel relationships and external legal spending
  • JD is not required for this role



physical requirements

Benefits

SunStrong Management offers a rich and affordable benefits package through UnitedHealthcare and MetLife within the US intercontinental states. Our benefits include:
  • HDHP and PPO Medical Plans, buy-up plans for both Dental and Vision, ancillaries such as Accident, Critical illness, Hospital indemnity, Short term and Long-Term Disability, Voluntary Life, and legal services along with multiple add-ons.
  • Our 401(k) Package includes an Employer Match of 100% up to the first 4% and 50% on the next 2% with immediate vesting.

Functional, automation, data validation, and performance testing

raw.description:
Who we are

Latent AI delivers edge AI solutions that enable rapid deployment of artificial intelligence capabilities on any device. Founded in 2018, the company's developer platform helps government and commercial organizations implement efficient, secure AI solutions at the edge. Latent AI's tools enable developers to build and update secure, adaptive models for field or laboratory use, serving defense and commercial customers. For more information, visit .

What we do

Latent AI is dedicated to unlocking the power of efficient and practical AI for real-world applications. Our deep expertise empowers organizations to seamlessly integrate AI into their operations, revolutionizing how they utilize edge devices. We understand the complexities of bringing AI to diverse devices. That's why we create solutions that simplify the process, making it accessible to a broader range of developers. This enables organizations to build better, safer AI faster.

What is a SkillBridge Program?

The SkillBridge Program is a D.o.D initiative that helps service members transition from active-duty military service to civilian careers.

Who we’re looking for

We’re seeking a motivated transitioning service member to join Latent AI as an Operations Intern through the DoD SkillBridge program. This role suits someone who thrives on variety, adapts quickly, and is comfortable switching hats as priorities shift. As a growing startup, our needs change fast: one week you may be supporting a customer program review, the next helping launch a marketing campaign or streamlining an internal process. You’ll work across operations, marketing, sales, and program teams to help Latent AI deliver its physical AI solutions to defense and commercial customers.

This internship is for training and professional development only. The service member will not displace civilian employees and will work under the close supervision of Latent AI’s operations leadership.

What you’ll do

Your focus will shift based on business needs. Expect to contribute across several of these areas:

  • Business Operations: Help build, document, and improve internal processes, SOPs, and workflows. Track action items, deadlines, and deliverables across teams to keep work moving.
  • Program and Project Support: Assist program managers with schedules, status reports, meeting coordination, and customer deliverables for defense and commercial engagements.
  • Contracts and Compliance: Support the organization of proposal materials, contract documentation, and government compliance requirements (e.g., registrations, certifications, security processes).
  • Marketing and Communications: Contribute to campaign ideas, write and edit content (blogs, newsletters, press releases, social posts), and help create sales enablement materials such as one-pagers and pitch decks.
  • Sales and Partner Support: Help maintain CRM data, prepare for customer and partner meetings, research prospects and markets, and coordinate joint initiatives with partners.
  • Events and Logistics: Plan and coordinate trade shows, conferences, customer visits, and team events, including travel, shipping, and vendor coordination.
  • Research and Analysis: Gather and synthesize information on markets, competitors, government programs, and operational metrics to inform leadership decisions.
  • People and Admin Operations: Support onboarding, recruiting coordination, tooling access, and general administrative needs as the team grows.

How we decide

  • Eligibility: Must be a transitioning service member eligible for the SkillBridge program.
  • Experience: Background in operations, logistics, administration, program management, public affairs, communications, or a related field. Experience supporting command staff or managing multiple lines of effort is a strong plus.
  • Skills:
    • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, shift focus quickly, and keep details from slipping.
    • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate technical concepts (e.g., edge AI, machine learning) for different audiences.
    • Sound research and analytical skills to support data-driven decisions.
    • Familiarity with project management, CRM, or marketing tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, HubSpot, Salesforce, Mailchimp) is a plus, with a willingness to learn new ones quickly.
    • Comfort using AI productivity tools to work faster and smarter is a plus.
  • Attributes: Adaptable, resourceful, and eager to learn. Takes ownership, asks good questions, and is comfortable with ambiguity. Team-oriented with a bias toward action and an interest in AI, technology, or defense.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace. Experience with design tools (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) or analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics) is a bonus.

What we offer

  • Hands-On Experience: Gain practical experience in content marketing and public relations within the innovative field of edge AI, working on projects that impact defense and commercial sectors.
  • Mentorship: Receive guidance from experienced marketing and AI professionals dedicated to supporting your transition to a civilian career.
  • Career Transition Support: Build a strong foundation for a marketing career by developing skills, networking, and refining your resume through the SkillBridge program.
  • Flexible Work Environment: This is a remote role, with opportunities to collaborate with our team based in Princeton, NJ, and across the US.
  • Impactful Work: Contribute to marketing initiatives that promote Latent AI’s mission to make AI accessible, efficient, and transformative for organizations worldwide.

This is a "pro bono" position

Location : This is fully remote with the option to work in Latent AI’s Princeton, NJ office.

Duration : This internship aligns with the SkillBridge program, which typically lasts up to 6 months and offers potential opportunities for continued engagement based on performance and business needs.

Welcome to Fi.

We’re a passionate team from Square, Google, Oura, Peloton, Uber, and more working to transform the human-pet relationship. Our mission? Develop cutting-edge technology to revolutionize what it means to be a pet parent. The pet industry remains firmly stuck in the past and we are here to change that. Fi is leveraging our team's talent and expertise to improve the lives of millions of pets in the U.S. Real-time location tracking, activity, sleep and behavior monitoring – and that's just the beginning.
The most exciting aspect of our work? Bridging the communication gap between pets and humans. Imagine a world where everyone knows how their pet feels in real time and how to keep their best friend in good shape. That's the future we're building at Fi.
If you're someone who thrives in innovative, collaborative work environments and feels strongly about helping pets live longer, better lives, Fi could be the perfect fit. Join us in our pursuit of the “impossible,” or as we call it here “let me find a way,” to redefine the future of pet ownership together.
Fi is looking for a Senior Director, Strategic Partnerships & Business Development!
Fi is looking for a Senior Director, of Strategic Partnerships & Business Development to build and lead the partnership engine behind our next stage of growth. You’ll find, structure and close deals with major brands, then turn each one into something customers actually love: a product integration, a co-marketing moment, or a new distribution channel that grows Fi’s reach and membership base. The goal is simple: build the integrations that make Fi indispensable to every pet parent.

What You'll Do:

  • Define where partnerships move the needle for Fi across acquisition, retention, membership value, distribution and brand, and build a prioritized roadmap of target partners
  • Open doors with major brands and lead deals from first pitch through term sheet and signature
  • Design product and marketing integrations that break through, with the customer experience at the center, not just the commercial outcome
  • Model the economics of every deal, including revenue, CAC, LTV, membership attach and cost to build and support, and make clear calls on what to pursue and what to pass on
  • Lead negotiations with confidence and structure terms that hold up over time
  • Rally Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance and Legal around each deal and own the plan from concept to launch
  • Set partner KPIs, run business reviews, double down on what works and wind down what doesn’t
  • Stand up BD processes, tools and pipeline reporting, and over time hire and develop a high-performing team
  • Represent Fi at industry events and with executives, and bring back sharp insight on trends, competitors and emerging opportunities

What You'll Bring:

  • 10+ years in business development, strategic partnerships or corporate development, with at least 5 in BD specifically
  • Deep D2C and subscription experience and a clear understanding of how partnerships drive acquisition, conversion, retention and LTV; time at a brand that also sells in retail, with a feel for channel economics, makes you even stronger
  • A track record of originating and closing game-changing deals with major brands, ideally including platform or ecosystem partnerships like carriers, insurance, veterinary, smart home, payments or app integrations
  • A senior network across brands, platforms and retailers, with bonus points for roots in pet, consumer electronics, wearables or health and wellness
  • Strong financial modeling chops: you build your own deal models, run scenarios and pressure-test assumptions with Finance, and a background in strategy, finance or consulting helps
  • Sharp negotiation skills and fluency in commercial terms like exclusivity, revenue share, data sharing, IP and co-marketing commitments
  • Creative product and marketing instincts that spot opportunities others miss
  • Proven cross-functional leadership taking deals from idea to launch without owning every team, plus experience building and leading a BD team
  • Executive presence: you can pitch a partner’s C-suite and write a crisp recommendation for Fi’s leadership
  • A builder mindset and real comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

Why You'll Love Us:

  • Time to Recharge: Enjoy flexible PTO to take the breaks you need.
  • Top-Notch Health Coverage: We’ve got your back (and teeth and eyes) with full medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Wellness Perks: Free access to One Medical, Kindbody, and Talkspace to keep you feeling your best.
  • Dog-Friendly Office: Bring your pup to work — they’re part of the team, too.
  • Give Back to the Pups: Make tails wag with a $500 annual donation to a dog charity of your choice through our BarkBack Program.
  • Free Fi Membership: Your furry best friend(s) get all the benefits of a Fi collar, on us!
  • Love for Friends + Family: Share the Fi magic with loved ones through our gifting program.

With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a Senior Manager, HR M&A to join our team.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Leads the HR workstream for assigned M&A projects from diligence through integration, partnering with Division/Functional HRBPs and HR COEs to coordinate all HR efforts and to identify and reduce operational HR risks.
  • Provides expertise, strategic consulting as well as thought leadership to help drive effective people strategies for each deal and influence deal negotiations accordingly.
  • Analyzes target company data to identify key HR-related financial exposures in a due diligence context, including those related to compensation and benefits plans.
  • Review and provide input on purchase agreements, disclosure schedules, presentation materials, employee communications.
  • Build and manage detailed project management plans for M&A transactions, from diligence to integration, coordinating HR COE activities to meet deal timeline. Manages multiple concurrent deals.
  • Lead HR team meetings, serve as HR functional lead on diligence calls, develop HR integration plan for IMO team. Owns the HR integration plan and Day 1 / Day 30 deliverables.
  • Provide input on HR best practices on processes that will be utilized during all merger and/or acquisition initiatives, both domestic and international, continuously improving the deal execution and integration processes utilizing integration checklists, project templates, best practices and project management tools pertaining to HR.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact between Labcorp HR and Seller HR throughout the transaction lifecycle, building trusted relationships and managing information requests, data exchanges and transition decisions.
  • Leads discovery of the seller's HR, payroll, compensation, benefits, leave and HR policy practices. Documents current-state vs. Labcorp gaps and recommends transition approaches.
  • Partners with Total Rewards, Compensation, and Payroll COEs to plan employee moves to Labcorp benefit plans, pay practices and payroll, including timing, transition service agreements (TSAs) and any bridge or harmonization strategies.
  • Coordinates Workday data conversion, onboarding and Day 1 readiness for acquired employees.
  • Develops employee communications, FAQs and manager toolkits with HRBPs, and supports town halls and change management.
  • Tracks integration milestones, risks and decisions, and, in partnership with the lead HRBP, reports status to HR leadership and the Integration Management Office (IMO).

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of HR experience, including experience in mergers and acquisitions
  • Bachelor's Degree, preferably in HR or similar field

Additional Job Standards:

  • Demonstrated minimum of 4-5 years’ project/program management experience.
  • Hands-on experience leading HR integration of acquired employees, including benefit, payroll and compensation transitions.
  • Broad HR generalist knowledge with understanding of complete employment lifecycle
  • Experience in international HR and M&A a strong plus
  • Working knowledge of US benefit plans, compensation structures and job architecture/leveling
  • Experience working directly with seller or target-company HR teams
  • Demonstrated leadership and management skills with the ability to drive to consensus on creative approaches to solving unique challenges in transitioning acquisition employees to Labcorp.
  • Proven ability to build credibility and influence with Seller HR and leadership, often before close and without formal authority.
  • Strong project management skills, including demonstrated ability to think end-to-end and manage multiple projects simultaneously with tight deadlines, ambiguous data, and rapidly shifting priorities
  • Keen attention to detail and accuracy, hands-on mentality, ability to influence in a global, matrixed environment
  • Knowledge of Workday utilizing best practices for M&A activities
  • Strong written and verbal communications; presentation skills.

About the Role:

This role is an integral part of the Global HR M&A team, reporting to the Sr. Director, HR M&A. The Sr. Manager leads HR workstreams for M&A projects end-to-end, from due diligence through integration, partnering closely with Division and Functional HR Business Partners, HR Centers of Excellence (Compensation, Benefits, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations/Workday and others), Finance, Legal and the deal team.

This position is the primary liaison between Labcorp HR and Seller HR. The Sr. Manager gains a deep understanding of the seller's HR, pay and benefit practices so they can plan and carry out a smooth move of acquired employees onto Labcorp's plans, policies and job architecture.


Application Window: Open through 11/11/26

Pay Range: $120,000-$140,000 + annual bonus

All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data.

The position is also eligible for an annual bonus under the Labcorp Bonus Plan. Bonuses are payable based on corporate and/or business segment performance and are subject to individual performance modifiers.


Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase

Job Description: Legal Citation Specialist (Law Students)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

What You'll Do: Review Bluebook citation-checking rubrics and create sample citation-checking tasks.

Requirements: Current or recent law school enrollment, hands-on experience with The Bluebook, and law journal or law review editing experience.

Job Summary

We are seeking law students and recent law graduates with law journal experience to support a legal citation project. Candidates with experience in cite-checking for a law review or law journal will apply their expertise to review citation guidelines, identify errors, and develop high-quality citation-checking tasks.

No prior AI experience is required. Strong knowledge of The Bluebook, attention to detail, and sound editorial judgment are essential for this role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review existing Bluebook and pinpoint citation (pincite) grading rubrics to identify unclear, incomplete, or inconsistently applied rules.
  • Identify citation edge cases that are not covered by existing rubrics and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Create sample citation-checking tasks by pairing source materials with citations containing realistic errors, along with corrected citations and explanations of the relevant rules.
  • Develop tasks covering a range of citation types and difficulty levels, from basic formatting errors to complex pincite and source-support issues.
  • Apply Bluebook rules consistently across all assigned submissions.
  • Flag ambiguous cases to project coordinators rather than making undocumented assumptions.
  • Complete assigned tasks on schedule while maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current law student, preferably in the second or third year (2L or 3L), or a recent Juris Doctor (JD) graduate.
  • Experience with a law review or law journal, preferably in cite-checking or source collection.
  • Strong working knowledge of The Bluebook, including pincites, short forms, signals, and parentheticals.
  • Ability to explain the reasoning behind citation errors and corrections clearly and accurately.
  • Excellent attention to detail and consistency when reviewing complex legal citations.
  • Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and meet deadlines.
  • Experience as a journal editor, articles editor, or executive editor is an advantage.

Selection Process

  1. Application: Apply for the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. AI Interview: Complete the interview to demonstrate your relevant skills and expertise to the client.
  3. Profile Review: The hiring team will review your profile and qualifications.
  4. Onboarding: The Talent Operations team will guide you through the onboarding process.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate has practical law journal cite-checking experience, a strong command of Bluebook citation rules, and the ability to evaluate citations critically, explain corrections, and create accurate, well-structured legal citation tasks.

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Business Value Strategy team is central to expanding Samsara’s enterprise business with our largest prospective customers by demonstrating significant ROI potential and positioning them for a long-lasting partnership with our company. This highly cross-functional role collaborates with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to grow revenue by identifying new areas of value for our customers and driving a value mindset across the organization.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Align customer and internal stakeholders on the main sources of value (efficiency, safety, sustainability) that a prospective customer will receive by using Samsara’s products.
  • Support existing customers by quantifying value realized by utilizing Samsara products and identifying areas of potential opportunity to maximize additional business value.
  • Conduct quantitative analysis, ROI modeling, and help manage trials to demonstrate value at scale through a Samsara deployment.
  • Consult with customers on best practices in change management, technology implementation, customer experience, and other topics critical to program successPresent insights and recommendations to customer executives and senior internal stakeholders.
  • Lead Business Value initiatives to drive operational excellence, lift engagement quality, and embed value throughout the broader organization.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 6+ years experience in management consulting, value engineering, finance, and/or business operations.
  • High aptitude and enthusiasm for complex problem solving utilizing modeling, including advanced Excel and Powerpoint / Google Slide skills.
  • Proven ability to build deep and empathetic working relationships with customers/clients and internal teams.
  • Structured thinker with an eye for value and attention to detail.
  • Self-starter who enjoys owning projects and thrives in an unstructured, change-heavy environment.
  • Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and driving impact/results.
  • Strong quantitative, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree required.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in fleet management, IoT devices, or B2B software a nice to have.
  • Experience working with executives in transportation, field services, energy, or public sector industries a nice to have.
  • Experience building AI-enabled tools or workflows that replaced recurring manual work a nice to have.
  • Experience applying AI to solve complex problems, with a clear view of where it succeeds and fails a nice to have.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$101,834—$154,035 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

We are a virtual women’s clinic delivering thoughtful, evidence-based care for complex and historically overlooked conditions—such as endometriosis, fibroids, chronic pelvic pain, and heavy menstrual bleeding. Here, you leverage your deep clinical wisdom from home, set your own cadence within flexible shifts, and focus entirely on meaningful patient relationships without the overhead and fatigue of brick-and-mortar clinics.

Why Senior Clinicians Choose Visana

  • True Flexibility & Restored Balance: Build your schedule around your life with a manageable 15-hour direct care commitment, zero commute, and paid administrative time.
  • Practice at the Top of Your License: Treat patients who genuinely need your specialized experience in complex women's health conditions, backed by an expert collaborative multidisciplinary team.
  • Protected Admin Time: We pay for admin time when your schedules are full, so you don't have to manage that competing priority.
  • High-Support Culture: Collaborate with seasoned clinical leadership and peer providers in weekly case conferences. Our provider retention rate (89% since 2025) reflects our commitment to clinician well-being.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide patient-centered, unhurried virtual evaluations and develop individualized, evidence-based care plans.
  • Guide patients through complex diagnostics and longitudinal management via secure messaging, telehealth visits, and phone follow-ups.
  • Complete accurate clinical documentation and coding within 24 hours of each encounter.
  • Mentor and collaborate within a group-practice model through weekly clinical case reviews and peer discussions.

Requirements

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

  • Clinical Expertise: 15+ years of extensive Nurse Practitioner experience dedicated to women’s health, complex gynecologic conditions, or primary care with deep women's health focus.
  • Licensure & Standing: Active, unencumbered NP licenses with prescriptive authority and eligibility for independent practice where applicable.
  • Multistate Footprint: Active licenses in at least 3 states, including:
    • Group A (at least 1): CA, NY, IN, GA, OH, TN, MN, AZ, or PA.
    • Group B (at least 1): VA, MO, KY, CO, FL, TX, MS, AL, NC, AR, CT, or NJ.
  • Board Certification & DEA: Certified in Family Practice, Adult Health, Women’s Health, or Nurse-Midwifery; active DEA registration.
  • Telehealth Agility: Comfort with or enthusiasm for virtual care delivery platforms and EMR workflows (Athenahealth experience preferred).
  • Availability: Commitment to at least 15 patient-facing hours per week with consistent Friday availability (shifts available between 6:30 AM – 10:00 PM local time).

Benefits & Support

  • Full malpractice insurance coverage provided.
  • Fully remote practice with comprehensive onboarding.
  • Dedicated administrative and care coordination support to offload routine non-clinical tasks.

This job is part of the Project Management function. The Sr. Project Manager is responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion. This is a remote role that requires approximately 40% out-of-town travel to client sites (3 out of 4 weeks a month/2 days per week).

raw.description:
Founded in 2012, Bugcrowd is the preemptive security platform that unifies exposure discovery and assessment, offensive testing, and intelligence shaped by AI and human insight to help organizations avoid, discover, and validate real-world risk. Bugcrowd helps security teams move faster by identifying the exposures that matter most so they can act first and stay ahead of attackers. By combining the power of humans and AI, teams can preempt attack paths and prevent breaches. Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others. Visit .

As a Embedded Systems Staff Engineer, you will own the architecture, maintenance, and continued improvement of ARM architecture support within Bugcrowd.

Job Summary

In this role, you will work at the boundary between CPU emulation, operating-system semantics, binary analysis, fuzzing, and symbolic execution. You will improve Bugcrowd’s ability to execute and analyze ARM and AArch64 binaries, diagnose subtle differences between native and emulated execution, and extend our support for new operating environments, binaries, and firmware targets.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve Bugcrowd’s ARM and AArch64 execution support using emulation.
  • Diagnose correctness, compatibility, and performance issues involving instruction semantics, memory management, exceptions, system calls, signals, threading, and process startup.
  • Add support for new ARM architectural features, instruction-set extensions, ABI variants, and execution environments.
  • Investigate discrepancies between native execution, QEMU execution, and Bugcrowd’s analysis engines.
  • Improve the performance, determinism, observability, and reliability of large-scale emulated workloads.
  • Develop test suites and regression infrastructure for instruction-level and end-to-end ARM behavior.
  • Debug customer binaries and firmware that exercise unusual platform, compiler, or operating-system behavior.

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 6+ years experience developing C/C++ on Linux
  • Significant experience working with low-level systems software such as emulators, virtual machines, operating systems, compilers, debuggers, binary translators, hypervisors, or dynamic instrumentation systems.
  • Deep understanding of ARM and/or AArch64 assembly, calling conventions, exception models, privilege levels, and memory semantics.
  • Strong understanding of Linux process execution, including ELF loading, virtual memory, signals, threads, system calls, dynamic linking, and debugging facilities.
  • Experience debugging complex native-code failures using tools such as GDB, LLDB, strace, perf, sanitizers, core dumps, or custom instrumentation.
  • Ability to reason about instruction-level behavior and identify subtle differences between architectures or execution engines.
  • Familiarity with fuzzing, symbolic execution, dynamic binary analysis, or program instrumentation, plus strong software-design skills and experience owning technically complex systems.

Preferred Experience

  • OCaml or other functional programming language
  • Background in vulnerability research, reverse engineering, or firmware analysis.
  • BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • US Person (for ITAR, such as a US citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual)

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

Sitting and / or standing - Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time

Carrying and / or lifting - Must be able to carry / move laptop as needed throughout the work day.

Environment - remote, work-from-home 100% of the time.

Pay Range Disclosure

At Bugcrowd, we strive for fairness, equality and to create an environment that allows our people to perform at their very best. Our compensation philosophy is to foster a collaborative community that rewards, attracts and retains the best possible talent. The provided compensation details are based on US national averages and we retain the flexibility to tailor to the needs of the business.

The national estimate for the current hourly rate for the position of $96.75 - $133.03.

This position may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary bonus program or commission plan, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Culture

  • At Bugcrowd, we understand that diversity in the workplace is vital to a company’s success and growth. We strive to make sure that people are included and have a sense of being part of making Bugcrowd not only a great product but a great place to work.
  • We regularly hear from both customers and researchers that Bugcrowd feels like a family, and we strive to maintain that internally as well.
  • Our team consists of a broad range of people: musicians, adventure sports junkies, nature lovers, parents, cereal enthusiasts, night owls, cyclists, artists—you get the point.

At Bugcrowd, we are solving security threats and vulnerabilities that are relevant to everyone, therefore we believe solving these problems takes all kinds of backgrounds. We value the perspectives and experiences people from underrepresented backgrounds bring.

Disclaimer

This position has access to highly confidential, sensitive information relating to the technologies of Bugcrowd. It is essential that the applicant possess the requisite integrity to maintain the information in the strictest confidence.

The company is authorized to obtain background checks for employment purposes under state and federal law. Background checks will be conducted for positions that involve access to confidential or proprietary information (including trade secrets).

Background checks may include Social Security verification, prior employment verification, personal and professional references, educational verification, and criminal history. Applicants with conviction histories will not be excluded from consideration to the extent required bylaw.

Any personal data you submit in connection with your application will be processed in compliance with Bugcrowd's Privacy Policy, which you may review here: .

raw.description:
Department Overview

The Medical Staff Office (MSO) at Hillsboro Medical Center (HMC) oversees practitioner credentialing, privileging, and medical staff support functions to ensure compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards and promote safe, high-quality patient care. Partnering closely with physicians, advanced practice providers, hospital leaders, and regulatory agencies, the MSO manages the full practitioner lifecycle, maintains accurate records, and supports key medical staff committees. Working in the MSO means joining a detail driven, collaborative team that plays a critical role in patient safety and organizational integrity. The environment is fast paced, highly regulated with a strong emphasis on accuracy, confidentiality, and service excellence.

The Credentialing Coordinator is responsible for coordinating practitioner credentialing, reappointment,

privileging, and ongoing monitoring activities for members of the medical staff and allied health professionals. This position ensures compliance with hospital bylaws, accreditation standards, regulatory requirements, and

organizational policies while supporting quality patient care through accurate and timely credentialing processes.

Function/Duties of Position

  • Processes applications for credentialing and privileging for both initial appointments and reappointments and/or privileging, as defined by established policies and procedures. This process requires detailed knowledge of legal, state, OHSU, DNV, TJC, and NCQA guidelines in assuring compliance with regulatory standards. Recognizes, investigates and validates discrepancies and adverse information obtained from the application, primary source verifications, or other sources. Regular communication with credentialing contacts is central to ensuring timely and accurate completion of the credentialing process.

  • Organization and maintenance of practitioner credential files, which contain confidential peer review information. As applicable when processing practitioner applications, this position involves consistent and professional follow-up for outstanding applications, conducting primary source verification, obtaining clinical activity documentation, and other searches such as OIG, Opt-Out and NPDB for presentation to the Medical Executive Committee/Governing Board. The coordinator tracks status of responses, follows up on missing information, and obtains appropriate approvals to assure that the practitioners’ credentials and quality files are complete, accurate, and up to date.

  • May need to collaborate with physician leaders, Credentialing Supervisor, and the Medical Affairs Director to develop and maintain a facility-specific, criteria-based clinical privileging system in accordance with regulatory requirements, accreditation standards, and organizational policies.

  • Maintenance of confidential computerized information in credentialing databases for all applications for appointments and reappointments, as well as any other processing such as additional privileges, temporary privileges, status changes and more. Detailed documentation during all steps in the credentialing process and updating and/or revising information in the database regarding credentialing daily from receipt of application to completion of processing is key.

  • May be required to perform and coordinate meeting logistics, documentation preparation, and follow-up at Hillsboro Medical Center.

  • Other Duties as Assigned

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED required AND

  • 3 years medical staff credentialing experience in a healthcare or insurance provider setting; OR associate's degree and 3 years experience performing data collection or data analysis using complex database software systems; OR A combination of education and experience.

  • Demonstrated software database experience (for efficient generation of letters and other correspondence, activity tracking and report production).

  • Familiarity with legal, state, TJC and NCQA guidelines in assuring medical staff compliance with regulatory agencies.

Job Related Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (Competencies):

  • Expresses thoughts clearly, concisely, and effectively both verbally and in writing. Ensures a free flow of information and communication upward, downward and across the organization by actively listening and encouraging the open expression of ideas and opinions.
  • Displays a credible presence and positive image. Use appropriate protocol for professional and social situations.
  • Organizes work, sets priorities, and determines short- or long-term goals and strategies to achieve them. Aligns communication, people, processes and resources to drive success.
  • Establishes productive, cooperative relationships with subordinates, peers, management, and stakeholders both internal and external to the organization.
  • Ability to understand laws, regulatory agency requirements and standards. Possess independent problem solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Sensitivity to, and natural inclination in, dealing with highly confidential information and communication.
  • Proficiency in word processing, computer system work, understanding of data and ability to interpret complex scenarios to assess possible actions and resolutions around credentialing and privileging.
  • Must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without accommodation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate or bachelor’s Degree
  • Previous experience in hospital medical staff credentialing and privileging is highly desirable.
  • Experience using CredentialStream or similar credentialing software.
  • Experience supporting medical staff committees.
  • CredentialStream credentialing database.
  • Hospital credentialing/recredentialing
  • Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS), or
  • Certified Professional Medical Services Management (CPMSM)

Additional Details

This position is being recruited for an expectation for Monday-Friday coverage from 8:00am-4:30pm. Full-time remote position with regular interaction with physicians, advanced practice providers, healthcare leaders, and external agencies. Position requires frequent computer use, management of multiple priorities, strict attention to detail, and the ability to meet established deadlines in a fast-paced regulatory environment.

Why apply to OHSU?

We are Oregon's only public academic health center. In addition to caring for patients, we lead groundbreaking research. We also train the next generation of health care professionals. As Portland's largest employer, we give you opportunities to learn and advance in a system of hospitals and clinics across Oregon and Southwest Washington. All are welcome. High Roller Technologies is expanding into the rapidly evolving regulated prediction markets space — a major new growth area for the business. We’re building a consumer-facing prediction markets platform for the US market and are looking for talented people to join us as we build and scale the product.

We are looking for a QA Lead to take ownership of quality assurance across our prediction markets platform. This is a hands-on role. You will be responsible for testing new features and releases while also establishing the QA processes and standards needed as the product and team grow. Working closely with Product and Engineering, you will help ensure issues are identified before they reach customers and that key customer journeys work reliably from end to end.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Own and develop the QA approach and processes across the ROLR prediction markets platform.

  • Test new product features against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.

  • Create and execute clear test plans, test cases and testing scenarios.

  • Perform functional, regression, integration and end-to-end testing.

  • Test key customer journeys including account registration, verification, funding, market discovery, placing trades, viewing positions, settlement and withdrawals.

  • Test different user, account and transaction scenarios, including error states and edge cases.

  • Identify, document and track bugs through to resolution.

  • Clearly reproduce and communicate issues to Product and Engineering.

  • Re-test fixes and ensure resolved issues do not create problems elsewhere in the product.

  • Work closely with the Product Owner to identify gaps and ensure requirements are testable.

  • Support testing of integrations and end-to-end customer journeys where required.

  • Own regression testing and QA readiness ahead of releases.

  • Highlight outstanding issues and product risks before release.

  • Build and maintain QA documentation and regression suites.

  • Support investigation and testing of issues identified in production.

  • Help shape how the QA function develops as the product and team grow.

You’ll Need To

  • Have previous experience in QA, software testing or a similar role, with experience taking ownership of QA activities.

  • Have experience testing web-based digital products.

  • Have a strong understanding of functional, regression and end-to-end testing.

  • Have experience creating test plans and test cases and documenting defects clearly.

  • Have strong attention to detail and an ability to identify scenarios others may overlook.

  • Be comfortable working closely with Product and Engineering teams.

  • Have strong problem-solving and communication skills.

  • Be able to work independently and take ownership of product quality.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in fintech, trading, payments, gaming or another transaction-based digital product.

  • Experience testing products involving financial transactions or real-time data.

What We Offer

  • Competitive health and welfare benefits

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match

  • Flexible vacation policy

  • Home office setup reimbursement

  • Team events and get-togethers

  • Access to mental health support

raw.description:
Role
Data Engineer
Who We Are
Mission: At Clever Digital Marketing, we are on a mission to empower large-scale home improvement companies by fueling their top-line revenue through innovative digital marketing strategies. By bridging the gap in the industry for a highly profitable digital lead vendor, we've created a unique space where growth isn't just supported — it's catalyzed.
Product: Clever Digital Marketing delivers outcome-driven paid advertising and strategic advising solutions. We don't focus on clicks and impressions — we focus on net sales. Our customized, data-driven strategies are tailored to each client's unique needs, ensuring measurable impact and scalable profitability across Google, Meta, and Microsoft ad platforms.
Scale: Recognized by the Globe and Mail as the #1 Fastest-Growing Company in the Marketing & Advertising category and #42 across all of Canada, we are the growth engine behind some of North America's most ambitious home improvement brands — companies on track to generate over $500 million in combined revenue in 2026. With a team of 80+ across North America, $74M in digital ad spend managed, and 400,000+ leads generated, we've built something rare: a system where scale isn't luck. It's engineering.
Impact: As trusted subject matter experts in the home improvement space, we are redefining what it means to deliver value. Our commitment to authenticity, collaboration, and continuous improvement ensures we remain a powerhouse of growth and measurable results for every client we serve. We don't do lead generation — we do revenue generation.
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for an Intermediate Data Engineer to build and strengthen the pipelines that power our entire advertising operation. As we scale Data Platform 2.0 — our GCP-native data platform — we need an engineer who delivers reliable, well-tested work independently, takes real ownership of defined portions of the stack, and is hungry to grow into broader platform ownership alongside a senior team. You won't be designing the architecture on day one — but you will be trusted to build within it, improve it, and prove you're ready for more.

Key Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

Build and Manage Data Pipelines
  • Build and maintain production ELT pipelines ingesting data from Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Microsoft/Bing Ads APIs — as well as CRM, call tracking, and lead event sources — into our BigQuery data ecosystem
  • Own reliable Bronze layer ingestion for your assigned sources, with audit trails and no silent failures
  • Extend and maintain API connectors (REST/OAuth2) within our established Cloud Run patterns, and troubleshoot integration issues to root cause rather than working around them
Deliver Within the Platform Architecture
  • Implement Silver layer transformation logic and contribute Gold layer Dataform models serving Command Centre, client reporting, and future AI/ML consumers — working from designs set by the Data Team leadership
  • Raise gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities in the architecture proactively — bring a proposed approach, not just the problem
  • Contribute to the CDMID join logic that unifies CRM, ad platform, and call tracking data into coherent lead records across client accounts
Manage Data Warehousing and Modeling
  • Develop and maintain BigQuery data models for your assigned domains, applying dimensional modeling fundamentals with consistent naming, structure, and documentation
  • Deliver clean, trusted, cost-metric-driven datasets that let our team move beyond vanity metrics to cost-per-issued-lead and cost-per-demo insights
Automate and Optimize
  • Write SQL & Python-based automation using GCP services — Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and Pub/Sub — to orchestrate workflows and eliminate manual processes
  • Monitor and tune pipelines and BigQuery queries for performance and cost-efficiency, flagging systemic issues before they compound
  • Help graduate workflows off low-code automation tools and onto reliable, auditable pipelines
Own Data Quality, Documentation and Responsible Data Handling
  • Implement quality checks and validation on everything you ship — and treat testing & documentation as part of delivery, not an afterthought
  • Proactively monitor pipeline health and resolve the root causes of data discrepancies, not just flag them
  • Handle lead and client data responsibly: respect consent boundaries, follow least-privilege access practices, and avoid introducing PII where it is not needed

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

What We Are Looking For

Non-Negotiables
  • 2–4 years of hands-on data engineering or analytics engineering experience with real production contributions — you've built and maintained pipelines that other people depended on
  • Strong SQL and working Python proficiency for data transformation, scripting, and pipeline development
  • Hands-on experience with BigQuery or an equivalent cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, Redshift)
  • Practical experience integrating third-party APIs (REST, OAuth2) into data workflows
  • Working experience with at least part of the GCP stack — or strong equivalent cloud experience and a demonstrated ability to ramp quickly
  • Solid grasp of data warehousing fundamentals: staging vs. modeled layers, incremental loads, deduplication, and idempotent design
  • Version control (Git) and code review as daily working habits
Who You Are
  • Accountable for outcomes — you take responsibility for the reliability of what you ship, not just task completion
  • Proactive — you ask scoping questions before starting work, surface problems you observe, and renegotiate timelines early when scope grows
  • Quality-minded — you balance delivery pace with maintainability and avoid shortcuts that create downstream debt
  • A clear communicator — you document decisions, flag risks before stakeholders do, and participate constructively in peer review
  • Kaizen-driven — you leave systems better than you found them and raise improvement opportunities without being asked
Nice to Haves
  • Direct experience with a major ad platform API (Google Ads, Meta Marketing API, or Microsoft Ads)
  • Dataform, dbt, SQLMesh, or an equivalent transformation framework
  • Pub/Sub or other event-streaming experience
  • Background in performance marketing, ad-tech, or a multi-client agency environment
  • CRM data pipelines (Salesforce, HubSpot, LeadPerfection) or call tracking data integration
  • Prior experience replacing fragile low-code automation with production-grade pipelines
  • Awareness of privacy-compliant measurement (consent signals, server-side tracking, PIPEDA/GDPR basics)
What You Will Not Do
  • Design the platform architecture solo — you will execute within it and inform it, with clear direction and code review from senior engineers
  • Own media buying, campaign strategy, or client-facing reporting delivery — your role is the infrastructure that makes those possible
  • Work in a legacy or on-premise environment — this is a fully cloud-native GCP stack

Benefits

What We Offer
  • An incredible team and culture — high-performance, feedback-oriented, and data-driven, where everyone is empowered to succeed. Our culture thrives on collaboration, extreme ownership, and Kaizen. This is more than a workplace — it's a place where you'll grow, learn, and thrive alongside passionate teammates who are as invested in your success as you are
  • Real ownership of production systems within a platform being built from the ground up — with a clear runway to grow your scope as you prove it
  • Be part of the #1 fastest-growing marketing company in Canada, redefining performance marketing for the home improvement industry
  • A modern, GCP-native stack with AI embedded in daily workflows — Claude and Gemini are tools you'll use every day, not novelties
  • Exposure to AI/NLQ, MMM modeling, and ML optimization layers as the proprietary platform matures
  • Fully remote work environment with the flexibility to work from anywhere in Canada
  • 3+ weeks of paid time off annually, with the freedom to use them as you see fit
  • Comprehensive group benefits including health, dental, and vision
  • Company-provided MacBook Pro and home office budget to help you create your ideal workspace
  • A work abroad policy to support you when you need a fresh perspective
  • Merch deliveries and opportunities to connect with teammates at meetups and company-wide events
  • A defined growth path toward Senior Data Engineer for those who demonstrate consistent ownership, quality, and impact
Other
  • Job-Type: Full-Time Permanent
  • Standard business hours: 9am – 5pm EST
  • Working Arrangements: Remote within Canada — Occasional in-office collaboration opportunities. Candidates must be legally eligible to work in Canada.
  • This posting is for an existing vacancy
  • Base Salary: $90,000 - $120,000 CAD
Clever Digital Marketing values the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the team. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of support during the recruitment and selection process. Please note that artificial intelligence (AI) may be utilized during the interview or candidate evaluation process to support the fair and efficient screening, assessment, and selection of applicants.
