raw.title: Master's-level Library Scientist – Systematic Reviews & Evidence Synthesis
raw.excerpt: Why RTI RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition.
raw.description:
Why RTI

RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.

We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.

About the Hiring Group

RTI International is seeking a Master’s-levelLibrary Scientist to fill a position supporting our evidence synthesis portfolio. Our work includes systematic and comparative effectiveness reviews, health technology assessments, rapid and scoping reviews, evidence maps, other types of evidence reviews, and research portfolio analysis for federal and other clients.

In this role, you will lead the design and execution of comprehensive literature searches and reference management for evidence synthesis projects, and you will also work as a research analyst and provide editorial support to review teams. You will be an integral part of multidisciplinary teams, collaborating with senior research staff, methodologists, and content experts on large, federally funded systematic reviews and smaller evidence synthesis projects.

The ideal candidate is an expert in searching health-related and allied health bibliographic databases (e.g., PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, CINAHL, ERIC, etc.), an expert citation management software user, and brings strong editorial skills to ensure high-quality, well-documented work products.

This position may be based in RTI’s U.S. office in Research Triangle Park, NC, or may be considered for fully remote work from an approved location within the United States. Teleworking is permitted within the United States only and is subject to RTI approval; not all U.S. locations may be eligible.

What You'll Do

  • Work with project directors, clients, and content experts to translate evidence synthesis questions and scope into search strategies, and contribute to documenting search methods in systematic review protocols and evidence synthesis reports.
  • Design, test, and execute comprehensive, reproducible search strategies using controlled vocabulary (e.g., MeSH, Emtree, CINAHL Subject Headings) and free-text terms across health-related bibliographic databases and platforms, including PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, CINAHL, PsycINFO, the Cochrane Library, Web of Science, and Scopus (via Ovid, EBSCOhost, ProQuest, and other interfaces).
  • Conduct grey literature and supplemental searches, including trial registries (e.g., ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO ICTRP), regulatory and government sources, conference proceedings, and citation chasing.
  • Peer review search strategies (e.g., using PRESS checklist), and document and report searches consistent with current standards (e.g., PRISMA 2020, PRISMA-S), including search appendices and flow diagrams.
  • Serve as the team’s citation management software lead: build and manage project libraries, deduplicate records, retrieve full text, maintain shared libraries, format references to journal and client style requirements, and train staff in reference management.
  • Run update and surveillance searches for living, update, and multi-year reviews.
  • As a research analyst, use rigorous methods consistent with current standards to conduct title/abstract and full-text screening, data abstraction, risk of bias appraisal, and prepare evidence tables; contribute to qualitative and quantitative synthesis.
  • Use systematic review software (e.g., DistillerSR, Nested Knowledge) to manage the review process.
  • Work with a team to explore, test, and validate AI and automation tools for searching, deduplication, and screening in evidence synthesis work.
  • Review and copyedit reports, manuscripts, and other deliverables for consistency, coherence, reference accuracy, and adherence to formatting and style guidelines, and support quality control processes.
  • Maintain client-specific templates for protocols and evidence synthesis reports; serve as a resource to evidence synthesis teams for using and troubleshooting templates.
  • Support the development of research products (i.e., reports, manuscripts, presentations, guidance documents, memos) in collaboration with the client and RTI project team.
  • Contribute to business development by writing search methods and information-specialist sections of proposals under the direction of more senior staff.
  • Help onboard, train, and mentor research analysts on searching, reference management, and documentation practices.

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in library science, library and information science, or information science (MLS, MLIS, MSIS, or equivalent; ALA-accredited program preferred) AND at least 3 years’ experience as a health sciences/medical librarian or information specialist supporting systematic reviews or other evidence synthesis.
  • Expert-level searching skills across major health-related databases and interfaces (e.g., PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, CINAHL, PsycINFO, Cochrane Library, Web of Science, Scopus), including controlled vocabularies and database-specific syntax.
  • Expert proficiency in citation management (EndNote preferred), including deduplication, shared libraries, full-text retrieval, and output style formatting.
  • Working knowledge of evidence synthesis standards and guidance (e.g., Cochrane Handbook, AHRQ EPC Methods Guide, PRISMA 2020, PRISMA-S, PRESS).
  • Experience using systematic review software (e.g., DistillerSR, Nested Knowledge, Covidence, EPPI-Reviewer).
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment with staff in different geographic locations and with a range of education and experience levels.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to meet client conflict-of-interest requirements, including no current or future financial relationships with pharmaceutical manufacturers.
  • To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B visa status, etc.). 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on research analyst experience in screening, data abstraction, and risk of bias assessment, and co-authorship of published systematic reviews.
  • Experience supporting federally or non-profit funded evidence synthesis programs (e.g., AHRQ Evidence-based Practice Center, USPSTF, PCORI, CDC, EPA, NIH).
  • Editorial experience, including copyediting or technical editing of reports and manuscripts for consistency, coherence, reference accuracy, and adherence to style guides (e.g., AMA Manual of Style, APA, client-specific styles).
  • Experience using AI and automation tools for search development, deduplication, or screening, and with search development aids (e.g., DistillerSR’s Smart Evidence Extraction, Yale MeSH Analyzer, PubMed PubReMiner).
  • Experience with bibliometric or research portfolio analysis.
  • Additional degree or coursework in public health, health sciences, or a related field.
  • Experience teaching or training researchers in literature searching and reference management.

EEO & Pay Equity Statements

For San Francisco, CA USA Job Postings Only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Further information is available here.

RTI accepts applications to our job openings from candidates with criminal histories or conviction records in accordance with all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

For Applicants in Massachusetts Only: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

The anticipated pay range for this role is listed below. Our pay ranges represent national averages and may vary by location as a geographic differential may be applied to some locations within the United States. RTI considers multiple factors when making an offer including, for example: established salary range, internal budget, business needs, and education and years of work experience possessed by the applicant. Further, salary is merely one element to our offer.

At RTI, we demonstrate our commitment to rewarding individual and team achievement through a total rewards package. This package includes (among other things) a competitive base salary, a generous paid time off policy, merit based annual increases, bonus opportunities and a robust recognition program. Other benefits include a competitive range of insurance plans (including health, dental, life, and short-term and long-term disability), access to a retirement savings program such as a 401(k) plan, paid parental leave for all parents, financial assistance with adoption expenses or infertility treatments, financial reimbursement for education and developmental opportunities, an employee assistance program, and numerous other offerings to support a healthy work-life balance.


Equal Pay Act Minimum/Range

$83,000 - $102,000

raw.description:
Exec Director, Opportunity Strategy Architect

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Company

Syneos Health is a leading, fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization that partners with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to develop and commercialize new therapies. Formed in 2017 through the merger of INC Research and inVentiv Health, the business combines clinical development and commercial capabilities within a single platform, supporting customers from early-stage trials through product launch and market adoption.

With more than 25,000 employees globally and operations across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, Syneos Health serves a broad mix of large pharmaceutical companies and emerging biotechnology organizations. The company’s integrated model, global scale, therapeutic expertise, and long-standing customer relationships position it as a differentiated partner within the biopharma services ecosystem.

Syneos Health was taken private in 2023 by a consortium of private equity investors after operating as a public company. Today, the business generates approximately $5 billion in annual revenue and is focused on defining its next phase of growth, including how it sharpens its strategic focus and evolves within an increasingly dynamic and technology-driven market environment.

The opportunity

Syneos is building an Analytics Center of Excellence to improve how data, clinical insight, real-world evidence, feasibility, patient access, site strategy, and operational experience are brought into pre-award decision-making. The Opportunity Strategy Architect is the role that forces the organization to ask better questions before the proposal strategy is set.

This person does not need to be the therapeutic expert or medical expert. They must understand clinical trials and drug development well enough to identify when the stated approach does not make sense, when the data does not support the strategy, and when the team is defaulting to the traditional answer instead of the best answer.

Core positioning

The Opportunity Strategy Architect is the strategic conscience of the opportunity: the person who asks why, challenges assumptions, determines what data is needed, and helps convert insight into a client-specific strategy that can win and be delivered.

The role

The Opportunity Strategy Architect is assigned to high-value or strategically important opportunities to assess, qualify, and shape the strategy before proposal and bid defense decisions are locked. The role must be constructively challenging, evidence-based, and commercially practical.

  • Lead structured opportunity interrogation for assigned Category 3/4/5 or strategically important opportunities.

  • Ask simple but powerful questions about client intent, asset strategy, protocol purpose, competitive context, current vendor dynamics, and what the client is really trying to achieve.

  • Pressure-test whether the protocol, enrollment assumptions, country/site mix, patient access plan, recruitment/retention approach, and delivery model are credible.

  • Identify what data and analytics are needed to support or challenge the proposed strategy.

  • Partner with data science, RWD analytics, RWE methods, feasibility, recruitment/retention, patient access, site intelligence, integrated solutions, pricing, proposal teams, BD, DSDs, and therapeutic leaders.

  • Translate insights into an opportunity diagnostic: client intent, asset objective, assumptions, risk hypotheses, data needs, recommended strategy, solution implications, and bid-defense win themes.

  • Influence or escalate through agreed governance when the team is ignoring data, overclaiming evidence, or defaulting to a weak or traditional strategy.

  • Support proposal and bid-defense teams by clarifying the differentiated story, likely objections, and data-backed proof points.

  • Document assumptions and hand off strategy, risks, and mitigation logic to delivery if the opportunity is awarded.

Candidate profile

The ideal candidate is a clinical development strategist who brings intellectual curiosity, commercial judgment, operational credibility, data literacy, and the ability to challenge conventional thinking constructively. They should be able to move across client strategy, clinical trial execution, evidence, patient access, proposal strategy, and delivery risk.

  • Strategic curiosity: Identifies the client’s trial rationale, asset strategy, and unstated needs in the RFP by asking clear, targeted questions.

  • Drug Development lens: Connects the protocol to lifecycle strategy, regulatory commitments, market access, competitive positioning, evidence generation, partnership, or divestiture goals.

  • Clinical trial fluency: Understands enough about trial design, feasibility, enrollment, site operations, patient burden, and delivery risk to recognize when something does not make sense.

  • Data judgment: Uses data directionally, challenges weak assumptions, identifies gaps and limitations, and prevents teams from ignoring inconvenient evidence.

  • Constructive challenge: Can ask hard questions without being abrasive and can influence without direct authority.

  • Translation ability: Turns messy, fragmented inputs into a clear strategic point of view and a proposal-ready story.

Professional qualifications

  • 10-15+ years of relevant experience in clinical development strategy, CRO strategic solutions, clinical operations strategy, portfolio/asset strategy, strategic feasibility, RWE strategy, trial innovation, bid defense strategy, or life sciences consulting.

  • Strong understanding of how clinical trials are designed, scoped, bid, awarded, operationalized, and delivered.

  • Experience supporting RFPs, RFIs, bid defenses, strategic account opportunities, complex proposals, or clinical trial advisory work.

  • Demonstrated ability to challenge assumptions and influence cross-functional teams in complex, time-sensitive environments.

  • Experience using data and analytics to shape strategy; direct data science expertise is not required, but data literacy and skepticism are essential.

  • Familiarity with feasibility, enrollment modeling, site/country selection, patient access, recruitment/retention strategy, RWD/RWE, decentralized trial solutions, or competitive trial intelligence is preferred.

  • Experience with multi-region or global clinical trials preferred.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree in life sciences, public health, business, health economics, epidemiology, or related field preferred.

Personal characteristics

  • Relentlessly curious and willing to ask obvious questions that others skip.

  • Comfortable saying, "Help me understand why we are going against the data."

  • Pragmatic and commercially minded; not academic for the sake of being academic.

  • Able to challenge with respect, precision, and calm confidence.

  • Uses sound judgment, intellectual honesty, and constructive influence; remains open to being wrong when the evidence shifts.

  • Able to operate with incomplete information and still land a clear recommendation.

  • Strong storyteller who can connect data, client intent, and execution reality.

  • Not attached to legacy ways of working or standard proposal answers.

  • Strong written and verbal communicator with senior stakeholder presence.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

raw.description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadRiuso, an AI recommerce venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Riusois the operating record for electronics returns and liquidation benches. Owner-operated resellers and refurbishers spend around eleven minutes identifying, grading and pricing each returned or liquidated unit by hand. When the bench backs up, units default to the liquidation pallet, the lowest-value exit.Riusoidentifies and grades each unit from photos in seconds and prices every disposition route, from resell and refurb to part-out, wholesale and pallet. It then routes the unit to the highest-recovery option. Every decision becomes memory the bench owns: repeat models price instantly, seller manifest accuracy builds over time, and outbound IMEI records turn mismatched returns into winnable claims. It runs on a phone and a label printer, with no integration.

Market Context

US consumers returned an estimated $849.9B of merchandise in 2025, and North American refurbished electronics is a roughly $17B market growing at double digits. Riuso addresses a $2.2B TAM across North American returns and recommerce benches. Its beachhead is 12,000 electronics-focused owner-operators, a $144M SAM. Right-to-repair laws now in force across California, New York, Texas, Oregon and five other states are deepening the parts market. Tariffs on new devices are pulling more buyers toward refurbished. Both make every unit on the bench worth more to price correctly.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

  • Investor and advisor network across supply chain tech and early-stage capital markets

  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with owner-operated electronics resellers and refurbishers, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion

  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

  • Direct exposure to electronics resale, liquidation, refurbishment or reverse logistics

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.
